title: Data Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Du möchtest nicht nur Daten verarbeiten, sondern eine moderne Datenplattform entwickeln, die Analysen, Reporting und datengetriebene Entscheidungen im gesamten Unternehmen ermöglicht? 

Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für dich sein. 

Unser Kunde, ein dynamisch wachsende E-Commerce Service Agentur in Berlin , zählt zu den erfolgreichsten Amazon-Händlern Deutschlands und vertreibt tausende Produkte 

Für den weiteren Ausbau der Data & Analytics Landschaft wird eine Persönlichkeit gesucht, die moderne Datenarchitekturen entwickelt und den Weg zu einer datengetriebenen Organisation aktiv mitgestaltet 

Deine Benefits 

- Attraktive Vergütung: Ein leistungsgerechtes Fixgehalt, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht. 

- Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit 2 Home-Office Tagen, einer 40-Stunden-Woche, Gleitzeit mit Arbeitsbeginn zwischen 6:00 und 10:00 Uhr. 

- Langfristige Sicherheit: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag sowie 30 Urlaubstage in einem wirtschaftlich erfolgreichen und zukunftssicheren Unternehmen. 

- Weiterentwicklung: Ob fachlich oder persönlich – deine Entwicklung wird aktiv gefördert und langfristig begleitet. 

- Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Freue dich auf ein modernes Büro im Berliner Bezirk Lichtenberg. 

- Mobilität: Ob mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder dem Auto – profitiere von einem bezuschussten Jobticket oder kostenlosen Parkplätzen direkt am Büro. 

- Teamkultur: Flache Hierarchien, offene Kommunikation, eine gelebte Du-Kultur und regelmäßige Team- sowie Firmenevents wie „Grill & Chill“ sorgen für ein starkes Miteinander. 

- Verpflegung: Kostenlose Getränke sowie frisches Obst stehen dir im Arbeitsalltag jederzeit zur Verfügung. 

- Mitarbeitervorteile: Profitiere von attraktiven Mitarbeiterrabatten auf das Sortiment sowie weiteren Corporate Benefits. 

Deine Aufgaben 

Als Data Engineer entwickelst und betreibst du moderne Datenplattformen in Microsoft Azure und Microsoft Fabric und sorgst dafür, dass hochwertige Daten zuverlässig für Analysen, Reporting und Machine-Learning-Anwendungen bereitstehen. 

- Data Engineering: Konzeption, Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung moderner Datenpipelines in Microsoft Azure und Microsoft Fabric. 

- Datenqualität: Sicherstellung einer hohen Datenqualität, Vollständigkeit und Reproduzierbarkeit sowie Implementierung effizienter inkrementeller Datenladeprozesse. 

- Datenintegration: Entwicklung und Pflege effizienter ETL-/ELT-Prozesse sowie API-basierter Datenintegrationen. 

- Plattformbetrieb: Entwicklung robuster Monitoring-, Logging- und Fehlerbehandlungskonzepte sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung von Performance, Kosten und Datenworkflows. 

- Data Architecture: Mitarbeit am Aufbau einer skalierbaren Datenarchitektur inklusive Test-, Staging- und Produktionsumgebungen sowie moderner Technologien wie CI/CD, Fabric Pipelines, dbt oder Airflow. 

- Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit dem Head of Data & Analytics und den Data Analysts zur Bereitstellung hochwertiger Daten für Power BI Dashboards und Machine-Learning-Modelle. 

Dein Profil als Data Engineer 

- Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von Datenpipelines oder Datenplattformen – idealerweise auf Senior-Level, motivierte Mid-Level-Profile sind ebenfalls willkommen. 

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Azure Data Services , insbesondere Data Factory und/oder Azure Synapse ; idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung mit Microsoft Fabric . 

- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL und Python , insbesondere im Bereich ETL-/ELT-Prozesse und Automatisierung. 

- Erfahrung in der Datenmodellierung , idealerweise mit Bronze-, Silver- und Gold-Layer-Architekturen . 

- Kenntnisse im Datenqualitätsmanagement sowie in Monitoring, Logging und Performance-Optimierung . 

- Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Umsetzung technischer Projekte sowie eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise. 

- Ausgeprägte Teamorientierung sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld. 

- Fließende Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse. Bei geringeren Deutschkenntnissen (ab B1) werden dafür sehr gute Englischkenntnisse vorausgesetzt. 

Nice-to-haves – jedes zusätzliche Know-how ist ein Pluspunkt:

- Erfahrung mit inkrementellen Ladeprozessen und Delta-Verarbeitung . 

- Erfahrung in der Datenintegration für Power BI sowie im Umgang mit semantischen Modellen. 

- Kenntnisse im E-Commerce- oder Amazon-Umfeld . 

- Erfahrung mit API-basierten Datenintegrationen . 

- Kenntnisse in CI/CD , z. B. mit GitHub Actions oder Azure DevOps . 

- Interesse an Machine Learning und dem Aufbau datengetriebener Organisationen. 

- Erfahrung mit Openbridge . 

Die Rolle als Data Engineer klingt genau nach dir? Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und wir geben dir in einem kurzen Telefonat alle weiteren Infos zu Stelle und Unternehmen.

title: Techniker / Ingenieur Versorgungstechnik, Gebäude- Energiemanagement, TGA oder Heizungstechnik (m/w/d)
description:
Wer wir sind 

termios macht Heizen in Wohn- und Gewerbeimmobilien smarter und klimafreundlicher. Unser Thermostat spart spürbar Energie und hilft Asset Managern, Wohnungsunternehmen und Eigentümern, ihre ESG- und Net-Zero-Ziele zu erreichen.

Wir sind ein Startup - 2023 als Joint-Venture von mantro (Company Builder), dem sauerländischen Familienunternehmen Oventrop und der Düsseldorfer LEG Immobilien SE gegründet. Als Technologieunternehmen entwickeln wir grüne Lösungen rund um Heizen, Nachhaltigkeit und ESG für Wohnimmobilien.

Unser Produkt — termios Pro — ist ein cloud-vernetztes Smart-Thermostat, das Wohnungsbaugesellschaften hilft, verifizierbaren CO₂- und Energieverbrauch in ihrem Bestand zu senken.

Warum wir diese Stelle besetzen 

Unser Algorithmik-Team hat Daten aus zigtausend verbauten Thermostaten und kann aus Theorie und Daten Verfahren entwickeln, auswerten und ausrollen. Hier arbeitest du mit – mit deinem Hintergrund entwickelst du Verfahren mit und beurteilst, ob eine Idee der Begegnung mit realer Gebäudehydraulik, verschiedenen Wärmeerzeugern (Fernwärme-Übergabestation, WP etc.) und den unterschiedlichen Regelungssystemen im Feld standhält.

Aufgaben

- Hydraulik und Anlagentypen bewerten: Egal ob Einrohr- und Zweirohrsysteme, Fernwärme (inkl. Rücklauftemperaturbegrenzung und Netzanforderungen), Anlagen mit Strangregulier- und Differenzdruckregelventile sowie Voreinstellungen und kv-Werte - Du kennst Dich mit der Hydraulik unterschiedlicher Anlagentypen aus und kannst beurteilen, welche Anforderungen sich daraus für unsere Verfahren ergeben.

- Machbarkeit beurteilen: Du bewertest algorithmische und methodische Ideen daraufhin, ob sie anlagentechnisch tragfähig sind — und sagst früh, wenn eine Annahme an der Realität vorbeigeht.

- Feldtests konzipieren und durchführen: Du baust Testszenarien in realen Gebäuden auf, steuerst sie, misst und bewertest die Ergebnisse.

- Messdaten lesen und auswerten: Wir erfassen zwar viele Messwerte, manches ist aber nicht direkt abzulesen - am Heizkörper gibt es in der Regel weder Volumenstrommessung noch Rücklauffühler. Du weißt, auf welche physikalischen Zusammenhänge es ankommt und kannst die vorhandenen Messwerte dahingehend richtig lesen und interpretieren.

- Verfahren formalisieren: Du unterstützt uns, physikalische Zusammenhänge und Berechnungsvorschriften in eine implementierbare Form zu bringen. — mit definierten Eingangsgrößen, Randbedingungen, Gültigkeitsbereichen und einer fehlenden oder unplausiblen Werten passieren soll.

- Fachliche Referenz sein: intern für Entwicklung und Produkt, bei Bedarf auch im Austausch mit Wohnungswirtschaft, Fachplanung und Handwerk.

Qualifikation

- Entweder ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Versorgungstechnik, Technischer Gebäudeausrüstung, Gebäude- und Energietechnik, Maschinenbau oder Verfahrenstechnik,

oder — alternativ – Techniker- oder Meisterqualifikation mit entsprechender Praxis.

- Nachgewiesene Praxis an Heizungsanlagen im Bestand: Planung, Inbetriebnahme, Optimierung oder Betriebsführung. Du hast hydraulischen Abgleich, Heizkurveneinstellung und Störungssuche selbst gemacht, nicht nur darüber gelesen.

- Erfahrung mit Algorithmen- und Logikentwicklung: Du hast schon einmal eine Berechnungs- oder Regelvorschrift so aufgeschrieben, so dass jemand anderes sie umsetzen konnte — als Auslegungsrechnung, Simulationsmodell, Excel-Werkzeug oder Regelstrategie.

- Erfahrung mit Messtechnik und Inbetriebnahme — Du weißt, wie man eine Messung so ansetzt, dass sie am Ende sinnvolle Werte liefern kann.

- Bereitschaft, datengetrieben zu arbeiten: die Gewohnheit, eine Vermutung über ein Gebäude in eine auswertbare Fragestellung zu übersetzen. Vorerfahrung ist ein Plus, die Bereitschaft ist die Anforderung.

- Bereitschaft, auch vor Ort unterwegs zu sein — die Rolle lebt vom Wechsel zwischen Heizungskeller und Schreibtisch.

- Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch auf Arbeitsniveau (Teamsprache).

Was Du nicht brauchst 

Du musst nicht programmieren können. Keine Machine-Learning-Erfahrung, keine IoT-Vorkenntnisse, keine Embedded-Kenntnisse. Diese Kompetenzen sind im Team.

Wenn Du Dich in der Anlagentechnik zu Hause fühlst und bereit bist, Dich in Daten einzuarbeiten, bist Du richtig.

Benefits

- Echten Einfluss darauf, was gebaut wird. Wir entwickeln ein neus Produkt und Du kannst es direkt mitgestalten.

- Alles unter einem Dach: Hardware, Firmware, Funk, Cloud und Daten. Wer das gebaut hat, wonach Du fragst, sitzt im selben Team.

- Ein Messdatenbestand aus tausenden Wohnungen — die Möglichkeit, Fragen zu beantworten, die sich an einem einzelnen Gebäude nicht beantworten lassen.

- Feldzugang als Teil der Rolle, nicht als Ausnahme. Wenn Du eine Idee an einem realen Strang prüfen willst, organisieren wir das.

- Unbefristete Festanstellung mit wettbewerbsfähiger Vergütung, 30 Tage Urlaub, dank der Joint-Venture Partner mehr Team-Events und Parties als üblich

title: Finance Process & Systems Lead
description:
Finance Process & Systems Lead

Our mission for you

Build the systems and process backbone of the Finance function in one of the most complex industries – and shape how Finance can be run differently.

trawa is transforming how mid-sized companies access green, intelligent energy. That means building in a market shaped by decades-old logic, extensive regulation, and highly complex data structures: 15-minute time series, PPAs, spot, futures, and direct marketing. All of this needs to flow into Finance in a way that is accurate, efficient, and scalable.

We're looking for a Finance Process & Systems Lead to take real ownership of how Finance operates, scales, and automates at trawa. This is a blue-sky role: you'll design our system landscape, redesign core processes end to end, lead the Finance side of our ERP rollout, and turn AI and automation from side experiments into core infrastructure.

You'll work closely with the Finance team across all functions, as well as Business Operations, Tech, Data, and other key stakeholders, to build the foundations that allow Finance to scale with the business.

What you'll own

Finance systems and IT transformation

- Own trawa's Finance technology stack end to end – from today's fragmented landscape to a fully integrated stack built around a modern cloud ERP.

- Lead the broader Finance IT transformation, including architecture, vendor selection, integrations, and the roadmap for our ERP, billing system, and future Finance tools.

- Drive requirements, implementation, and go-live from the systems side. For accounting-heavy topics, you'll work closely with the Accounting Lead, who brings the required technical depth.

Process redesign, automation, and AI

Your biggest lever in the first 12 months will be to structurally redesign Quote-to-Cash for our energy business.

- Redesign our core Finance processes end to end – including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report – with scalability, controls by design, and automation built in from the start.

- Own the automation roadmap: define what gets automated, in which order, and with what expected return on investment.

- Drive month-end close automation and establish time to close as a measurable performance indicator.

- Turn AI and workflow automation into reliable Finance infrastructure rather than isolated experiments.

Data and the Finance–Tech bridge

- Own Finance master data and the Finance layer of our data warehouse, from source systems and governance through to reporting-ready tables.

- Translate energy-specific data – including time series, accruals, and portfolio pricing – into Finance-grade structures together with Tech, Data, and Business Operations.

- Establish the data models, governance, and quality standards that enable reliable reporting and scalable Finance processes.

Your first 90 days

- Month 1 – Understand and map: Get deep into our business model, the energy market, and our Finance systems and process landscape. Meet key stakeholders across Finance, Business Operations, Tech, and Data. Map Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report end to end, and identify the most critical system and data pain points.

- Month 2 – Take first ownership: Own the automation roadmap and deliver one meaningful automation or process improvement. Take ownership of Finance master data governance and begin scoping the strategic IT landscape and Finance transformation.

- Month 3 – Own the roadmap: Own the Finance systems, process, and automation roadmap end to end. Present a concrete direction and rollout plan for the IT transformation. Define the target data model together with the relevant cross-functional stakeholders.

Who you are

Must-haves

- 6+ years of experience in Finance Systems, Finance Processes, or FinOps in a fast-growing scale-up. You've built and improved systems and processes – not just operated them.

- A proven track record of redesigning Quote-to-Cash in a complex environment with multiple product logics, numerous data sources, high volumes, and regulatory complexity. You also have a solid understanding of Procure-to-Pay and Record-to-Report.

- Hands-on ERP implementation experience with a modern cloud ERP. You've personally owned requirements, process design, data migration, cutover, or hypercare.

- Technical fluency to build, not just specify: You use SQL and Python in live workflows and are comfortable working with REST APIs, webhooks, and direct data access rather than relying only on standard reports.

- An AI-first mindset with a track record: You've redesigned real processes using AI agents and workflow automation and have hands-on experience with tools such as Claude Code, n8n, or comparable solutions.

- Experience designing master data and data warehouse structures: You've established Finance data models, governance, and quality rules and worked with Tech or BI to build a commercially usable data warehouse layer, from source systems through to reporting-ready tables.

- An ownership mindset and business-fluent English.

Nice-to-haves

- Experience in the energy market, utilities, or trading. This will noticeably reduce your time to value.

- An accounting qualification or background, such as CPA, ACCA, Bilanzbuchhalter:in, or Wirtschaftsprüfer:in.

- German language skills.

Don't worry if you don't match every box. We value ownership, build instinct, and learning speed over perfect CVs. 

What we offer

- Blue-sky design authority: Work in one of Europe's most complex energy markets, with the opportunity to design Finance infrastructure from the ground up rather than maintain a legacy stack or legacy processes.

- A role that grows with the company: trawa is scaling fast, and our Finance organisation is scaling with it. This role comes with genuine headroom: as the function grows around you, so do your scope, your team, and your seniority.

- The opportunity to lead the Finance side of our ERP rollout: a milestone that will shape the company for the next decade.

- The chance to build a truly AI-first Finance stack. 

- Direct contact with our founders and senior leadership. 

- A uniquely complex business model at the intersection of energy, technology, and finance.

- Flexible working, 30 vacation days, an L&D budget, competitive compensation, VSOPs (share package), meal vouchers, an Urban Sports membership, and a vibrant Berlin office culture.

title: Head of Revenue Operations
description:
Head of Revenue Operations 

Deine Mission

Die Energiekosten in Europa sind doppelt so hoch wie in den USA und China. Gleichzeitig wird sich die Stromnachfrage bis 2050 voraussichtlich verdoppeln. Marktpreisvolatilität und zunehmende Komplexität werden uns erhalten bleiben. Damit steht das Rückgrat der europäischen Industrie unter Druck – und Unternehmen müssen jetzt handeln.

trawa entwickelt die Lösung: die erste integrierte B2B-Energieplattform, die Energiebeschaffung, Energiemanagement und die Steuerung von Flexibilitäten in einem Produkt vereint. Supply, Manage, Flex – kombiniert. Diese Integration ermöglicht Einsparungen von bis zu 30 % bei den wiederkehrenden Stromkosten und unterstützt Unternehmen gleichzeitig dabei, auf erneuerbare Energien umzusteigen.

Wir sind Europas am schnellsten wachsende B2B-Energieplattform. Aktuell sind wir in Deutschland und Österreich aktiv und planen, unsere Aktivitäten 2027 auf einen dritten Markt auszuweiten. Unser Ziel ist die europaweite Skalierung. Wir bewegen uns schnell – das Marktfenster ist offen, und wir wollen es nutzen.

Über trawa

trawa ist ein Scale-up mit Sitz in Berlin und rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, davon etwa 30 in Product & Tech. Bis heute haben wir mehr als 35 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, darunter eine Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde über 24 Millionen Euro im Mai 2025. Zu unseren Investoren zählen Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic und Tiny VC. Alle drei Gründer sind weiterhin aktiv dabei und zu 100 % committed, das Energieversorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft aufzubauen.

Wir suchen eine:n Head of Revenue Operations , um gemeinsam die nächste Wachstumsstufe zu erreichen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren General Manager Energy Solutions und arbeitest eng mit unseren Commercial-Teams zusammen. Du gestaltest das Produkt mit, das die europäische Industrie wieder wettbewerbsfähiger macht – und setzt deine Ideen mit hohem Tempo um.

Die Position ist in Berlin angesiedelt. trawa ist ein Office-First-Unternehmen : In der Regel arbeitest du an fünf Tagen pro Woche aus unserem Büro.

Das Team

Unser Revenue Operations Team ist ein zentraler Wachstumstreiber für den kommerziellen Erfolg von trawa. Es verbindet verschiedene Teams, schafft effiziente Prozesse und befähigt unseren Vertrieb, sein volles Potenzial zu entfalten. Dadurch entsteht ein dynamisches Umfeld, das nachhaltiges Wachstum ermöglicht. Nach einer Phase starken Wachstums gilt es nun, das Team gezielt für die nächste Wachstumsphase aufzustellen – sowohl für die weitere Skalierung in unserem Heimatmarkt Deutschland als auch für die Expansion in weitere Märkte.

Wen wir suchen

- Revenue Engine: Du übernimmst die weltweite Verantwortung für den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Revenue Operations Aktivitäten, durch die aus Leads verlässlich planbarer Umsatz entsteht

- CRM: Du definierst die CRM-Architektur inkl. Datenmodell und Funnel Design, stellst systematisch die Datenqualität sicher, verantwortest Prozessdefinition und Governance sowie die Prozessautomatisierung

- Tooling: Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis der Sales Journey unserer Kunden und entwickelst sowohl customer-facing sowie internes Tooling, um die Effizienz und Conversion Rates unserer Revenue-Organisation strukturell zu steigern

- Reporting & Analytics: Du ermöglichst ein zielgerichtetes Steering unserer Account Executive und Sales Development Teams durch Reporting & Dashboarding und deckst durch Analysen Optimierungspotenziale im Rahmen von Strategiediskussionen auf

- CPQ: Du übernimmst die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für Angebotserstellung, Contracting und Commissioning, in dem du unsere Prozesse, Tools und Strukturen stetig weiterentwickelst und dabei auch eng mit unserem Tech Team zusammenarbeitest

Deine Ziele in den ersten 90 Tagen

- Du hast das notwendige Verständnis zu unseren Produkten, zum Energiemarkt, zur Sales Journey unserer Kunden sowie zu relevanten internen Prozessen aufgebaut

- Du hast dich als fester Ansprechpartner des Revenue Operations Teams etabliert - und bist im stetigen Austausch mit allen wichtigen internen und externen Stakeholdern

- Du hast eine Strategie für Revenue Operations bei trawa entwickelt, klare Prioritäten gesetzt und eine Roadmap mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten und Meilensteinen aufgesetzt, die unser weiteres Wachstum in Deutschland und die Expansion unterstützt

- Du hast dabei insbesondere erste Optimierungsprojekte zur Steigerung der Conversion Rates sowie zur internen Prozessoptimierung angestoßen - und erste Ergebnisse sind in Sicht

Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft

- Du gehst Aufgaben mit Eigeninitiative und klarer Zielorientierung an

- Du denkst analytisch und strukturiert: Komplexe Prozesse zerlegst du gerne in einzelne Schritte, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen und Metriken

- Du berücksichtigst bei deiner Entscheidungsfindung sowohl strategische Ziele wie kommerzielle Auswirkungen und kannst dich sowohl in die Perspektive von Kunden als auch von unserem Vertrieb hineinversetzen

- Durch offene und wertschätzende Kommunikation, konstruktives Feedback und klare Prioritäten befähigst du dein Team, gemeinsam erfolgreich zu sein.

- Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss

Warum trawa?

Wirkung: Europäische KMU geben jährlich zwischen 150.000 und 10 Millionen Euro für Strom aus – viele davon zahlen zu viel und sind an veraltete Beschaffungsmodelle gebunden. Mit unserem Produkt veränderst du unmittelbar, wie Tausende Unternehmen Energie einkaufen, managen und nutzen. Die Wirkung ist messbar, der Markt ist riesig und der Zeitpunkt ist jetzt.

Verantwortung: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine Themen und treibst Ergebnisse voran – unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund oder deiner bisherigen Berufserfahrung.

Lernen und Entwicklung: Wir stellen dir ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget und feste Zeit für deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung zur Verfügung. Dich erwarten Mentoring, vielfältige Lernmöglichkeiten und echte Perspektiven für deinen nächsten Karriereschritt.

Vielfalt und Inklusion: Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit lebt, und unser Team spiegelt das wider. Menschen aus mehr als 15 Nationen bringen unterschiedliche Sprachen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven zusammen. Bei trawa ist Familienfreundlichkeit auf allen Ebenen selbstverständlich – in unserem Team und in der Führung arbeiten Eltern. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld ein, in dem alle ihr Bestes geben können.

Vergütung und Benefits: Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket mit Gehalt und Stock Options, 30 Urlaubstagen sowie zahlreichen Benefits. Dazu gehören Zuschüsse für Internet und Mittagessen, eine Mitgliedschaft im Sport Club, feste Lerntage mit jährlichem Weiterbildungsbudget, ein wöchentliches Team-Mittagessen und regelmäßige Teamevents.

Bei trawa bauen wir einen vielfältigen, inklusiven und authentischen Arbeitsplatz auf. Wenn dich die Position begeistert, dein bisheriger Weg aber nicht in allen Punkten dem Anforderungsprofil entspricht, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht bist du genau die richtige Person für diese oder eine andere Position bei uns.

description:
Hi! We are AMBOSS, and we're looking for someone to take the role of Engineering Compliance Manager and CSV & Process Validation Manager in our medical device team. 

About AMBOSS 

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering physicians globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Why can this position be exciting for you? 

At AMBOSS, we build tools that help doctors and students make critical decisions impacting the healthcare of billions of people worldwide. This position makes sure that our product is built, verified, and documented in a way that's compliant, trustworthy, and audit-ready. You'll work closely with engineering as an independent evaluator, setting the standard for what "done and compliant" means across our medical device software. Join a small, high-impact team ensuring our medical device software meets the regulatory standards needed to safely support healthcare professionals.

You will: 

As CSV & Process Validation Manager, prove our systems and processes work and produce reliable evidence. 

- Own the computer system validation and process validation processes for the AMBOSS medical device portfolio — procedures, templates and work instructions — keeping them aligned with MDR and ISO 13485 and updated based on audit findings and team feedback.

- Maintain the inventory of systems in scope and decide, risk-based, which need validation and to what depth; plan, execute and document that validation and keep systems in a validated state as they change.

- Concentrate validation effort where the evidence is produced — test management, defect tracking, build/release tooling and automated pipeline steps whose output can't be fully verified by inspection alone — confirming these systems and processes reliably produce trustworthy, intended results.

- Own the resulting evidence and represent it directly to auditors and regulators; raise, document and own validation deviations and the associated CAPAs through to resolution.

As Engineering Compliance Manager, ensure the medical device product itself is built compliantly, from a day-to-day engineering work perspective 

- Own compliant execution of the software lifecycle — requirements, design, implementation, verification, release — against IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1

- Define the compliance requirements and gates in our delivery pipeline against IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1 (traceability tagging, release criteria, automated checks) and partner with engineering to implement them.

- Operate the compliance gate in the release flow, keeping the trace intact from user requirement through verification to released evidence. Sign off each release as a required gate; no release ships without your approval.

- Ensure engineering-related Technical Documentation deliverables are compliant with regulatory and QMS requirements

- Onboard and train software engineers on compliance requirements and how to work within them day-to-day.

- Act as the point of contact for audits and technical reviews on engineering-related topics, representing the team's compliance posture to auditors and Notified Body reviewers.

- Drive resolution of audit findings and deficiencies affecting engineering.

- Assess the engineering impact of Design Changes before they are implemented.

- Identify and drive adoption of tooling the team is missing to work compliantly — both inside the QMS and on the engineering side.

You bring: 

- Knowledge of medical devices or another regulated industry (pharma, biotech, IVD). Experience in, or eagerness to learn, computer system validation and/or process validation, including risk-based scoping of validation effort, is a plus.

- Working knowledge of MDR, ISO 13485, IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1 as they apply to software.

- Familiarity with software engineering, and enough depth in our stack (React, Python, PHP, Go; AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, ArgoCD) to review pipelines, tests and release processes with engineers as a peer.

- Experience representing validation documentation and rationale to auditors and inspectors.

- Experience assessing the engineering/technical impact of Design Changes within a regulated development process.

- Excellent written and spoken English

You enjoy: 

- Working closely with engineers, Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs — able to challenge and be challenged on technical detail.

- Strong communication and training skills, with the ability to explain complex validation requirements to cross-functional stakeholders

- Structured, detail-oriented way of working, with the ability to balance regulatory rigor with practical, workable processes for development teams

Benefits 

AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized, and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health and work-life harmony.

Check out all of our employee benefits here: https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

- Begleitung ausgewählter Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung

Dabei lernst du nicht nur, wie gute Ideen entstehen , sondern auch, wie sie strategisch hergeleitet, überzeugend präsentiert und schließlich in ein reales Event übersetzt werden.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst 

Wir suchen weniger den perfekten Lebenslauf als jemanden mit echter Neugier und kreativem Potenzial.

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn du: 

- ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung im Bereich Design, Kommunikation, Medien, Marketing abgeschlossen oder vergleichbare Erfahrungen hast

- Ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung, Bildwelten und aktuelle Trends besitzt

- Gerne konzeptionell denkst und Spaß daran hast, Ideen weiterzuentwickeln

- Wenn Du kreative Werkzeuge wie die Programme der Adobe Creative Cloud, PowerPoint oder Canva nutzen kannst

- Interesse an neuen Technologien und KI-Tools mitbringst

- strukturiert arbeitest und auch bei mehreren Aufgaben den Überblick behältst

- offen bist, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und deine eigenen Ideen einzubringen

- sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse besitzt

Erste Erfahrungen in einer Agentur, im Eventbereich oder durch Praktika sind willkommen – aber kein Muss.

Benefits

Was uns wichtig ist 

Kreativität bedeutet für uns nicht nur, schöne Bilder zu gestalten.

Wir wollen verstehen, was Menschen bewegt, welche Geschichte ein Event erzählen kann und wie aus einer Botschaft ein Erlebnis wird. 

Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der Gestaltung und Konzeption zusammendenken möchte, Fragen stellt, Neues ausprobiert und Lust darauf hat, gemeinsam mit uns Ideen zu entwickeln, die nicht nur auf einer Präsentationsfolie funktionieren.

Was wir dir bieten 

- Direkten Einblick in die kreative Arbeit einer Event- und Live-Kommunikationsagentur

- Mitarbeit an großen Marken, Veranstaltungen und Pitches

- Enge Zusammenarbeit, die vor allem Spaß macht

- Viel Raum zum Lernen, Ausprobieren und Entwickeln

- Eigene Aufgaben und Verantwortung

- Einblicke in den gesamten Prozess von der Idee bis zum Live-Erlebnis

- Ein vielseitiges Arbeitsumfeld zwischen Strategie, Design, Kommunikation und Event

- Ein Team, das Ideen gemeinsam weiterentwickelt und Wissen teilt

Klingt nach dir? 

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und – wenn vorhanden – gerne ein Portfolio oder einige Arbeitsproben. Viel wichtiger als perfekte Projekte ist uns dabei, zu sehen, wie du denkst und was dich kreativ interessiert.

title: Test Engineer - Ground
description:
Who we are 

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 

The role 

Airworthiness is a system-level requirement. We cannot certify an aircraft if the launcher or the control link hasn’t been rigorously de-risked. This role professionalizes our Ground-Side Engineering, moving our failure rate from the expensive flight-test phase to the low-cost laboratory phase. It is an investment in crash prevention and regulatory compliance.

The day-to-day

· Pre-Flight De-risking: Executing high-repetition "burn-in" tests on all new firmware and hardware configurations for the Ground Control Station and data links .

· Launch System Validation: Engineering tests for mechanical launch systems to ensure repeatable, safe exit velocities and structural integrity .

· The "Iron Bird" Connection: Acting as the link to the IRB Team by maintaining a ground-based "Iron Bird" to test system-wide reactions to simulated component failures .

· Regression Library: Building a library of ground-side edge cases and failure cases that must be passed before any new sub-system is cleared for flight integration .

· Documentation of Proof: Generating technical "De-risking Reports" and managing relevant testing cards in JIRA .

You should apply if you 

· Infrastructure & GSE Mastery: Deep technical understanding of Ground Control Stations (GCS), pneumatic/mechanical launchers, tracking antenna arrays, and ruggedized power and control systems.

· Interface & Protocol Testing: Ability to sniff and analyse communication protocols between ground and air (IRONBIRD) to de-risk command-and-control latency and packet loss.

· HIL/SIL Setup: Experience building and maintaining Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) environments to simulate flight triggers on the bench.

· Environmental & Stress Testing: Competence in vibration, thermal, and EMI (Electromagnetic Interference) "torture tests" on supporting hardware to ensure field survivability.

· Diagnostic Tooling: Skilled in the use of oscilloscopes, spectrum analysers, and network protocol analysers to perform root-cause analysis on ground-side hardware failures.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 

Nice to Have 

· Bachelor's degree (B.Sc. or B.Eng.) in a relevant engineering discipline.

· Prior exposure to defense, dual-use, or regulated hardware in a test context is strongly preferred.

· Experience in an aerospace or defense environment operating under ITAR/EAR or equivalent national defense export control frameworks is an advantage.

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 

- 
Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns 

- 
The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world 

- 
Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward 

- 
In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts 

- 
We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about 

What we offer 

- 
Competitive salary and VSOP options 

- 
Relocation support : up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation

- 
Learning : €500/£450 yearly allowance

- 
Health & wellness : gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)

- 
Social : regular company events and monthly social allowances

- 
Enhanced parental leave : 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers

- 
Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work

- 
A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one 

Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation. 

Helsing's Candidate Privacy and Confidentiality Regime can be found here .

title: Test Engineer - Environment
description:
Who we are 

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 

The role 

As an Environment Test Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, execution, and analysis of environmental stress test campaigns across the full range of drone sub-systems and Ground Support Equipment (GSE). As a generalist within the Environmental Cluster, you will apply your knowledge to mechanical, thermal, and environmental qualification—across multiple hardware domains. The Environmental Cluster is the "Physical Reality" team within the Test Department. Where other clusters validate functionality, the Environmental Cluster validates survivability and performance under real-world stress.

The cluster is organized around domain specialists—Launch Systems, Ground Communication Systems—but requires a generalist backbone to ensure test coverage continuity across all sub-systems, absorb campaign overflows from specialist engineers, and extend the cluster's capability into emerging and sensitive hardware domains.

The day-to-day

- Vibration & Shock Campaigns: Designing and executing vibration test campaigns (sine sweep, random vibration, shock) on drone sub-systems and GSE hardware to simulate transport, operational, and launch-induced dynamic environments.

- Thermal Soak & Cycling: Executing controlled thermal exposure tests across the full operational temperature range on any sub-system assigned by the Head of Testing or cluster lead.

- IP & Ingress Testing: Executing dust and water ingress tests on drone enclosures, connectors, and GSE hardware to validate field survivability.

- Humidity, Salt Spray & Corrosion: Running humidity-controlled and salt-spray campaigns to identify corrosion risks in connectors, structural joints, and electronic housings.

- Altitude Simulation: Validating component behaviour under simulated low-pressure conditions relevant to the operational altitude range of the drone.

- Fatigue & Endurance: Running high-cycle mechanical campaigns to characterize material and joint fatigue over the required operational life of any assigned sub-system.

- Failure Mode Boundary Testing: Deliberately pushing hardware beyond its design limits to physically map the failure envelope and validate safety margins across all assigned sub-systems.

You should apply if you 

- Environmental Standards Literacy: Working knowledge of applicable standards as the primary frameworks for environmental test campaign design and execution.

- Instrumentation & DAQ: Expert in physical instrumentation—strain gauges, accelerometers, thermocouples, pressure transducers, and load cells. Ability to configure and operate DAQ systems across a wide range of test scenarios.

- Mechanical Systems Understanding: Solid understanding of structural mechanics, material fatigue, vibration dynamics, and shock response for both metallic and composite structures.

- Thermal Testing: Experience with thermal chambers, thermal cycling rigs, IR cameras, and thermocouple mapping.

- Environmental Test Equipment Operation: Hands-on experience operating vibration tables, shock rigs, thermal chambers, IP spray equipment, and salt-spray cabinets.

- Metrology: Proficient with precision measurement tools (load frames, calipers, torque meters, dimensional gauges) for pre- and post-test validation.

- Basic Familiarity with Weapons Hardware Constraints: Understanding of the physical and regulatory constraints that govern the environmental testing of defense-related hardware. Specifically:

- Awareness of ITAR/EAR export control obligations when handling test data and reports related to lethality hardware.

Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. - Demonstrated track record of exceeding retention, adoption, and expansion outcomes; experience recognized with performance distinction is a plus.

- Elevates teammates through knowledge sharing and informal mentorship.

Drive Adoption & Value Realization

As Vanta continues to grow, winning in the International markets will be critical. We’re just starting to establish our EMEA presence, and we need talented and customer focused Account Executives who are excited to help build and grow a large and untapped UK&I markets as we continue to distinguish Vanta as best-in-class to prospects in a burgeoning competitive landscape.

What you’ll do as an Account Executive at Vanta: 

- Own your pipeline from the ground up — identify, research, and prioritize high-potential accounts and verticals, building a consistent outbound motion to create new opportunities.

- Run a world-class sales process — qualify deeply, forecast accurately, and progress deals using MEDDPICC or a similar structured methodology to drive predictable outcomes.

- Convert interest into long-term value — educate prospects on the business impact of Vanta, deliver compelling demos, and tailor solution recommendations to each customer’s goals.

- Communicate with executive presence — engage confidently with founders, CEOs, and technical leaders, translating complex compliance and security concepts into clear business value.

- Continuously sharpen your craft — act on feedback, seek coaching, and contribute to improving team playbooks, messaging, and outbound best practices.

- Be a self-starter who makes things happen — operate with urgency, ownership, and autonomy in a fast-moving environment where results matter.

- Champion market expansion — explore partnership opportunities, represent Vanta at industry events, and help us deepen our presence in new and existing markets.

- Cross-Functional — working alongside our SDR team, marketing team, legal and Solutions Engineers to find, run and win deals.

How to be successful in this role: 

- 3+ years closing experience

- Have had a closing and quota-carrying role in the past, while consistently exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets

- Be experienced in B2B SaaS, preferably in SMB and Mid-Market

- Be highly curious, seeking to understand customers, their needs and how best Vanta can help them

- Possess the technical competency to understand Vanta’s software and build great relationships with highly technical prospects

- Have stellar problem-solving skills, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up

- Have entrepreneurial spirit, initiative and autonomy so you can make a huge contribution to the EMEA landing team

- Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n: 

- Industry-competitive salary and equity

- 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

- 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

- Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

- Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

- Pension matching

- 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

- 8 company-paid holidays

In your first six to twelve months, you will help sharpen how Trainline Media presents itself to the market, focus the team on the right priorities and put in place the operational foundations needed to grow, balancing commercial growth with operational effectiveness.

In this role as the General Manager, Trainline Media, you will...🚄 

- Set the direction for Trainline Media, shaping its proposition, target market and growth priorities so it becomes a trusted travel media offering.

- Take ownership of Trainline Media's revenue targets, working with senior stakeholders to align its goals with wider business priorities.

- Partner with colleagues across Product, Data, PR and Marketing to develop the proposition and bring it to market.

- Represent Trainline Media externally, building awareness and credibility with the media and advertising buying community through an active industry presence.

- Lead and grow a team of more than ten people across sales, advertising operations, client success and strategy, creating a culture where people want to join and develop.

- Design the operating model, processes and measures needed to scale the business, including client delivery and billing, using data and AI tools to help the team work smarter.

- Balance commercial growth with operational effectiveness, so the function delivers sustainably as it grows.

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍 

- Experience building and scaling a media or advertising function, ideally within a larger, operationally focused consumer technology business.

- A solid understanding of brand media, with the ability to position and grow an emerging proposition. Experience across performance media is also helpful if you have it.

- Experience leading and growing large teams, and creating an environment where people can do their best work.

- Experience owning revenue targets and designing the processes, operating rhythms and measures that support sustainable, scalable growth.

- Sound judgement in balancing competing priorities, working constructively in a business where advertising is one of several revenue streams, and turning ambiguity into clear priorities and practical action.

- A collaborative, diplomatic leadership style, with the ability to build trust and influence senior stakeholders.

- Curiosity about how data and AI tools can improve the way a team works, and ideally some experience putting them to use.

- An active presence in the media industry, or a keen interest in building one, and the confidence to represent the business externally.

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one!

Our Workplace Technology team owns and manages the corporate technology stack of business and workplace solutions, driving innovative, cost efficient, future ways of working.

The Tech Support team is a critical part of the Workplace Technology team, ensuring Tier 2 and Tier 3 support services are delivered effectively and efficiently within a culture of continual service improvement, aligned to Trainline values.

The team is principally responsible for end user computing across a MacOS estate under central management using JAMF Pro, and a Microsoft Windows estate integrated with Azure Active Directory and Microsoft Windows Servers. This is a highly visible team, also providing dedicated AV/VC support for meeting rooms and internal events — ensuring high availability, instilling trust, and enabling a seamless experience for Executive-level presenters.

About the Role 

This is not just a senior technical position — it is a leadership role within the team. We are looking for someone who takes genuine ownership: of problems, of standards, of team capability, and of the overall service we deliver to Trainliners. You will be the go-to person when things get complex, the one who sets the bar for quality, and the one who actively lifts others to reach it.

You will work closely with the Workplace Technology Lead, acting as a technical anchor for the team — driving consistency, mentoring your peers, championing best practices, and making sure nothing important falls through the cracks. If you see something that isn't right, you fix it. If a junior engineer is stuck, you help them through it. If a process is broken, you own improving it.

As a Senior IT Support Analyst, you'll be responsible for... 🚝 

Technical Leadership & Team Ownership 

• Acting as the technical escalation point for the team — owning complex incidents end-to-end and ensuring nothing stalls without clear direction

• Mentoring and upskilling junior and mid-level engineers: pairing on problems, reviewing their work, and sharing knowledge deliberately and consistently

• Setting and maintaining quality standards for ticket management, documentation, and technical investigations across the team

• Driving team readiness — identifying skill gaps, flagging them to the Lead, and taking initiative to close them through coaching or knowledge sessions

• Leading by example in attitude, thoroughness, communication, and follow-through — shaping the team culture through daily behaviour

• Supporting the Workplace Technology Lead with operational decisions, workload balancing, and service improvements

Incident, Problem & Request Management 

• Owning the full incident lifecycle for complex and high-priority issues — from triage and investigation through to resolution and post-incident review

• Conducting deep root cause analysis: reviewing logs, correlating cross-system patterns, engaging third-party vendors, and documenting findings clearly

• Ensuring the team's ticket queue is healthy — proactively monitoring dashboards, reassigning where needed, and preventing SLA breaches before they happen

• Driving problem management: identifying recurring incidents, initiating investigations, and leading permanent fix efforts rather than accepting repeat workarounds

• Owning escalation quality — ensuring issues are fully investigated, clearly documented, and appropriately packaged before being escalated to Tier 3 or vendors

Microsoft 365, Azure AD & Identity Management 

• Advanced administration of Microsoft 365 services: Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, and the M365 Security & Compliance Centre

• Azure Active Directory: user and group lifecycle, Conditional Access policy design and troubleshooting, SSPR, MFA enforcement, and RBAC

• Leading SSO/SAML integrations for new SaaS platforms — configuring, testing, and documenting alongside the security team

• Owning access package governance and token management processes, ensuring alignment with policy and audit requirements

• Supporting licence governance: E3/E5 procurement, assignment, cost awareness, and flagging any out-of-policy requests to the appropriate stakeholder

AV/VC & Events Support 

• Taking ownership of the AV/VC estate — maintaining full health of meeting room systems including display hardware, conferencing codecs, room controllers, and peripherals

• Proactive health monitoring using remote administration tools, with performance analytics and regular firmware/software updates

• Leading in-person and remote technical delivery for internal events and Executive/all-hands presentations

• Acting as the senior point of contact for AV issues, ensuring fast resolution and minimal meeting disruption across all sites

• Documenting AV configurations and building runbooks that enable the wider team to support the estate confidently

End User Computing & Device Management 

• Advanced MacOS and Windows 11 management via JAMF Pro and Microsoft Intune/Autopilot — including policy authoring, troubleshooting complex deployment failures, and estate-wide configuration management

• Overseeing the quality of on/off-boarding processes: laptop builds, IT inductions, IAM compliance, deprovisioning, and asset retrieval

• Driving IT Asset Management maturity: inventory accuracy, lifecycle planning, hardware refresh adherence, and secure disposal compliance

• Working knowledge of Android and Linux environments; able to support edge cases confidently

Security, Compliance & Governance 

• Championing security standards across the team — ensuring all activity aligns with ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, and internal policy

• Leading the team's contribution to audit and compliance reviews: ensuring evidence is well-organised, processes are followed, and findings are acted on

• Owning the leavers process for sensitive cases — coordinating deprovisioning, data access controls, and asset recovery in line with CISO and privacy requirements

• Supporting MFA rollout, access policy governance, and SSO governance initiatives with appropriate rigour and documentation

• Ensuring all advice given to the team is backed by security sign-off and documented reference — not informal Slack approvals

Documentation, Process & Continuous Improvement 

• Owning and continuously improving the team's knowledge base — SOPs, runbooks, known error records, and onboarding guides must be accurate, accessible, and up to date

• Identifying process inefficiencies and owning their improvement: not just flagging them but designing, implementing, and embedding the fix

• Driving automation and tooling improvements — proposing and where possible implementing AI, ML, and scripting solutions that reduce toil and improve consistency

• Ensuring approvals, decisions, and audit trails live in the ticketing system — not in Slack channels

• Windows 11 and Apple ecosystem in an enterprise environment (+ working knowledge of Android & Linux)

• Mobile Device Management: JAMF Pro and Microsoft Intune — policy creation, complex troubleshooting, and deployment strategy

• Microsoft 365 administration — Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and M365 Security & Compliance Centre

• Azure Active Directory — user lifecycle, Conditional Access, SSPR, MFA, and RBAC at an administrative level

• Modern workplace solutions: Autopilot, Intune, MFA, and cloud migration strategies

We're hiring a permanent Senior Backend Engineer to join our Asset Sales group as we scale one of the most important parts of M-KOPA's FinTech platform. Build distributed, event-driven microservices and help shape what AI-native engineering looks like at M-KOPA.

Your code will directly power the systems that put smartphones and e-motorbikes into the hands of Every Day Earners across Africa. 🎯 Mission-driven engineering : Every service you build helps expand financial inclusion for under-banked populations

🏆 Global recognition : Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest-growing companies for five consecutive years (2022–2026)

🚀 Scale challenges : Build backend systems serving millions across multiple African markets

🤖 AI-native from day one : We're actively embracing AI as part of the engineering craft, not bolting it on

🌍 Fully distributed : Work remotely with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

What You'll Do 

At M-KOPA, you'll build and operate distributed C# and .NET microservices on Azure, working within an event-driven architecture at significant scale. This is an outcomes-driven role: we care far more about the value you create than where you sit or how many hours you're online. You'll own what you build end-to-end — from idea, through implementation and deployment, into production and iteration.

Technical Environment 💻 

- Modern C# stack : Distributed C# and .NET microservices

- Cloud & orchestration : Hosted on Azure using Kubernetes

- Architecture : Event-driven, supporting products used at significant scale

- Observability : Grafana, Azure Application Insights, logs, traces, and metrics

- AI tooling : Claude and other AI tools used throughout the engineering workflow — design exploration, code generation and review, test writing, incident investigation, and technical communication

Our Engineering Approach 🚀 

- AI-native engineering : We want engineers who tinker — experimenting with new tools, agents, and workflows, and sharing what works

- Guardrails as we accelerate : Automated tests, SLOs, alerting, observability, and deployment safeguards around everything we ship

- Own it beyond the pull request : Design for idempotency, retries, out-of-order events, and failure modes, and know how your services behave in production

- The Campfire Rule : Leave the systems you touch a little better than you found them

- On-call as feedback, not heroics : Engineers who build our systems also help operate them, using incidents to make the platform more resilient

What You Need 

We're looking for a senior engineer who's curious, autonomous, and highly trusted. You're comfortable owning the entire software stack — including supporting infrastructure — throughout its lifecycle, and you see production data, not just deployment, as the real measure of "done."

Required Experience: 

- Strong grasp of C# and .NET development

- Experience with event-driven systems - We use Azure Service Bus, but would love to hear from you if you have experience with similar messaging technology (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)

- Microservices architecture experience, ideally on Azure and Kubernetes

- Experience using observability tooling (e.g. Grafana, Application Insights) to understand production behaviour

- Comfort using AI tools as part of a daily engineering workflow (design, code review, testing, incident investigation)

- DevOps culture mindset, including on-call/production ownership

- Proven ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams across time zones

- Continuous learning mindset and openness to feedback

Location & Benefits 

- Fully remote role, collaborating during core GMT working hours

- Work with diverse teams distributed across UK, Europe, and Africa

- Personalised training budget to support your development

- Home office setup budget

- Professional development programs and coaching partnerships

- Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

- Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍 

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚 

Our technology has created measurable change:

- Connected 📱 : 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected

- Prosperous 💰 : 70% of customers use M-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000 livelihoods created for agents

- Green 🌱 : 2.155 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided since 2010 through clean energy, refurbished devices, and e-mobility

Ready to build C#/.NET systems — with AI as part of your craft — that create real-world financial inclusion? Apply Now!

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com .

title: Staff Product Engineer
description:
About Parloa 

Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com , HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role: 

As a Staff Product Engineer , you will work directly inside our most strategic enterprise customers. You will build the software that makes their AI agents work in production, and be measured by the difference it makes for the customer.

Our agents are built by business users in Parloa’s platform, AMP. AMP already comes with a broad library of tools and integrations. Your job is the part AMP does not cover yet for a given customer: the last connection into their systems, or a capability the product does not have. Our customers are large enterprises in financial services, telecom, insurance, travel and retail. For them, a working prototype is where an engagement starts, not where it ends.

The work comes in two forms. Some engagements run for years. You stay with the account, deepen its integrations and help it grow into new use cases. Others are short experiments. You test a new idea with a real customer and decide quickly whether it is worth building. At Staff level, you take on the hardest cases of both: accounts where a pilot-grade solution would fail in production, and capabilities nobody at Parloa has built before. Staff means harder problems and more ambiguity, not less hands-on work.

On many accounts, you work alongside a Deployment Strategist. Think of the two of you as the account’s leadership team. The Deployment Strategist acts as its CPO and defines what success looks like. You act as its CTO and own the architecture and the build. On accounts without a Deployment Strategist, you own the engineering yourself.

Areas of ownership: 

- Lead the hardest engagements. Run complex programmes with several workstreams. Make the architecture decisions that span Parloa’s platform and several parts of the customer’s organization.

- Build what AMP does not cover yet. Systems of record, telephony and contact-center integrations, state management, data readiness, multi-agent orchestration and retrieval. When the answer is unclear, build a prototype quickly and decide whether it is worth pursuing before Parloa invests a full quarter in it.

- Own production quality and security. Evals, production readiness, observability and incident playbooks for enterprise-scale traffic. Meet the data handling standards a regulated customer expects, including PII, access control and audit trails. Debug live issues, whether they are technical or caused by model behaviour.

- Grow the account, and share what belongs in the product. Drive the second use case, the second business unit, the renewal. Set the delivery standard for other engineers on complex accounts. When something you build would help every customer, flag it. That is how Parloa decides what goes into the core product.

- Mentor other Product Engineers , and take part in interviewing and hiring.

- Use AI well, and set the standard for it. Decide how AI-assisted work is validated before it reaches a customer’s production traffic.

- Represent Parloa with senior technical stakeholders. Work directly with the customer’s principal engineers, architects and security leaders. Be the engineer commercial teams bring in when a prospect asks how the solution would work for them.

What this role is not: 

- Not running the Parloa platform itself. That is a separate engineering role. The platform is your foundation, and you build what a specific customer needs on top of it.

- Not agent configuration. Business users design and configure agents in AMP. You build the integrations and capabilities those agents need.

- Not a people-management role. You are an individual contributor and write and review code every week.

OUR TECH STACK: 

Go, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, FastAPI, frontier LLMs, MCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka/NATS

You will not use all of these, and most engagements add something new.

Who you are: 

- 8+ years of professional software development , delivering production systems end to end. Fluent in TypeScript or Python, or able to get there quickly.

- 5+ years leading the design and architecture of large-scale production systems in customer-facing or enterprise environments, with a focus on reliability, scale and failure modes.

- Experience leading agentic, spec-driven development in production. You know when a coding agent’s output is wrong and what checks it needs before it ships.

- A track record in long-term accounts or fast experiments. You have owned a strategic enterprise relationship over several years, through an expansion, a renewal or a leadership change. Or you have tested new ideas at the frontier and decided quickly whether they were worth building.

- Experience as a mentor or tech lead , helping engineers become independent.

- Comfortable with ambiguity and with customers. You work well in complex organizations, build trust quickly with new customer teams, spot risks early and keep your judgment when the stakes are high.

- Willingness to travel up to 25% to customer sites, depending on the engagement.

- Strong spoken and written communication skills in English.

Nice to have: 

- Experience building or deploying an LLM-powered system used by real users in production

- Hands-on experience with eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG, prompt engineering or multi-agent orchestration (few candidates will have all of these)

- A founder or founding-engineer background

- Forward-deployed, solutions engineering, product engineering or strategic-partner experience at an enterprise software or AI company

- Voice or conversational AI, or contact center, telephony or CCaaS integration

- Experience in regulated industries such as banking, insurance or telecom

Our engineering values: 

At Parloa, we hire, promote, and evaluate based on cultural and technical excellence. You’ll thrive here if you:

- Earn Trust – act with transparency and reliability.

- Obsess Over Customers – always start with the customer problem.

- Think Big – set bold goals and pursue them fearlessly.

- Have Integrity – do the right thing, especially when it’s hard.

- Disagree & Commit – debate with candor, align fast, and deliver.

- Own It – take full responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.

- Dive Deep – master the details without losing sight of the big picture.

- Bias for Action – move fast, decide quickly, iterate fearlessly.

- Deliver Value – measure success by customer and business impact.

- Insist on the Highest Standards – raise the bar continuously.

- Go the Extra Mile – make the impossible possible.

- Hire & Elevate the Best – raise the bar with every hire.

Our recruiting process: 

Recruiter Call → Technical Peer Interview → 360° Tech Interview Loop → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa? 

We’re at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn’t just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We’re building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren’t just support tickets; they’re defining experiences. We’re here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale—and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments—this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn’t a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that’s evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. The Senior Partnerships Manager, Media & Data owns the end-to-end pursuit of medium-to-large global media publications and publisher groups, from first conversation to signature, to live, verified data flowing, and is responsible for building the commercial value exchange that makes Awin the leading partner for a premium publisher to work with. The focus in year one is a small number of flagship, tier-one lighthouse partnerships that prove the model and become the reference cases the rest of the market follows.

- Build and own a global target list of medium-to-large media publications and publisher groups whose audience, content and commerce activity make them high-value contributors to Awin’s deterministic dataset.

title: Associate Account Manager (Paris)
description:
The AI-powered OS for beauty, 

wellness and self-care 

About Fresha 

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC. 

Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions. 

Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management. 

The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google. 

Role overview 

Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Associate Account Manager to come and join our global business. 

Reporting directly to the Account Manager Team Lead, you will be accountable for building relationships and driving monetisation of the Fresha platform. 

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, who likes to work autonomously, enjoys a challenge, and wants to make an impact. 

To foster a collaborative environment that thrives on face-to-face interactions and teamwork, all Fresha employees work from office five days per week in Paris, on the Champs-élysées. 

Commercial Growth 

- Engagement - Accountable for meeting key performance indicators on monetisation and revenue growth by proactively engaging with and educating our Partners on the value of the Fresha platform.

- Sales Cycle - Proactively introduce, educate and convert Partners on to Fresha’s payments solution.

- Market Trends - Optimise listing content and availability competitiveness on the marketplace to maximise conversions.

Relationship Building 

- Partnering - Have a pool of Partner accounts serving as a dedicated advisor for all your Partners assisting them on their journey to product adoption.

- Advisor - Advising Partners on suitable product selection based on their needs and specifications.

- Business Partnering - Ensure a strong Partner Experience through building relationships by attending video meetings with your pool of Partners and effectively communicating the Fresha features and benefits.

- Relationships - Build key internal relationships with our Sales and Onboarding teams to ensure smooth transition and handover of Partners through the Partner journey.

- Collaboration - Collaborate with our Product teams to provide important product feedback to help enhance future releases.

- Persuasion - Use consultative sales techniques to understand customer needs and requirements and have the ability to upsell and cross-sell the Fresha Platform.

- This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver. 

What we are looking for 

- Experience - 1-2 Years experience in effectively delivering commercial outcomes from a previous Account Management role

- Closing Skills – Demonstrated ability to effectively close deals, negotiate, and convert opportunities

- Adaptability - Shown to be commercially motivated with an ability to adapt and achieve targets

- Analytics - Proven experience in using and analysing data and reporting effectively to improve commercial outcomes

- Curiosity - Naturally proactive and inquisitive, with a desire to consistently learn and improve

- Tele-prospecting - Previous experience in an outbound call environment or a related sales position preferred

- Communication - Excellent and proven written, verbal and presentation skills

- Innovative - Creative thinking and problem-solving mindset

- Relationship Building - You are a true hunter and relationship builder

- Team Player - Happy to roll sleeves up and assist the team when required

- Initiative - Ability to self-starter with a proactive approach

Added Bonus 

- Bi-lingual - Fluency in English and another language

- Beauty & Wellness - Experience within the beauty and wellness industry

- At Fresha, we value passion and potential as much as specific skills. If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role.

Interview Process 

- Screen Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30 mins)

- Skills & Experience - In-Person interview with Team Leads (30 mins)

- Presentation - In-Person interview with General Manager.

We aim to complete the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks . 

- Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe

Inclusive workforce 

At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable. 

We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment. 

We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying. 

If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you.

- Windows agent’s Anti-Tampering (self-protection from malware attempting to harm the agent), network sensors, device control, and other kernel-side features involving both research and development,

- usermode security & agent infrastructures - e.g. installers, logging, services such as communication layer & interfaces for our Windows agent, for improving the quality, performance & stability of the agent and making the user experience smoother.
