- As a new member of one of our distributed development teams, you will work in both user-mode & kernel-mode, and deal with a large variety of fields.

- You will have the chance to design, develop primarily in modern C++ (23), test and debug the most complicated real-world problems (often unseen before). In order to successfully deal with this challenge, you will continuously enrich your knowledge and experience with Windows OS internals & Kernel, Endpoint Protection, and Endpoint Detection & Response eco-system.

- Our teams design and execute significant new features, as well as rewrite and reimplement the existing ones from scratch. You will also deal with extraordinary performance & optimization challenges, given the scale of our cybersecurity SW (handling hundreds of billions of events every day).

- Your work will influence the security of tens of millions of Windows devices, that we protect at enterprise & government customers across the globe (incl. 4 of Fortune 10 and hundreds of Global 2000).

- You’ll also be encouraged to share knowledge within both Platform teams and the broader Windows group.

- Working setup: Flexible working hours, this is a 100% remote role on full-time permanent employment based within France. We provide optional membership in major coworking chains. Currently for this role in France we are able to consider only candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying. Optionally for those willing to relocate to the Czech Republic relocation assistance is available for any candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying.

What skills & knowledge should you bring? 

- Multiple years of experience as a software engineer in the area of lowlevel programming using modern C++ (or using C and a willingness to learn modern C++)

- Hands-on experience and in-depth understanding of Windows OS design & internals, Windows low-level development, with debugging of Windows applications and familiarity with related standard debugging and profiling tools

- Previous experience working on a production-grade product with a wide-scale deployment

- Great communication skills and the ability to work both independently and with peers from different time zones, problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

- Attention to detail and high coding standards

- An advantage: experience with Windows Kernel and Windows Drivers development, experience in security-oriented development, with reversing or malware analysis

Why SentinelOne? 

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. description:
Venez rejoindre l'IMT Mines Alès, grande école de prestige qui se classe parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs sur le plan national et mondial et implantée à Alès, ville à taille humaine, capitale des Cévennes où la qualité de vie est fortement appréciée par ses habitants. 

Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr 

Vous êtes rattaché(e) au Centre de Recherche et d’Enseignement en Environnement et Risques (CREER) de l'IMT Mines Alès et dans l'unité de recherche : HSM. 

Ce travail s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet PREV’IA qui s’intéresse à la connaissance et à la prévision des ressources en eaux de la nappe plioquaternaire de la plaine de Roussillon, et de la source du Lez qui alimente Montpellier en eau potable. 

Votre travail s’inscrira dans la continuité d’une thèse en cours au sein de l’UMR HSM (équipe HYTAKE), portant sur la durabilité de la ressource en eau karstique (aquifère du Lez) alimentant une métropole méditerranéenne (Montpellier) en contexte de changement climatique. 

Votre mission : 

- Utiliser les concepts émergeants dans les approches de « Physics Informed Machine Learning » (PIML) pour évaluer les intérêts d’une synergie en modélisation hydrogéologique : (1) à base conceptuelle d’une part et (2) à base de réseaux de neurones informés, ou complémentés, par la physique. L’approche PIML (Physics Informed Machine Learning) est développée, avec deux courants : (i) les Physics Informed Architecture (PIA) : intégration de connaissances physiques dans l’architecture du modèle (couches cachées) ; et (ii) les Physics Informed Loss Function (PILF) : combinaison de modélisations physiques (équations différentielles) et boîte noire, fusionnées dans la fonction de coût (terme de régularisation). Les deux méthodes pourront être explorées. Les modèles proposés pourront être utilisés pour déterminer l’évolution de certaines grandeurs hydrologiques en réponse au changement climatique.

- Doctorat dans un des domaines liés à l’hydrogéologie, l’hydrologie, ou la modélisation de l’environnement

- Expérience en machine Learning pour la modélisation des phénomènes naturels complexes

- Réelles aptitudes et une expérience en organisation et travail en équipe : organisation de réunions, planification des actions, contribution à la rédaction de documents administratifs

description:
IMT Atlantique , reconnue internationalement pour la qualité de sa recherche, est une école d’ingénieurs de premier plan sous la tutelle du ministère de l'industrie et du numérique, classée dans les trois principaux classements internationaux (THE, SHANGHAI, QS).

Le poste est ouvert sur le campus de Rennes au sein du département SRCD (Systèmes Réseaux, Cybersécurité et Droit du numérique) . Le département SRCD est composé de 24 enseignant.e.s-chercheurs.euses permanent.e.s, plus de 10 post-doctorant.e.s et ingénieur.e.s contractuel.le.s, et 30 doctorant.e.s. Ses domaines d'activité recouvrent tous les aspects de l'enseignement et de la recherche en systèmes et réseaux au sens large, en cybersécurité, et en droit et économie des activités numériques. Dans le cadre de ses activités de recherche, la personne recrutée rejoindra l’équipe SOTERN (Self Protecting the Future Internet) du département D2 du laboratoire IRISA (UMR CNRS 6074), l'un des plus grands laboratoires de recherche français (+ de 850 personnes) dans le domaine de l'informatique et des nouvelles technologies de l'information.

Enjeux et profil attendu sur le thématique de recherche 

Deux enjeux majeurs présentent actuellement un impact conséquent sur la recherche et l’innovation en Cybersécurité. D’un côté, l’intelligence artificielle par ses développements récents et les attendus pour les années à venir décuple les possibilités offertes aux attaquants pour mettre en œuvre de nouvelles attaques, tout autant qu’aux structures défensives (type SOC par exemple) pour détecter, corréler et contrer des incidents de sécurité. D’un autre côté, les cibles des attaques évoluent et les architectures déployées dans les réseaux opérationnels (systèmes industriels, réseaux intra-véhiculaires, avionique, opérateurs d’importance vitale) nécessitent de nouveaux moyens de détection et protection face à une menace grandissante.

Le profil recherché pour ce poste s’inscrit ainsi dans la thématique de la sécurité des réseaux au sens large. Il sera plus spécifiquement recherché soit une expertise relative aux architectures, protocoles et algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle pour la sécurité des réseaux ou de l’IA (apprentissage fédéré, sécurité des architectures d’IA type Model Context Protocol (MCP), etc.), soit une expertise sur la sécurité des réseaux opérationnels (OT) quel qu’en soit le cadre applicatif. 

Enjeux et profil attendu en enseignement 

Positionnée sur 3 campus attractifs, IMT Atlantique affiche une forte dynamique internationale tout en restant à taille humaine. Dans ces différents cursus BAC+5 (formations d’ingénieurs et de masters-DNM), les étudiants sont confrontés, via des approches pédagogiques variées, à des situations-problèmes concrets. L’école a ainsi pour ambition de former de jeunes professionnels à fort potentiel, capables de mobiliser un large spectre de compétences en situation réelle, dans des environnements (production, recherche, création d’activité, etc.) et des domaines socio-économiques variés.

Impliqué tant en tronc commun que dans les parcours électifs, la personne recrutée contribuera aussi bien dans sa spécialité Cybersécurité que dans des activités transverses, interdisciplinaires ou en lien avec des entreprises : tutorat de projets / stages, soutenances, accompagnement, etc. La personne recrutée sera encouragée à contribuer, dans un esprit de collaboration, à l’évolution cohérente des programmes d’études, en proposant de nouveaux projets, programmes et méthodologies pédagogiques, particulièrement inspirés et soutenus par les exigences et les partenariats industriels. https://www.imt-atlantique.fr/fr/formation 

En cohérence avec le profil de la personne candidate, il sera demandé de prendre en main les thématiques d’enseignement parmi les suivantes : IA et Cybersécurité (IA offensive, IA pour la protection des infrastructures, sécurité de l’IA), Sécurité des systèmes industriels, participation puis prise de responsabilité de l’organisation du CTF Hack’lantique, et plus largement une participation aux différents enseignements en Cybersécurité.

Responsabilité collective et implication dans le développement économique 

En effet une attention particulière sera portée sur la capacité du candidat à s’impliquer dans la vie collective de l’école : contribuer, ou piloter des projets transverses (par exemple sur la transition écologique, prendre des responsabilités (programmes de formation, projets de recherche, équipes pédagogiques ou de recherche) ou participer à des instances : comité de l’enseignement, conseil d’école, comité social d’administration.

En outre dans un environnement de relations privilégiées avec de grands partenaires industriels nationaux et internationaux, ainsi qu’un réseau dense de PME, Start up, l’enseignant chercheur recruté contribuera au rayonnement de l’école et au développement économique, notamment au travers de la valorisation de ses travaux par le dépôt de brevet ou le transfert de technologies. Avec 257 enseignants-chercheurs permanents, 2450 étudiants dont 399 doctorants, IMT Atlantique produit chaque année 655 publications et lève 28.3M€ de fonds de recherche.

title: STAGE - Junior Fullstack Engineer
description:
Notre mission ⚖️ 

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.

Contexte du stage

Depuis des années, Doctrine propose une fonctionnalité d’envoi de décision de justice en France à ses clients. Cela est une source précieuse de décisions de justice qui permet à Doctrine d’enrichir sa base de données (c'est-à-dire son legal graph) avec des décisions qui n’ont pas pu être ajoutées par nos processus habituels.

Le but de ce stage est l’internationalisation de cette fonctionnalité de manière à ce qu’elle soit utilisable dans tous les autres pays où Doctrine est actif (Italie, Allemagne).

Les tâches principales seront :

- Le développement d’une application minimale pour la revue et validation des décisions de justice mises en ligne par nos utilisateurs pour nos juristes avant leur publication.

- La migration du processus legacy d’upload français actuel pour se conformer au processus commun (internationalisé).

Une fois que le processus de mise en ligne de décisions par nos utilisateurs sera internationalisé, le ou la stagiaire pourra travailler sur des tâches d’amélioration de l’application de revue de décisions dans le but d’aider notre équipe de juristes à mieux traiter le volume de décisions mises en ligne.

Exemples de pistes d’amélioration (non exhaustif)

- Application de techniques d’OCR sur les documents pour faciliter leur validation.

- Détection via LLM d’attributs des décisions (niveau de confidentialité, juridiction, domaine du droit, cour, …) pour faciliter leur validation.

- Aide au retrait de contenu qui n’est pas le texte de la décision (pages blanches, notification à l’avocat, …).
Le ou la stagiaire devra participer à la définition de la solution et sa réalisation. Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Italie et sera amené·e à travailler avec les équipes des autres pays (principalement l’équipe France) et l’équipe légale. Il ou elle participera aussi au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs full stack de l’entreprise).

Les à-côtés du poste 👁️ 
Le ou la stagiaire participera comme tous les ingénieurs à son chapter (réuni 2 fois par mois) dont le but est de :

- Partager des connaissances entre ses membres (amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques)

- Proposer des améliorations (nouveaux outils et processus)

- Aider ses membres en fonction de leurs besoins

Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝 

- Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.

- Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.

- Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.

- Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

Nos valeurs 🤝 

Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

- Challenge the status quo : n ous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.

- Liberty and responsibility : n ous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.

- Knowledge is power : l 'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.

- Release early, release often and listen to your customers : n ous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.

Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️ 

🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

Notre processus de recrutement 🚀 

- Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine

- Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager , pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.

- Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences

- Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.

(si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles)

Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins. 

Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature ! 

Diversité & inclusion

title: Senior Software Engineer, Chaos Engineering
description:
Datadog’s Chaos Engineering team builds systems that surface reliability weaknesses before they become outages. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will initially focus on zonal resilience, building automation that helps services safely evacuate and recover from zonal failures, while also contributing to fault injection, incident replay, gameday orchestration, and reliability tooling. You will work across engineering teams to design systems that safely exercise production failure modes and turn findings into verified remediation. You will also help advance the use of AI and automation to identify, test, and close resilience gaps as Datadog’s software and infrastructure evolve.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do: 

- Build zonal-resilience automation that coordinates safe workload evacuations, switchovers, and recovery in partnership with the teams that own affected services.

- Design and build fault-injection systems for production environments, including infrastructure- and application-level testing, incident replay, and controlled resilience experiments.

- Develop safeguards such as blast-radius controls, kill switches, validation mechanisms, and rollback paths that keep production experiments contained and reversible.

- Build agents and automation that help propose failure scenarios, triage experiment results, and connect reliability findings to tracked remediation and verification.

- Lead gamedays from hypothesis and scenario design through execution, documented findings, remediation tracking, and validation of completed fixes.

- Design and implement reliable distributed systems, including gRPC services, Kubernetes controllers, and shared platform components, while contributing to technical design and mentoring other engineers.

Who You Are: 

- You have strong distributed systems fundamentals and can reason about consistency, failure modes, backpressure, idempotency, quorum, retries, and failure recovery.

- You understand Kubernetes workload lifecycles, including how pods, controllers, scheduling, draining, and eviction interact with resilient system design.

- You have experience designing, building, or operating production systems where safety, availability, and controlled failure handling are important.

- You communicate complex technical decisions clearly through design documents, runbooks, postmortems, and cross-functional technical discussions.

- You are comfortable collaborating across engineering teams to understand unfamiliar systems, identify failure modes, and drive resilience improvements.

- Experience with reliability engineering, chaos engineering, zonal failover, AI-assisted operational workflows, traffic interception, or large-scale observability systems is beneficial but not required.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That’s okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth: 

- Develop deep expertise in distributed systems, production resilience, Kubernetes, and large-scale infrastructure.

- Work on reliability systems that operate across Datadog’s production environment and influence how engineering teams design for failure.

- Grow your experience designing safe, automated approaches to fault injection, zonal resilience, and incident reproduction.

- Explore practical applications of AI and automation to reliability engineering and operational workflows.

- Collaborate with engineers across infrastructure, databases, observability, and service teams on complex systems challenges.

- Mentor other engineers and contribute to technical designs, engineering practices, and platform strategy.

- Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

Who We Are

Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the DuckDuckGo subscription . Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role 

As a Senior Product Designer, Design Systems you'll be the first of its kind at DuckDuckGo. You'll take ownership of our design system at a pivotal moment, with a chance to define both a role and a roadmap from the ground up — helping build the process, not just step into one. You'll audit our existing system, lead projects that move it forward across platforms and products like Duck.ai and Search, as well as shape how we manage and scale it as we grow. 

Applying your hands-on design skills, you will autonomously lead highly impactful projects that scale across millions of users, and collaborate with team members at all levels to pioneer new solutions as we build out the privacy layer for the internet. Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Pourquoi Deliveroo ? 

Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d’un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!

Descriptif du poste : 

En tant que Account Manager – Paris , vous serez responsable du succès de votre portefeuille de comptes stratégiques, afin de mettre en place les outils les plus pertinents pour nos utilisateurs. Vous reporterez directement au Client Partner en place.

Vos principales missions :

- 
Gérer un portefeuille de restaurants clés dans des secteurs matures, nécessitant une réelle expertise et une attention particulière.

- 
Créer un partenariat privilégié et durable en apportant votre expertise Food Tech, en tant qu’expert(e) de votre zone/ville.

- 
Optimiser la rentabilité de votre portefeuille et proposer un accompagnement personnalisé, construit sur le long terme avec l’appui de la data.

- 
Soyez un expert de votre zone et assurer le rayonnement de Deliveroo grâce à une vision 360 : account management, sales, marketing, opérations.

- 
Analyser la performance de votre portefeuille et prendre les mesures adéquates. Faire des recommandations directes au Client Partner, faire preuve d’agilité et d’ouverture à la nouveauté. Deliveroo est une entreprise en mouvement, avec des outils et options à déployer à un rythme soutenu.

- 
Suggérer et mettre en œuvre des campagnes marketing et promotionnelles adaptées à votre portefeuille.

- 
Suivre de près les opérations pour optimiser l’expérience à la fois des restaurants partenaires et des clients.

Votre expérience et vos qualités : 

- 
2 à 3 ans d’expérience minimum sur un poste similaire.

- 
Capacité à négocier, anticiper des discussions commerciales, entreprendre les actions nécessaires pour maintenir un portefeuille de qualité (discussions contractuelles, négociation d’outils commerciaux, etc.) et atteindre les objectifs (OKRs).

- 
Capacités d’analyse data afin d’y tirer des axes de croissance nécessaires au développement de vos comptes.

- 
Capacité à garder le contrôle de son portefeuille Partenaires, à observer les tendances du marché et à fournir des retours en temps réel à ses partenaires et à son manager.

- 
Expertise terrain : proche de vos partenaires, vous êtes capable d’assurer une veille concurrentielle qualitative sur votre portefeuille et votre secteur.

- 
Capacité à convaincre et à influencer vos partenaires pour atteindre les objectifs fixés, tout en respectant les valeurs de Deliveroo.

- 
Proactivité et capacité à tirer des conclusions des résultats de vos actions pour faire des recommandations pertinentes aux partenaires.

- 
Compréhension et appropriation rapide des objectifs à atteindre, avec autonomie et détermination.

- 
Capacité à mettre en place des actions personnalisées et cohérentes avec les besoins des partenaires et les directives managériales.

- 
Capacité à identifier, comprendre et analyser les données de performance commerciale et opérationnelle sur l’ensemble de votre portefeuille dans une logique d’excellence de service.

- 
Maîtrise de l’anglais (écrit/parlé) pour défendre un point de vue et communiquer efficacement.

- 
Capacité à construire des relations commerciales durables afin de faire de Deliveroo la référence de la “food” aux yeux de nos partenaires.

Environnement de travail & avantages 

Chez Deliveroo, nous savons que les employés sont au cœur de l'entreprise et nous accordons une grande importance à leur bien-être. Les avantages varient d'un pays à l'autre, mais nous proposons du télétravail hybride, ainsi que de nombreux avantages dans des domaines tels que la santé, le bien-être, les congés parentaux, la retraite ainsi que des congés pour soutenir une œuvre de bienfaisance de votre choix. Les avantages sont propres à chaque pays. Pour plus d'informations, veuillez vous adresser à la personne chargée du recrutement pour ce poste.

Diversité 

Nous sommes convaincus qu'un excellent environnement de travail est celui qui reflète le monde dans lequel nous vivons dans toute sa diversité. Nous ne portons aucun jugement sur ce qui fait de vous la personne que vous êtes - que ce soit votre genre, votre race, votre sexualité, votre religion ou même une aversion secrète pour la coriandre!

À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l’article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s’engage en faveur de la diversité, l’égalité professionnelle, l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness .

title: SMB Success Junior Account Executive
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. 

GET TO KNOW US 

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. We operate in 18 countries worldwide and our platform supports more than 40,000 clients, connecting their employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. 

Headquartered in NYC with team members across Europe, North America, and South America (2,000+ Wellhubbers and counting!), we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company. As we continue to grow, we're extending our presence across Europe, with France among our next key markets! 

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! 

THE OPPORTUNITY 

We are hiring a Client Success Account Executive II to join our SMB team in Paris ! This is a hybrid role, requiring a minimum of two days per week in our Paris office. 

Wellhub is officially expanding into France, and you will join a high-impact team at the forefront of this new venture! As one of the first SMB BDRs in the country, you will play a key role in building our presence from the ground up—generating pipeline, engaging HR leaders, and contributing to both the development of our local sales playbook and our go-to-market approach. 

This is a rare opportunity to take on real ownership from day one, introduce a global brand to a new market, and help shape our long-term success in France. 

YOUR IMPACT 

Reporting to the Country Lead your core mission will be to manage a wide portfolio of growing B2B businesses (typically up to 500 employees) and ensure their long-term satisfaction through the following pillars: 

- High-Velocity Onboarding: Lead the digital launch and setup process for a high volume of new SMB clients, guiding HR leads and business owners through their first 90 days seamlessly. 

- Engagement & Activation Drive: Create and execute scalable communication strategies (webinars, automated campaigns, and digital toolkits) to introduce Wellhub to our clients' workforces and rapidly increase user sign-ups. 

- Portfolio Health & Optimization: Monitor account health data to proactively identify low-engagement accounts, intervening with creative solutions to boost activation and prevent early churn. 

- Commercial Retention: Own the renewal cycle for your portfolio, handling high-volume contract renewals, minor contract updates, and identifying upselling opportunities. 

- Cross-Functional Bridge: Collaborate closely with the SMB Sales team to ensure smooth client handovers 

WHO YOU ARE 

- You have 1+ year of experience in sales, high-velocity sales, or client-facing roles. Experience in a startup or in a "new market" environment is a big plus. 

- You communicate confidently in French (native level) and fluently in English. 

- You are motivated by targets and bring energy to outbound activity. 

- You’re proactive, curious, and comfortable working in a fast-moving, evolving environment. 

- You thrive on building processes from scratch and take ownership of your work. 

- You are familiar with CRM tools such as Salesforce (a plus). 

- You enjoy working as part of a team and contributing to a positive, collaborative environment. 

- You are passionate about wellness and genuinely excited to help the French workforce lead happier, healthier lives. 

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. 

WHAT WE OFFER YOU 

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include: 

WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. 

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role is Hybrid, with a minimum of 2 days per week in-office based in Paris . We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. 

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines. 

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year (including an extra holiday on your birthday!). 

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled. 

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn ! 

Wellhub was named a Top Sales Team of 2025! 

This is a recognition of the collaboration and impact we create together every day. Ready to be part of a team that’s making a real difference? Read more about the award here. 

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub 

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. 

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. 

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

title: Business Development Representative - Marché Français
description:
À propos du poste 

En tant que Business Development Representative chez Amenitiz, vous prenez en charge l'intégralité du cycle de vente, du premier contact de prospection jusqu'à la signature du contrat. Il ne s'agit pas d'un poste centré uniquement sur la prise de rendez-vous. Vous prospectez, réalisez des démonstrations, traitez les objections et concluez les ventes, tout en gérant votre pipeline et votre contribution au chiffre d'affaires de bout en bout.

Nos clients sont des hôteliers indépendants partout en Europe : des établissements familiaux, des hôtels-boutiques et de petites chaînes hôtelières insuffisamment servis par des solutions technologiques conçues pour les grands groupes. Avec plus de 15 000 clients et une note de satisfaction de 4,8/5, notre produit bénéficie d'une forte reconnaissance sur le marché.

Vous commercialiserez une solution qui a un impact concret et mesurable sur le quotidien de ses utilisateurs, tout en étant pleinement responsable de l'ensemble du processus qui leur permet d'y accéder.

(Ce rôle est basé à Lyon, en France) 

Votre mission 

- Prospection et génération de pipeline

- Identifiez et contactez de nouveaux clients potentiels par téléphone, e-mail et chat. Maintenez un niveau d'activité élevé et construisez un pipeline commercial solide à partir de zéro. Vous êtes responsable de l'ensemble de votre activité de prospection.

- Découverte des besoins et qualification

- Comprenez l'organisation actuelle de chaque prospect, ses problématiques et ses besoins opérationnels. Identifiez rapidement les opportunités pertinentes et positionnez Amenitiz de manière précise et adaptée à leur situation.

- Démonstrations produit

- Animez des démonstrations structurées et personnalisées qui établissent un lien direct entre les fonctionnalités du produit et les enjeux métier du prospect. Rendez la prise de décision simple et évidente.

- Gestion des objections et closing

- Traitez avec assurance les hésitations, les comparaisons avec la concurrence et les objections liées au timing. Créez un sentiment d'urgence lorsque cela est pertinent et sachez demander la signature.

- Gestion du pipeline

- Maintenez HubSpot à jour et garantissez la fiabilité des données. Réalisez des prévisions précises et assurez un suivi rigoureux de chaque opportunité.

- Collaboration

- Travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables commerciaux et vos collègues afin d'améliorer en continu votre approche. Partagez les retours du marché, les objections récurrentes et les informations concurrentielles pour contribuer à la performance collective.

À propos de vous 

- Vous disposez de 2 à 4 ans d'expérience dans une fonction commerciale (SDR, Account Executive ou poste en cycle de vente complet).

- Vous êtes de langue maternelle française, italienne, espagnole ou portugaise, et possédez un excellent niveau d'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.

- Vous êtes à l'aise pour alterner entre des phases de prospection intensive et des phases de closing au cours d'une même semaine.

- Vous assumez l'entière responsabilité de votre pipeline et de vos résultats, au-delà des simples indicateurs d'activité.

- Vous adoptez une approche structurée de la gestion commerciale : vos prévisions sont fiables et votre suivi est irréprochable.

- Vous faites preuve de résilience et de régularité dans un environnement exigeant, orienté objectifs et à fort volume d'activité.

- Une expérience en SaaS, dans la technologie appliquée à l'hôtellerie ou en startup constitue un atout.
La maîtrise de HubSpot ou d'un CRM similaire est appréciée.

Ce que nous offrons 

- Une rémunération attractive (OTE) composée d'un salaire fixe et de commissions déplafonnées basées sur la performance.

- Des stock-options avec un calendrier d'acquisition progressif.

- Une couverture santé complète.

- Un accès anticipé à votre salaire, sans attendre la fin du mois.

- Un parcours de carrière structuré, avec des critères d'évolution clairement définis à chaque niveau.

- Des avantages flexibles permettant d'optimiser vos dépenses liées aux repas, à la garde d'enfants, aux transports et à la formation.

- L'achat de tout livre professionnel dont vous avez besoin, ainsi qu'un accès à une bibliothèque partagée au sein de l'équipe.

- Une équipe internationale composée de plus de 35 nationalités, basée dans l'un des principaux hubs technologiques européens.

title: Senior Product Manager - Paris
description:
Who we are 

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role

At Yubo, Product Managers have real ownership. They work in strong partnership with Product Designers and Engineering, shaping strategy and decisions from problem definition all the way to delivery, with direct and visible impact on both the product and the business.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to form that partnership with a Product Designer: a duo jointly responsible for the end-to-end experiences you ship together. You'll take ownership of a strategic product area, identify the biggest opportunities, and turn them into clear product bets on a product used by millions of people.

We're moving away from small, isolated feature launches toward bigger, end-to-end experiences tested at scale . You'll combine user understanding, data and strong product convictions to frame problems, shape solutions with Design and Engineering, and decide what to scale, iterate, or stop.

You'll also work closely with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing and Trust & Safety on challenges ranging from recommendation and discovery to retention, safety, monetization and AI.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and who wants their decisions to have a visible impact on both user experience and business outcomes.

To make this dream duo work, we’re basing this role in Paris and looking for someone willing to come to the office once or twice a week.

Your responsibilities

- Own a strategic product area from problem definition through delivery and post-launch iteration

- Define product strategy and translate company objectives into clear priorities and measurable outcomes

- Partner closely with Product Design and Engineering to shape end-to-end experiences rather than isolated features

- Use data, research, user feedback, market insights, and product intuition to identify the problems worth solving

- Turn opportunities into bold product bets, measure their impact, and decide whether to scale, iterate, or stop

- Collaborate with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, Trust & Safety, and Legal to make informed product decisions

- Balance user value, business impact, safety, and technical constraints when making trade-offs

- Create alignment across stakeholders through clear problem framing, strong product conviction, and structured decision-making

Tools we use

- Amplitude, SQL, Looker

- Figma

- Notion

- Slack

- Enterpret

- AI tooling: Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, Dust

Who you are

- You have 4+ years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally within consumer mobile products and a startup or scale-up environment

- You are comfortable owning a product area from problem definition through launch and iteration

- You combine strong product intuition with analytical rigor

- You know how to use data, research, user feedback, and experimentation to guide decisions

- You start with the user problem rather than jumping straight to a feature or solution

- You have the conviction to form a strong product point of view, make bold calls, and defend them

- You enjoy working closely with Design and Engineering and leading through influence rather than hierarchy

- You are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and changing direction when the evidence tells you to

- You know how to balance user experience with growth, engagement, monetization, safety, and long-term product health

- Experience with social, community, social discovery, gaming, recommendation, or consumer subscription products is a plus

Within a month, you will

- Get familiar with Yubo's product, users, business model, and product principles

- Build relationships with your Product Designer and key stakeholders across Engineering, Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, and Trust & Safety

- Understand current product priorities, ongoing experiments, major user journeys, and the metrics behind them

- Start contributing to discovery and product discussions

Within 3 months, you will

- Take ownership of a defined product area and its key user and business problems

- Establish a trusted way of working with your Product Designer and Engineering counterparts

- Lead your first discovery work and turn your findings into clear product opportunities

- Launch and analyze your first experiments, using their results to inform your next decisions

Within 6 months, you will

- Own the strategy and key initiatives for your product area end to end

- Lead ambitious product bets that rethink meaningful parts of the user experience rather than isolated features

- Drive measurable progress on outcomes such as retention, engagement, recommendation quality, monetization, or trust

- Use data, user insight, and experimentation to decide what to scale, iterate, stop, or explore next

- Raise the bar on product thinking, experimentation, and decision-making across Yubo

The recruitment process

- Phone screen with Anita, Talent Acquisition

- First interview with Sacha, our CEO

- Product case study and debrief with Product Managers

- Cultural fit assessments

- And if everything went well, an offer!

What we offer 

- A highly competitive salary range as well as equity in the company

- A hybrid work policy with up to two days of on-site presence per week at an amazing office and monthly team events to enjoy.

- We also cover fees for external professional events and meetups (Android Makers, etc…)

- Great health insurance coverage for both you and your family by Alan, fully paid for by Yubo !

title: Head of Sales @Pelagon (backed by Hexa)
description:
Who are we?

The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable.

Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction : detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them.

We sell to navies and coast guards , and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy.

Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa , the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk.

⚡ What is at stake in the coming months

- Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators.

- Deploy and sign our first paid pilots.

- Sign our first contracts.

By joining us, you'll play a key role in turning that early traction into multi-year protection contracts, and in building the sales team that follows.

🎯 Your mission

- Own every deal from first meeting to signed contract, with navies, port authorities and operators of cables and offshore energy.

- Sell interdiction, not detection alone: make the threat and the gap between alarm and response concrete for each buyer, then turn pilots into multi-year protection contracts.

- Shape requirements before the tender: work with navies and operators months ahead of an RFP so that it asks for detection and action together.

- Open our priority export markets: the Baltic and the Nordics, the Black Sea, the Gulf and Southeast Asia.

- Work as a pair with Gauthier, our Co-CEO, on key accounts, and bring Aymeric and the engineers in when the technical conversation starts.

- Build the partner channel: primes and integrators, offshore and cable operators, and local partners in each country.

- Turn every deployment into a reference the next customer can check.

- Set up the sales machine, then hire and lead the first sellers.

📈 How you will be measured

- First 3 months: you own the pipeline, have a qualified deal plan for each priority region, and a first paid pilot or LOI is signed.

- 6 months: paid pilots are running and the first contracts are signed.

- 12 months: recurring contracts in at least two countries, and your first sales hires are made and ramped.

🤩 This job is your dream job if:

- You have closed defense or government deals and want to do it again, from zero, where every contract changes the trajectory

- You like being the second half of a founder pair: the CEO brings operational credibility, you bring the deal

- You'd rather be on a plane to Tallinn, Constanța or Abu Dhabi than in a forecast meeting

- You speak engineer well enough to sell sensors, AI and C2

- You want to write the sales playbook yourself, then hire the team that runs it

🙅 This job is not for you if:

- You need a brand, a marketing team and SDRs to sell

- You have only sold short-cycle SaaS or SMB deals, never through formal procurement

- You want to manage a large team from day one rather than close deals yourself

- Sales cycles of 12 to 24 months and 40% travel put you off

- You are looking for the comfort of a large defense group

What we offer

- A founding role in a seed-stage defense tech company backed by Hexa

- Fixed salary, variable on signed revenue, BSPCE

- Offices in Paris, real deployments at sea

🧭 Our recruitment process

- A first call to get to know each other.

- A deep dive into two deals you closed.

- A case study on a real Pelagon challenge, presented to the founders.

- A conversation with the founders.

- Reference checks, with your consent.

- Offer.

We answer after each step.

Pelagon is committed to creating a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment irrespective of gender, origin, identity, background and sexual orientation.

description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot , based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here ). 

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve , Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started. 

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

Join us as a Data Analyst – Growth to own how Qonto measures whether its marketing spend actually works. You'll take charge of our attribution models and incrementality tests — geo tests, conversion lift studies — turning marketing spend across channels into evidence-backed decisions, under the guidance of Clotilde Pety , our Lead Data Analyst.

➡️ What you'll do 

- Own attribution, end to end — maintain the attribution models and touchpoint definitions, and be the go-to when a stakeholder asks why the numbers moved.

- Test where it matters, inside the ad platforms — design and run geo tests and conversion lift studies directly in Google Ads and Meta Ads.

- Build the roadmap, not just answer tickets — pick up and drive the incrementality - testing roadmap within the first few months.

- Referee, don't take sides — help channel teams and Finance agree on what the numbers actually say.

- Use AI across the workflow, from making sense of a stakeholder's ask to shipping the dashboard that answers it.

- Has owned an attribution model, not just read one — can explain last-click vs first-click and has navigated a real team disagreement over it.

- Real ownership from day one — no inherited playbook, you build the roadmap.

- A stack that's already there — Snowflake, Tableau, AI-forward team.

- Your own lane to grow into, distinct from the senior data scientists.

- Stakes that matter — your calls influence real budget allocation.

Her background? Clotilde started her career across some of the top data consultancies in France — fifty-five, Artefact, and Ekimetrics — working on data science and analytics challenges across industries. She then built and grew the Customer Insights team at Galeries Lafayette: though embedded in Marketing, the team forged strong working relationships across Strategy & Finance, Merchandising & Buying, and Operations — directions that had never partnered with an analytics team before. She joined Qonto as Lead Business Analytics Growth, partnering with Growth, Customer Lifecycle Product, and Operations Onboarding.
What does she bring to the team? Clotilde leads with a relentless focus on the "why" — before any analytics request moves forward, she insists on a live conversation to nail down the context and the decision it's meant to inform (she rebuilt her team's own ticket templates around exactly this). She challenges proposed solutions with care, not to slow things down but to sharpen them, and she's deeply invested in helping each team member grow into someone who pushes back and reasons for themselves, not just executes.

title: AI Content Manager Intern
description:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

The internship 

You'll shape how Homa communicates, inside and out. You'll operate at the intersection of storytelling, strategy, and AI, turning complex ideas into sharp content that lands with every audience: talent, game studios, partners, investors, and our own teams. There's no shadow work. What you create will be published, presented, and read. You'll develop a 360° understanding of Homa by working with every function, while building your writing, design, and AI skills.

What you'll do 

- Build. Design AI-powered content systems (workflows, prompt libraries, templates) so the team can produce more, faster, without losing quality.
- Create. Produce high-impact content fast: LinkedIn posts, blog articles, employer branding, internal decks, and strategic presentations.
- Produce. Use AI tools for images, video, and copy to create high-performing creatives and content for our games.
- Monitor trends. Track social media trends, competitor content, and new AI tools to stay ahead.
- Elevate. Spot high-impact opportunities, introduce better formats and tools, and raise the bar for how Homa informs, inspires, and engages.

Why Homa

- Exceptional growth. We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest.
- Real ownership, early. Your projects will change how Homa operates, and you'll see the results.
- Learn from leadership. You'll work alongside leaders and people who make decisions.
- A high talent bar. Our teams are small and demanding, and the people around you will push you to grow.
- AI at the core. You'll have access to the best AI tools, and you'll help shape how an AI-first company works.
Requirements 

- Extreme ownership. You drive outcomes, when something breaks, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.
- Proactive. You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.
- Pragmatism and simplicity. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship. 
- Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly. You can explain something complex in a few sentences.
- AI-driven. AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink at least one thing you're proud of.
- Hungry and motivated. You're ambitious, high-energy, and grounded. You see this internship as a chance to learn faster than anywhere else, and you're ready to work for it.
- Bonus: you've built something. A game, an app, a student initiative, a side business. We'd love to hear about it.
For this role, you'll also bring: 

- You've created content in some form: a blog, a TikTok page, a newsletter, a portfolio, a standout university project. Show us. We care about what you've made, not where you made it.
- Sharp writing. You write and speak with clarity and punch, adapt to any audience, and work confidently with anyone.
- Design instinct. You're fluent in content tools (slides, Canva, Figma, or similar) and build clean, high-quality visuals.
Practical details

- A 6-month internship, with a flexible start date. We adapt to any month.
- A convention de stage (internship agreement) is required.
- Apprenticeships ( alternance ) are also welcome.
- Paris based. You'll need to be able to work onsite at our Paris office.
- Fluent English is required. French is a plus, not a requirement.
- Top performers may be offered a full-time role at the end of the internship

Our Culture 

At Homa , we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

- Humility: We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.
- Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.
- Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.
- Ambition: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” - we use common sense to reach higher.
Benefits 

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

- 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
- 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
- 🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
- 🌐 Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
- ✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.

title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
description:
Description Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes. 

You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind. 

Your mission 1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence 

- Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution. 

- Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy. 

- Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters. 

- Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo. 

2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership 

- Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer. 

- Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders). 

- Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice. 

- Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos. 

3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement 

- Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation. 

- Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations. 

- Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder. 

What We Want to Achieve Together 

In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds. 

In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount. 

Your profile - Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies. 

- Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences. 

- Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility. 

- Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data. 

- AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new. 

- A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough. 

- Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both. 

Why us? - Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else. 

- A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI. 

- Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites. 

- Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation. 

- Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority. 

Process - 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations. 

- Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live. 

- Case study: show us something you’ve written or built, and how you’d turn it into a sales-ready asset. 

- Meet the team in the office. 

- Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team! 

How to Apply 

Send us your CV, two or three writing or work samples you’re proud of, and a short note answering: what’s your sharpest point of view on where Legal AI is heading, and what’s the evidence?

title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer - Autonomy Architecture
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously. Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. 

About the Job 

The autonomy team at Gravis architects autonomous behaviors for different tasks, e.g. different types of excavation or truck loading. This role owns the architecture that lets those behaviors live in the same software stack as opposed to creating one SW stack per behavior. You'll be responsible for how tasks are decomposed and orchestrated, for the interfaces between, and for the software quality. We are looking for a senior roboticist with C++ and Python expertise and high standards for software quality, who can make clear, pragmatic architectural calls that let the system grow without losing stability.

What you'll do 

Architecture 

- 
Own the task-level architecture shared across our autonomous behaviors

- 
Define clear module boundaries and responsibilities between behavior orchestration, factor out common logic across different tasks

- 
Implement component tests and telemetry/metrics collection pipelines

- 
Identify technical debt early enough to guide the team toward sustainable solutions

- 
Act as the go-to person for software quality: modern C++ practices, code structure, error handling, robustness. Likewise for Python.

Configuration & tooling 

- 
Design an easily extensible and testable module for deploying policies that can be reused across tasks and supports schema versioning for observations, so a deployed policy pins the exact version of the computations it was trained against

- 
Provide technical leadership on C++ and Python tooling (clang-tidy, sanitizers, static analysis, linting, typing, test setup)

- 
Work with our incoming simulation team to unify training, benchmarking and evaluation tooling across tasks, so adding a task doesn't mean forking tooling and infrastructure

What we're looking for 

Required 

- 
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

- 
5+ years developing complex C++ systems, with deep knowledge of modern C++ (17 and onwards)

- 
Strong Python for tooling, configuration and simulation-side scripting

- 
Strong experience designing large, modular software systems that outlived their first use case

- 
High standards for software quality and long-term maintainability

Nice to have 

- 
Experience with behavior trees, state machines, or other task orchestration frameworks in production

- 
Experience working alongside learned controllers in a production stack - deployment, versioning, observation pipelines. No need to train them.

- 
Motion planning, geometric algorithms, or spatial data structures

- 
Feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms

This role is a great fit if… 

- 
You want to make systems work reliably in the real world, and enjoy thinking through the edge cases

- 
You'd rather our next behavior be a configuration than a dedicated piece of software

- 
You want the best idea to win regardless of who had it, and you'd rather be corrected by the numbers than agreed with

- 
You take a result end-to-end: when something needs to happen, you use or ask for whatever it takes, even outside your scope

- 
You're a software purist, but pragmatic — first make it work, then make it right, and cut corners consciously when it's the right call

Gravis is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team, and do not discriminate based on race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

Power electronics are the bottleneck on every next-generation UAS airframe we build: motor controllers, gate drivers, and DC-DC stages are what define flight time, payload, thermal envelope, and field reliability. We're looking for a senior IC to own the analog power chain end-to-end across our UXV platforms: from MOSFET commutation simulation through PCB layout to lab validation. You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment.

This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware.

Responsibilities 

- Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification.

- MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs.

- Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink.

- BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces.

- High-Power-Density PCBA: Lead schematic and layout in Altium or KiCad with thermal, parasitics, and EMC engineered in from the first revision.

- EMI / EMC Engineering: Drive pre-compliance, filter design, and root-cause debug under flight-representative loads.

- Prototype-to-Production: Take motor-controller PCBAs through revision discipline, DFM, and qualification - closing the loop on field returns.

- Lab Validation: Execute bench characterization (power analysers, oscilloscopes, thermal imaging, double-pulse testing) and reconcile against simulation.

- Firmware & Controls Interface: Partner with embedded and propulsion on FOC tuning, current-sense calibration, and the hardware/firmware compensation boundary.

- Design Authority & Mentorship: Set the bar via design-decision records and reference designs. Mentor 1–2 junior engineers.

Candidate Requirements 

- MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or equivalent.

- 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience on motor drives, BLDC/PMSM controllers, or high-power-density power electronics.

- Deep working mastery of MOSFET commutation design : gate-driver selection, dead-time tuning, switching transitions, loss budgets.

- Proven ownership of at least one motor-controller PCBA shipped from prototype through production (or pre-production qualification) : ideally on drone, robotics, eVTOL, or automotive platforms.

- Fluency in simulation (LTspice, PLECS, or Simulink) and PCB design (Altium).

- Strong, hard-earned intuition for EMI / EMC design and debug.

- Lab-bench discipline: you've personally debugged what simulation missed.

- Comfort with scale-up iteration speed and end-to-end ownership.

- English fluent (working language); French is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.

Bonus points for: GaN / SiC experience, safety-critical design exposure , applied control theory implemented in hardware, exposure to defense, aerospace, or UAS programmes.

title: Production Engineer
description:
As a Production Engineer, you will play a key role within our Test Engineering team, programming test software and documenting test procedures to scale production of our next-generation drone platforms. In this position, you will take ownership of verification and production test equipment, from defining test concepts to designing automated test solutions, jigs and needle-bed adapters that help us improve yield and reliability. You’ll collaborate closely with our software and electronics engineers and OEM partners to enhance test coverage and reduce testing time, driving efficiency across our manufacturing process.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, agile environment, offering the opportunity to design creative, practical test solutions from concept through to mass production. This involves balancing the transition from our existing test setups to more scalable and complete solutions in a pragmatic and iterative way for a number of different projects.

Beyond test engineering, you’ll apply your software expertise across the broader hardware and software team by supporting the engineering validation efforts of new products. You will also visit OEMs to support new product integrations and support small scale engineering runs in person.

Responsibilities and Duties 

- Research, design and build test solutions, including auto generated, 3D printed test equipment and CNC milled custom test jigs, and needle-bed adapters to enable low-volume prototyping and mid- to high-volume PCB production.

- Plan and execute product verification, covering test case definition, execution, analysis, and comprehensive documentation, also for repair guidance.

- Write Python code and STM32 firmware to test our embedded products from the inside (selftest) and outside (via test fixture).

- Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams by offering technical guidance and hands-on support for testing and validation of advanced avionics PCBs and modular systems.

- Specify and document additional manufacturer tests (like flying probe) to allow for a layered, holistic approach to test coverage.

- Write Repair Guides that document the error cases and the affected components.

- Guide manufacturers with new product integrations usually in person in the factory.

- Manage tracking systems across multiple locations to inspect the product workflow.

- Support internal CI systems with real hardware to validate test procedures before upgrading test fixtures at OEMs.

Qualifications and Skills 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field.

- Proficiency in modern Python and C/C++ also applied to embedded systems.

- 5+ years of experience in programming software that runs on real hardware and testing it on real hardware.

- CAD experience (e.g., Onshape) and soldering skills are required.

- Practical experience in Linux, microcontroller programming, 3D printing, and related prototyping tools.

- Pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.

- Good verbal and written English communication skills.

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Efficient LLM Inference & Model Optimization

The Applied Scientist is expected to design rigorous experiments, write strong code, collaborate with engineers, and convert research into deployed inference capabilities.

-

Must-haves : 

- 
PhD in computer science, machine learning, ML systems, computer systems, computer architecture, electrical engineering, applied math, or a closely related field.

Strong publication record or equivalent research artifacts in ML, ML systems, efficient inference, model compression, quantization, distillation, serving systems, or related areas.

- 
Strong hands-on coding ability in Python and PyTorch; ability to move from idea to experiment to prototype quickly.
