title: Staff Core Platform Engineer
description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. 

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

- Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

- Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

- Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register .

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to shape and evolve the core platform architecture that powers n8n — creating scalable, configurable foundations across execution, infrastructure, and frontend platform so 80+ product engineers and our open-source community can build confidently across cloud and self-hosted deployments.

Working across our platform teams, you’ll bring architectural coherence to the systems they jointly own and help us make the right long-term technical decisions as n8n scales:

Architectural direction across Core Platform

- Drive architecture across the two Core Platform teams, ensuring execution, infrastructure, data, and frontend platform systems evolve as a coherent whole rather than independent components.

- Design highly adaptable backend foundations that support different workloads, deployment models, shared product team needs, and future scale without creating unnecessary complexity.

- Partner with the FE platform workstream on core canvas architecture, real-time communication, performance, plugin contracts, and other platform primitives used by product teams.

Execution, distributed systems & data foundations

- Evolve core subsystems including durable workflow execution and state, orchestration, queue and task distribution, worker management, scheduling, and horizontal scaling.

- Design for correctness and resilience across distributed environments, including failure modes, idempotency, state transitions, tenant isolation, and reliability guarantees.

- Shape our data and persistence architecture, including database scaling, sharding, migration strategies, deployment abstractions, and long-term operational maintainability.

Platform architecture & engineering enablement

- Lead consequential technical decisions through clear proposals and RFCs, making trade-offs explicit and aligning engineers and stakeholders around durable solutions.

- Define stable platform interfaces and abstractions that reduce coupling, support safe migrations, and make the platform easier for feature teams to build on.

- Mentor engineers across all engineering teams through design reviews, pairing, and technical guidance, raising the bar for architecture, system design, and maintainability.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves 

- 🏗️ Staff-level architectural ownership: You have a track record of leading architecture across multiple systems or teams, including migrations, re-architectures, or foundational platform initiatives with long-term organizational impact.

- 🧠 Systems thinking: You reason deeply about invariants, correctness, failure modes, boundaries, and trade-offs, and you’re comfortable making decisions where there is no obviously perfect solution.

- ⚙️ Configurable systems at scale: You’ve designed highly configurable, adaptable systems that serve multiple use cases or operating modes without becoming brittle or excessively complex.

- 🌐 Distributed systems depth: You’ve designed and operated distributed systems involving concepts such as asynchronous processing, idempotency, state machines, queues, consistency, and resilience.

- 🗄️ Data architecture at scale: You’ve worked on data-intensive systems where persistence, performance, isolation, migrations, and operational reliability were meaningful architectural concerns.

- 🛠️ TypeScript & Node.js depth: You have strong TypeScript experience and have built substantial backend systems with Node.js beyond conventional CRUD applications.

- 🤝 Cross-team technical leadership: You influence through technical judgment, clear communication, RFCs, design reviews, and mentorship, helping multiple teams converge on better solutions without relying on formal authority.

- 🧱 Platform enablement mindset: You care about creating clear contracts, abstractions, and developer experiences that allow other engineers to move faster and more safely.

- 🧹 Long-horizon engineering: You’re energized by modularization, migrations, refactoring, and evolving existing systems while keeping the product and engineering organization moving.

Nice-to-haves 

- 🧰 Workflow, orchestration or devtools experience: You’ve worked on workflow engines, orchestration platforms, developer tools, or infrastructure-heavy SaaS products.

- 🖥️ Frontend platform architecture: You’ve worked with architecture-heavy frontend systems such as canvas applications, plugin systems, real-time applications, web workers, or complex rendering environments.

- 🧾 Durable execution patterns: You’ve designed or operated systems using event sourcing, sagas, durable execution, or related state-management patterns.

- 👥 Multi-tenant architecture: You’ve designed systems where tenant isolation, resource management, data boundaries, or noisy-neighbour concerns were important.

- 🌍 Open-source experience: You’ve contributed to or maintained open-source software and understand the additional pressure around public contracts and backward compatibility.

- 📈 Large-scale SaaS exposure: You’ve operated systems at meaningful scale or worked in environments where reliability and architectural decisions had broad customer impact.

- 🧩 Monolith → modular migrations: You’ve decomposed monolithic systems or led incremental architectural migrations without preventing product teams from continuing to ship.

- ☁️ Multi-deployment awareness: You’ve designed products that need to work consistently across both managed cloud and self-hosted environments.

- 🔭 Observability mindset: You think about instrumentation, debugging, incident response, rollout safety, and operability as part of system design rather than an afterthought.

- 🧪 Strong CS grounding: You bring deep knowledge of distributed systems concepts, consistency models, consensus, formal methods, or similarly rigorous approaches to system correctness.

Why join us? 

At n8n, you’ll work on the foundations that almost every product experience depends on. You’ll have influence across two Core Platform teams, helping shape how our execution engine, infrastructure, data architecture, and frontend platform evolve together as both our product and engineering organization scale.

This is a Staff role with real architectural leverage: you’ll tackle problems that span team boundaries, evolve systems that already operate at meaningful scale, and create platform capabilities that make 80+ engineers more effective. You’ll do that in a remote-first environment that values autonomy, thoughtful experimentation, and engineers who influence through strong technical judgment rather than hierarchy.

Sound like the kind of platform challenge you want to own?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. 

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work. 

Our company language is English. 

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ( https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35 ). 

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future. 

Benefits 

- Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

- Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

- Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

- Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

- US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

- Health & wellness 🩺 –

- Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

- US : Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

- Future planning 💰 –

- Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

- US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

- Financial security 🛡️ –

- Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

- US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

- Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

- A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

- Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

- Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

- Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

* Country-specific details are provided in your contract.

title: Junior Field Sales Executive (m/f/d) - Munich
description:
About us: 

Saltz is an online food marketplace serving restaurants across multiple European markets. We help chefs and restaurants discover and source products from trusted local and international suppliers.

At Saltz, we believe the best ingredients should be accessible through one seamless marketplace experience. Restaurants purchase directly from Saltz and are fully supported across sales, logistics, customer support, account management, and claims handling. Through our catalogue and platform, we provide visibility into sourcing origins and product information, helping chefs make informed purchasing decisions and discover trusted suppliers worldwide.

We recently closed a €20M Series A backed by leading European venture funds. Our vision is to build the modern infrastructure layer for foodservice commerce - building the new standard for how the world sources food. 

About the role: 

Own Saltz.App expansion in your city! You’ll find and contact new venues, meet chefs and managers, show how the app works, and support their orders, from cozy lunch spots to Michelin-level places. We’ll train you, and give you room to own your day and your results. 

You don't need a sales degree, you need grit, passion for gastronomy, and the drive to grow.

What your days will look like: 

- You’ll be out in the field, visiting restaurants and kitchens. Your mission is to introduce chefs and owners to a marketplace that actually makes their lives easier

- You’ll manage about 10–15 meetings a week and you’ll be responsible for following up and making sure no one is left hanging

- You will plan your weekly schedule (with guidance when needed) and work towards hitting or exceeding targets

- You’ll show chefs a demo of our application, in their own environment, how Saltz makes ordering simple and reliable

- You’ll use our CRM (don't worry, we’ll teach you!) and other tools to keep notes on your progress so the whole team can support you

What you need: 

- Whether you’ve run a kitchen, managed a bar, or worked as a concierge, you understand the fast-paced world of gastronomy. Career changers are welcomed! If you’ve done sales internships or part-time customer roles, that’s a huge plus too

- You’re energized by being out in the field, walking into kitchens, and building face-to-face relationships with chefs and managers

- Very good oral and written German and English skills

- You’re comfortable leading a conversation. You know how to listen, solve problems, and confidently seal the deal

- Bonus: You speak other languages fluently in addition to German or English

What you get: 

- OTE 52.000€ - 56.000€+ and it is uncapped, so your earnings grow with your performance. Base: 36.000€ - 42.000€

- 30 days of paid time off - because recharging is part of performing at your best

- front-row access to the gastronomy world: from new restaurant openings and tastings to pop-up events, you'll be close in the industry you're selling to

- The hardware you need to get started

- Autonomy and trust to manage your own workflow

- Work with and be supported by mature, intelligent, entrepreneurial and fun people who are leading experts in their fields, driven by their passion for the industry

- A great place to build your first sales career, as you'll learn by doing, hit real milestones, and have people around you who've done it before

Interview Process 

We aim to keep our process fast, transparent, and focused on getting to know you.

- Intro Chat (30 min) – A conversation with our Talent Acquisition Manager to learn more about you, your motivations, and what you're looking for next.

- Interview with Head of Sales (30 min) – A discussion with our Head of Sales to explore your previous experience and your sales approach.

- Interview with Team Leader (30 min) – A final conversation about the day-to-day realities of the role: the challenges you'd be taking on, how you'd approach them, and how you'd work with the rest of the team.

- Offer 🎉 – If everything aligns, we’ll move quickly with an offer and welcome you to the team.

This is where you can accelerate your growth by solving complex challenges and broadening your skillset.

Join us to create impact for our future in an exciting new chapter, owning your success and contributing to shared goals. We actively talk about technology and adhere to our key technology principles that have guided us this far. We are growing and have ambitious plans to expand across Europe , employing the best minds and technology to let us do this.

The impact you’ll have: 

Lead Software Engineers at loveholidays will contribute to and develop expertise in:

- Supplier integration systems that process vast amounts of data

- Industry leading bespoke, high performance search and recommendation systems

- Sophisticated real time pricing systems

- ML-backed marketing optimisation systems

- Complex domain modelling and implementation of booking payment, fulfilment and management systems

- AI-powered solutions to assist customers pre and post booking

- Best in class, modern user experience through web and mobile applications

For a better understanding of our work, refer to some of our blog posts .

Or our open source contributions:

- github.com/loveholidays/ripley 

- github.com/loveholidays/phrasebook 

- github.com/loveholidays/po-test 

As part of our tech culture we continuously improve our time to delivery, reducing errors and generally leaving things better than you found them.

Your day-to-day: 

- Adoption of our engineering principles 

- Building and running services at scale in the cloud

- Collaborating with engineers, designers, product managers within and outside of the team

- Providing technical leadership and guidance

- Understanding the wider context of the business and designing system architectures that meet short and long term business goals

- Mentoring and growing your team

Your skillset: 

- Proven ability to lead people from a technical and cultural perspective

- You have proven experience in building scalable and high-performance applications, employing cutting edge algorithms, software design and technologies to do so.

- You enjoy collaborating with other engineers through pair programming.

- Observability

- Web services, REST, HTTP

- Containers, cloud

- Testing, reliability, monitoring

- Strong knowledge in building and owning application end-to-end, from inception to maintenance, to retirement

- Designing systems that scale

- Expertise in some of our main programming languages - TypeScript, Java, Golang, Rust, Python

- You have extensive experience coding in Go and Java.

description:
We’re Heidi. 

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The Role 

What you’ll do 

As our Design Quality & Compliance Engineer , you’ll sit at the heart of Heidi’s mission to make world-class care faster and safer through intelligent, compliant technology. Reporting into the Legal & Regulatory Affairs team, but working day-to-day within Engineering, you’ll be the key link ensuring our agile software development practices remain fully aligned with global medical device and information security standards.

Your core mission is to help ensure that our software design and development activities meet global medical device requirements, leading the practical implementation of IEC 62304 (software lifecycle), ISO 14971 (risk management), and ISO 13485 (quality management systems) within an agile, iterative environment. You’ll help shape how design inputs, verification, validation, and risk controls are captured, reviewed, and evidenced.

This is a hybrid role for someone who can masterfully implement compliance within a modern, agile software culture, enabling engineering teams to build quickly and safely, while ensuring every release stands up to regulatory scrutiny.

What you'll do 

Drive Medical Device Design Control Processes 

- Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of design control processes across the software lifecycle in alignment with IEC 62304, ISO 14971, and ISO 13485.

- Partner with engineers and product managers to ensure requirements, risk controls, verification, and validation activities are clearly defined, documented, and traceable.

- Support the creation and maintenance of technical documentation, including requirements specifications, risk management files, verification reports, and change records.

- Support external ISO 13485 and Notified Body audits, with a focus on Design and Development aspects.

- Champion compliance in software development by translating complex and opaque IEC/ISO standards into clear, actionable processes that engineering teams can follow.

What we will look for 

- SaMD Experience : Prior experience working on Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) or other regulated healthtech products, ideally in a start-up or scale-up environment.

- Standards: Strong working knowledge of standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 14971, and ISO 27001, and the ability to apply these in practical, developer-friendly ways.

- Technical Skills: A solid understanding of technical security domains, including cloud security, access control, network security, and secure software development lifecycles.

- Proactive & Detail-Oriented: A commitment to quality and the ability to drive tasks to completion in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

- Collaboration & Communication: Excellent communication skills, enabling you to work effectively with internal teams (engineers, product) and manage external partners (auditors, customers).

- A Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant scientific, engineering, regulatory, legal, or governance discipline is a plus.

How we show up 

- Build for the next decade, not next quarter . Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

- Lead, don't wait . We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

- Follow the evidence . Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

- Own the outcome . Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

- Ship, measure, go again . A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

- Live in clinicians' reality . Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi? 

You’ll join a team focused on real-world impact over imaginary valuations and glossy PR. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders, and designers who’ve felt the moral and practical toll of what non-care feels like. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose to build something that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognise that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. The work is hard, but you will trust and admire the people you work beside, and rest easy knowing you’re doing the defining work of your career.

We take care of you.

description:

We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team.

To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers .

Enterprise Solutions Manager, Managed by Industrious

About Managed by Industrious

For the last decade, companies with real workplace needs have solved them the hard way: building an internal real estate team, running a self-delivery project with a dozen different vendors, and hoping it all comes together on time. Managed by Industrious exists to break that model. We combine the operational expertise we've built running premium flexible workspace at scale with tailored, single-tenant solutions, so landlords and enterprise clients get a fully outsourced, hospitality-driven workplace, without the internal headcount or the fragmented delivery chain. It's our newest product line, and one of the fastest growing parts of the business.

The Opportunity

We're at the point where the model is proven and the demand is real, but the playbook is still being written. This role sits right at the center of that build. You'll take opportunities from a client's first conversation with us through to a signed deal and a live, operating space, working closely with the GM of Enterprise Solutions and a small, senior, fast-moving team. You won't be slotting into a fully formed process. You'll be helping define what that process becomes as the business scales across Europe.

Why Industrious

We've spent the last decade becoming the highest quality provider of flexible workspace in the market. Managed by Industrious is us taking that same operational rigor and hospitality standard and applying it to a completely different kind of client relationship, one where you're building a bespoke, single-tenant solution rather than selling into an existing space. It's early enough that you'll genuinely shape how this product line operates in Europe, and established enough that you're doing it with the backing, brand, and delivery capability of a company that's already proven this model works.

What Might Your Day Look Like

A client reaches out needing a dedicated space for a growing team, say 150 people, in a European city where we don't yet have a foothold for them. You get on the phone to understand what they're actually solving for: who's working there, what the culture needs to feel like, what's non-negotiable and what's flexible. You bring our design team in as a thought partner and land on a brief. From there you're in the market, working with brokerage channels to shortlist two or three sites that could work, and touring the client through them alongside you.

Once you've got a favorite or two, you're building pricing, which means understanding the landlord's lease terms on one side and our own design, build, and operating costs on the other, and pulling all of it into a proposal that's honest about what it will take to deliver. If the client is in, you're moving toward signing high level commercial terms with them and with the landlord at close to the same time, then spending the following weeks getting both to a final agreement.

The moment ink is dry, you're handing a clean, well-briefed project to design and construction, and making sure everything you promised the client is something the business can actually deliver, on time and on budget.

What You Will Own

- You will manage the full lifecycle of a Managed by Industrious deal, from the first client conversation through to a live, operating space.

- You will translate what a client says they need into a workable, costed real estate and design solution, working closely with our design team to get there.

- You will lead landlord and broker relationships on every deal, negotiating lease terms that protect us and set the project up to succeed.

- You will build the commercial model and client-facing proposal for each opportunity, pulling together lease costs, build costs, and operating costs into a single coherent picture.

- You will run point on the transaction itself, from high level commercial terms through to final signed agreements with both the client and the landlord.

- You will hand projects to our design and construction teams with everything they need to deliver on what was promised, and stay close enough through delivery that nothing gets lost in the handoff.

- You will help build our own playbook as you go, documenting what works so the next deal moves faster than the last one.

- You will generate your own opportunities when the pipeline calls for it. This isn't a role where you only work what's handed to you.

You Will Love This Role If

- You get real energy from being the person who makes a complex deal actually happen, not just one piece of it.

- You're comfortable holding two sides of a negotiation at once, a client who needs to be won over and a landlord who needs to be managed, and you don't lose the thread of either.

- You'd rather help build a process than inherit a finished one, and you're not precious about the fact that things will change again next month.

- You want to be trusted with real accountability early, and you're motivated by seeing a project through from a first phone call to a space full of people.

- You're genuinely energized by the idea that you're building something inside a much larger, established company, without giving up the pace or ownership of a smaller one.

This Role Is Probably Not For You If

- You want a role with a fixed, well worn process to execute against. This one is still being written, and you'll be one of the people writing it.

- You'd rather stay on one side of a deal. This role asks you to be genuinely fluent on both the client side and the real estate side, not just conversant in one.

- Ambiguity slows you down rather than something you push through. Our team is small and things move fast, so you'll often be figuring it out as you go.

- You're looking for a role where business development isn't part of the job. When the pipeline needs it, you'll be picking up the phone yourself.

What We Are Looking For

- A track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder deals or projects through to completion, ideally where you were the person holding the whole thing together rather than one workstream within it.

- Strong client-facing instincts. You can sit across from a senior stakeholder, understand what they actually need underneath what they're asking for, and turn that into a solution they trust.

- Comfort working both sides of a transaction. Experience with landlords, brokers, or portfolio-side real estate work is a strong plus, alongside client or account-facing experience.

- Someone who's excited by the idea of building a new business line inside an established, high quality company, and who wants the accountability that comes with that.

Compensation
We offer a competitive base salary, depending on experience, skills, and role alignment in addition to eligibility for an annual bonus and participation in our long-term incentive program. But compensation is only part of the story.

At Industrious, we believe a good workplace supports the whole person. Not just the work they do. Our benefits are designed to give people the stability, flexibility, and room to grow that make a career sustainable.

Our Benefits May Include: 

- Heavily subsidized medical, dental, and vision plans to support you and your family

- Flexible paid time off, to maintain balance

- Paid parental leave to help you welcome a new child and focus on what matters most

- Annual professional development grants so you can keep learning and growing

- 401(k) retirement savings program to support long-term financial wellbeing

- Wellness initiatives and additional employee support programs

- Specific benefits may vary by role, location, and eligibility requirements

Equal Employment Opportunity: Industrious is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We have a long-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. 

About the Role: 

Hi there! We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive III to join our Sales team.

Our sales team is tenured, technically curious, and genuinely invested in doing right by the customer, not just closing the deal in front of them. We partner closely across the business, and we operate with a lot of trust: you're given real ownership over your territory, and you're expected to bring your own judgment to how you build it.

This role carries real weight. You'll be responsible for a book of enterprise accounts where the deals are complex, the buying committees are large, and the technical bar is high. There's meaningful room here to shape how your territory gets built, not just execute against someone else's plan.

As an Enterprise Account Executive III, you'll own the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, working alongside sales engineering, customer success, and leadership to get complex deals across the line. This role matters because enterprise wins are how Camunda grows its footprint in large, strategic accounts, and how we prove the platform works at scale.

What You Will Do 

- Own and execute the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts, from prospecting through negotiation and close.

- Build and drive strategic account plans that identify whitespace, map stakeholders, and set a realistic path to close.

- Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying committees, including technical, business, and executive buyers.

- Partner with sales engineering and customer success to build technical credibility and ensure smooth handoff after close.

- Represent Camunda's value to senior leaders and technical buyers, tailoring the pitch to what each audience actually cares about.

- Forecast accurately and manage pipeline health with discipline, not optimism.

What You Will Bring to the Role 

- Significant experience closing enterprise software deals end-to-end, ideally six figures or more, with a track record across multiple full sales cycles. You know what it takes to move a deal from first meeting to signature without losing momentum.

- Comfort navigating complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise environments. You've worked deals with C-suite, IT, legal, and procurement in the room at the same time, and you know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.

- Strong territory and account planning instincts. You can build a plan independently, not just work from a list handed to you, and you know how to prioritize where your time actually pays off.

- The ability to sell technical products credibly. Experience with process automation, integration platforms, middleware, or similar technical software is a real advantage here, since you'll regularly be in the room with engineering and IT buyers.

- Negotiation experience under genuine pressure. You know where to hold firm and where to flex, and you can explain your reasoning either way.

- A relationship-building style that goes beyond the transaction. You've had customers treat you as an advisor, not just a vendor, and you know what it took to earn that.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP) .

Benefits & Perks 

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

- Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

- In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets , including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

- Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027 .

- Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

- Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process : Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here 

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application! 

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

title: Product Strategy Analyst - New Customers
description:
Product Strategy Analyst - New Customers (UK)

Hybrid in London, UK

We’re looking for a Product Strategy Analyst 

You'll shape how new businesses become iwoca customers – the sign-up flow, the documents we ask for, and the models that decide who gets funded and on what terms.

The company 

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team 

The New Customers team owns everything from a business's first application to a funded loan: the application flow, the logic that routes each application, the documents we ask customers for, and the models that set loan amounts and pricing.

The team is cross-functional – data scientists, analysts, and software engineers – and sets its own goals and direction. It partners closely with credit risk on the trade-offs behind every lending decision. Knowledge sharing is central to how the team works, supported by regular forums to share findings, and dedicated research and development time.

The role 

As the Product Strategy Analyst, you'll run the projects that shape how new businesses join iwoca. You'll steer which experiments the team runs, weighing short-term gains against longer-term bets that compound over time, with customer lifetime value as your key metric.

- Judgement and strategy. You'll set iwoca's new-customer lending strategy, weighing trade-offs between speed, friction, risk, and decision accuracy. You'll identify drop-off points and commercial opportunities across the conversion funnel, and propose the initiatives that address them.

- Challenge and experimentation. You'll design, run, and interpret controlled experiments on changes to the customer journey and new loan features. You'll apply statistical thinking so decisions rest on evidence.

- Autonomy and growth. You'll manage analytical and strategic projects end-to-end, sharing findings and recommendations directly with senior leadership. You'll partner with the Team Lead to shape the team's long-term roadmap, with the expectation of growing into a Team Lead role yourself.

The requirements 

Essential:

- Commercial analytics. You've worked in strategy, analytics, product, finance, or consulting. You understand how to use data to make commercial decisions on revenue, cost, or risk that the business acts on.

- Quantitative foundations. You have a STEM background (degree or equivalent) in mathematics, statistics, physics, engineering, or similar. You reason about uncertainty and calibration, grounded in the underlying statistics.

- First-principles thinking. You break complex problems into their core parts, decide which to tackle first, and iterate systematically to a solution.

- Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

- AI leverage. You've built AI workflows, or used AI to produce analysis or prototypes beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

Bonus:

- Experimentation. You have designed, run, and interpreted controlled experiments, including A/B tests, to inform product or policy decisions.

- Cross-functional delivery. You have worked closely with engineering or data science teams to get analytical insight into production systems.

- Customer journey analytics. You have analysed and improved a customer journey, balancing conversion, risk, and long-term value.

- Coding abilities. You can code for analysis, automation, or prototypes - whether directly or via AI coding tools like Claude Code.

The salary 

We expect to pay from £60,000 to £80,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture 

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices 

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

- Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

- Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits 

- Flexible working hours.

- Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

- A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

- 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

- A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

- Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

- 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

- An employee equity incentive scheme.

- Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

- Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

- Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

- A learning and development budget for everyone.

- Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

- Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Implementation Specialist - UKI Market
description:
About Us 

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem .

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About The Role

The Implementation Team is responsible for the onboarding of all our Premium and Pro customers on the Perk platform, and providing recommendations to optimize the customer experience. We guide new customers from signup to launch, providing consultative, administrative, technical, and educational support to maximize the customer’s experience with the Perk platform.

As an Implementation Specialist, you must be a change management and consultative expert who digs in deeply to understand customer needs and provides customers with a tailored solution that meets their needs. You'll use your platform expertise and stakeholder management skills to build a bridge between platform capabilities and customer expectations. In order to serve the customer beyond the bounds of the platform you'll produce a thoughtful rollout plan that accurately covers the scope of the specific customer’s needs, including immediate travel and a long term success. As an IS, you'll be both a mentor and an example to the Implementation team and across the Revenue organization.
The IS ensures that new customers are fully prepared to use Perk to book their business travel, by executing platform configuration, providing technical support and troubleshooting, and user readiness. This includes configuring customer accounts to their specifications and requirements, providing proactive support on any integrations, as well as coordinating and executing tailored training sessions with key customer stakeholders.

What You’ll Do

- Provide the first impression of Perk to all customers in your portfolio and serve as the first point of contact for customers during the implementation process.

- Define the best onboarding strategy, leading the change within the customer´s org and providing support in any technical aspects related to the integrations and account setup. That means preparing and executing onboarding plans through the use of project management.

- Carry out consultative conversations with customers to collect their requirements.

- Proactively providing customers with recommendations with your experience and data-driven best practice recommendations.

- Drive customer onboarding forward by providing influential recommendations and creating urgency for customer stakeholders.

- Manage the rollout of a new platform for your customers; providing guides, templates, and recommendations to the customer for how to ensure adoption and long-term success of the platform.

- Take full ownership of timeline, rollout plan and handling of the account while the account is in implementation, including directing work through the internal team supporting customers and, in essence, being the subject matter expert in the area of change management.

- Coordinate and conduct training sessions for newly onboarded customers, including executive-level stakeholders and company-wide training.

- Validate customer configuration and account satisfaction by monitoring customer booking behaviour post-implementation and proactively offering support or recommendations.

- Embrace a pattern of execution, assess, improve, repeat and evolve as the team and organization evolve.

- Take on additional projects related to IS Team alignment with other departments. Ensure that project team members have a clear understanding of timelines, tasks, risks and issues.

What We’re Looking For

- Demonstrated relevant professional experience, either as an Implementation Specialist, Sales, Customer Care, Account Management, Project Management or other related roles.

- Demonstrated overachievement against targets/goals & expectations in previous roles.

- English fluency is essential; strong comprehension, writing, and verbal communication skills are required. 

Additional attributes of an Implementation Specialist

- Proven track record of successfully managing and delivering complex projects.

- Although Implementation Specialists need to be tech-savvy and understand some basic technical concepts in the area of integrations and open APIs, they do not need to be experts in this area right away.

- Solid level of Project Management, Persuasive Communication, Technical/Business Acumen and Customer Centric Quality Control skills.

- A customer-first mentality; you’ll focus on ensuring a smooth onboarding for your customers and must understand what they need to be a happy customer for the long term.

- Willingness to seek out ways to improve and develop a mindset of continuous improvement.

- Excited by challenges and have a personal drive to make a difference.

- Excellent problem-solving and process optimization skills, with the ability to identify inefficiencies and implement effective solutions.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and managing competing priorities.

What We Offer

- Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

- Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

- Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

- Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

- Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

- Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

- Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

- Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

- Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

- Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

- Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

- Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

- Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

- Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

- Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

The Process 

1) A 20-minute screening call with our Talent Acquisition Partner

2) A 1-hour practical assessment presentation with our Hiring Manager 

3) A 30-minute interview with our IS Country Manager

4) A 30-minute in-person culture‑fit interview in our Birmingham hub 

AI at Perk 
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work 

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Fullstack Developer with Backend Focus
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 

The team

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

About the role

We are looking for a fullstack engineer with a strong backend center of gravity who enjoys designing reliable systems, thinking rigorously about correctness, and applying strong software fundamentals to real-world operational problems.

Platform touches both client facing features as well as internal tooling. The capabilities we own are the ones our users touch most often: how workflows and dashboards are configured, how fast a screen full of exceptions loads, how consistently permissions behave, how reliably a release reaches production. When the platform is right, every product team ships better software faster, and that lands directly with the tens of thousands of people who use blp every day. Platform decisions here are judged by what they do for our users, not by internal elegance.

What you'll do

- Build the Foundation: Design and develop the shared backend services and APIs that our product teams depend on, with clear contracts and abstractions that fit how they actually work.

- Drive User Impact: Work with product teams and business stakeholders to understand where the platform is holding them back, communicate trade-offs openly, and turn that into concrete improvements our users feel.

- Own Reliability and Correctness: Build and operate systems with a strong focus on robustness, and improve them continuously through careful analysis and iteration. Managing entropy in a complex system is part of the job, and we expect you to adapt accordingly.

- Build Great Software: Write clean, maintainable, high-quality code across the stack. Conduct code reviews and contribute to a culture of technical excellence.

- Shape Architecture: Collaborate on system design, tech stack decisions, and platform boundaries, optimizing for scalability, performance, and maintainability.

- Lead and Influence: Guide technical direction on major initiatives such as migrations and platform capabilities, and mentor team members along the way.

- Promote Innovation and Collaboration: Work closely with colleagues to continuously improve processes, tools, and team practices, fostering a culture of learning and growth.

The tech stack includes Golang, React/TypeScript, Python, various ML models, MySQL, F#, Docker images deployed on a Kubernetes cluster in our cloud infrastructure (GCS, AWS, or Azure), and GitHub CI/CD.

What you'll bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 5+ years of experience in a software engineering role, with a clear backend focus.

- Genuine fullstack capability: comfortable working in a modern React/TypeScript codebase, even if backend is where you do your deepest work.

- Experience with functional programming concepts or languages.

- Passionate about software craftsmanship: strong understanding of core engineering principles including type systems, composition, testing, Clean Code, and Clean Architecture.

- Product thinking: ability to translate business problems into precise requirements, specifications, and ultimately into code.

- Entrepreneurial mindset: link your daily work to team and company goals, balance cost and benefit, deliver high-quality solutions efficiently.

- Ownership: take responsibility for your technical work, for the platform we build, and for the team we shape.

- Abstraction and efficient communication: simplify complex systems, identify core concepts, and communicate complex ideas clearly.

Nice to have

- Familiarity with distributed systems, Kubernetes, or cloud infrastructure.

- Experience with ERP systems, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes.

- Background in a platform, infrastructure, or developer experience team.

- Experience with large-scale migrations or incremental modernization of an existing codebase.

description:
Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place! 

E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of space-powered Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are fundamentally changing the design, economics, manufacturing, coverage limitations and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems.

By building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system—with a unique antenna design, highly sustainable spacecraft system and low-cost, small portable end-user devices—we can extend global satellite coverage, capacity and connectivity beyond legacy space services to provide a new kind of IoT platform that lets users sense, track, connect and act on information gathered, anywhere.

We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to saving space, protecting our planet and turning connectivity into actionable intelligence.

We are looking for a talented and experienced Senior Digital Hardware Design Engineer to join our hardware engineering team. You will play a key role in the design, development, and delivery of complex digital hardware solutions for high-performance products. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will take ownership of designs from concept through to production, driving technical excellence across the full development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities 

- Design and implement digital hardware including high-speed interfaces, signal processing, and switching/routing architectures.

- Develop, simulate, and verify RTL designs, ensuring correctness, timing closure, and design robustness.

- Define and review hardware architectures, contributing to system-level design decisions and trade-off analyses.

- Produce and review detailed design documentation, including specifications, schematics, and test plans.

- Perform functional simulation, static timing analysis, and synthesis targeting FPGAs and/or ASICs.

- Collaborate with firmware, software, and systems engineers to ensure seamless hardware/software integration.

- Support hardware verification and validation activities, including lab bring-up and debugging.

- Contribute to design reviews, code reviews, and continuous improvement of engineering processes

- Collaborate with manufacturing teams to ensure seamless design for high volume manufacture and test

- Work with component manufacturers and distributors to ensure longevity of manufacture.

- Experience with Altium Designer

- Design principles for operation in harsh environments.

Required Skills & Experience 

- Degree (BEng/MEng/BSc or equivalent) in Electronic Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline

- Solid understanding of digital design fundamentals including clocking strategies, CDC (clock domain crossing), reset architecture, and timing constraints.

- Experience with FPGA design flows using tools such as Vivado, Quartus, or equivalent.

- Familiarity with simulation tools such as ModelSim, Questa, or similar.

- Experience writing and executing hardware test plans and debug at the board level using lab equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analysers, protocol analysers).

- Strong understanding of high-speed PCB design considerations and signal integrity principles.

Desirable Skills 

- Five or more years experience with high speed digital design.

- Experience with Altium Designer

- Experience with Hyperlynx

- Accelerated life testing

Additional Requirements 
This is a fast-paced, high-impact environment - flexibility to occasionally work extended hours or weekends during critical periods is expected.

title: Senior Counsel, Privacy & Product (Hybrid)
description:
Location: London, UK – Hybrid (2 days per week in office)

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team that includes and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the job 
OpenTable is looking for a highly motivated, practical, and business-oriented Senior Counsel, Privacy & Product to join our Legal team. You will serve as a trusted advisor to OpenTable’s Product, Engineering, Security, Commercial, Partnerships, and Marketing teams, providing strategic and practical counsel across product development, privacy and data protection, artificial intelligence, information security, consumer protection, and related regulatory matters. You will also serve as OpenTable’s Deputy Privacy Officer, helping lead and operationalize OpenTable’s global privacy program and serving as a key liaison with Booking Holdings, Inc. (BHI) on privacy and data protection matters. This role is ideal for a lawyer who enjoys working closely with commercial, product and technical teams, navigating emerging areas of law, and developing practical solutions that enable responsible innovation at scale.

Responsibilities 

- Serve as a primary legal partner to OpenTable’s Product, Engineering, Security, Commercial, Partnerships, and Marketing teams, providing end-to-end counseling on new products, features, data uses, integrations, consumer experiences, and other strategic initiatives.

- Serve as Deputy Privacy Officer for OpenTable, helping lead and operationalize OpenTable’s global privacy program and serving as a key liaison with BHI on privacy strategy, governance, regulatory developments, and group-wide privacy initiatives.

- Advise on global privacy and data protection requirements and embed privacy-by-design principles into OpenTable’s products and operations, including counseling on data collection, use, sharing, retention, consent, personalization, and consumer rights.

- Provide strategic legal guidance on the development, deployment, procurement, and use of artificial intelligence and emerging technologies, including generative AI and AI-powered product features, and help develop scalable AI governance frameworks as the regulatory landscape evolves.

- Provide strategic legal advice and guidance to Product teams regarding product development, launch, and sunsetting, with strong focus on legal risks related to data privacy, cybersecurity, data usage and ownership, consumer protection, and marketing. 

- Partner closely with OpenTable’s Information Security team on cybersecurity and data security matters, including product and vendor security risk, security requirements, incident response, potential data breaches, regulatory obligations, and remediation.

- Identify and address emerging product, privacy, AI, security, consumer protection, and regulatory risks; draft and negotiate related agreements and terms; and develop scalable legal processes, policies, playbooks, and disclosures that enable the business to innovate responsibly.

Minimum Qualifications 

- 8+ years of relevant legal experience, including significant experience advising on privacy, data protection, technology, and product matters, preferably in-house at a technology, consumer, marketplace, or other high-growth company.

- Deep knowledge of U.S. and global privacy and data protection laws, including GDPR and U.S. state privacy laws, as well as global consumer protection laws, with demonstrated experience translating complex legal and regulatory requirements into practical product and business guidance.

- Significant experience providing product counseling, including partnering directly with Product and Engineering teams on new products, features, data uses, and technology initiatives from development through launch.

- Experience supporting or helping lead a global privacy program, including privacy governance, policies, compliance frameworks, and cross-functional implementation.

- Experience advising on information security and cybersecurity matters, including security requirements, incident response, and related regulatory obligations.

- Strong judgment, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with demonstrated ability to assess risk, navigate ambiguity, and provide practical advice to cross-functional teams and senior leaders.

Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience advising on artificial intelligence and emerging technologies, including legal and regulatory considerations associated with developing, deploying, or procuring AI-enabled products and services.

- Experience working within a complex global organization or corporate group and partnering effectively with enterprise-level legal, privacy, security, compliance, or governance functions.

- Social events & Thursday happy hours

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. - Oversee compliance and health & safety requirements across the portfolio

- Support the team with major works, contractor management and other complex property matters

- Provide leadership and direction while remaining hands-on and accessible to the team

- Contribute to wider business strategy, operational improvements and future growth

What We're Looking For (Essential) 

- At least 5 years' experience in private residential leasehold/block management, covering service charge budgets, service charge accounts, major works, Section 20, leasehold legislation, contractor management, compliance, health & safety, and the Building Safety Act

- Strong practical experience managing residential block portfolios

- Strong knowledge of leasehold and service-charge management

- Experience overseeing budgets, accounts and financial matters associated with managed properties

- Good working knowledge of the Building Safety Act and relevant building safety requirements

- Strong understanding of compliance and health & safety within residential property management

- Excellent organisational and time-management skills

- Strong communication and client-management skills

- Ability to deal confidently with complex or escalated matters

- Clean UK driving licence and access to your own vehicle

Nice to Have 

- TPI/IRPM qualification or equivalent professional qualification

- Previous supervisory or team-management experience

- Experience mentoring or developing Property Managers

- Experience with major works and Section 20 consultation

- Substantial block-management experience and ready to take a first formal team-leadership role will also be considered

Compensation 

Salary: £48,000–£55,000 per year

Benefits: Company events, company pension, free parking, work from home

What is it like being a Dwell-er? 

Feel free to check out Dwelly Core Principles . That’s about what we believe in, how we operate and make decisions.

What we offer is not a fancy office or a static workplace. Instead, this is solving one of worlds’ most complex problems in the largest consumer industry in the world (residential rentals), to improve the experience for >30% of households (>5M in the UK, and >100M including EU and US) that live in rental homes.

This is about disrupting the largest, most antiquated industry in the world, with one of the strongest operational and technical teams that exist in the UK and the EU. We work hard, and we shoot for extremely ambitious results. But we want people to be proud of what they’ve built and be able to look back and say one day “hell yeah, that was me that did it all”.

- Customer obsession rather than competitive focus

- Passion for invention

- Operational excellence

- Long-term thinking

We’re hiring our first Enterprise Account Executives in EMEA to build Pallet’s commercial presence across Europe.

This is a highly consultative enterprise sales role focused on educating customers on an entirely new category of AI-powered workflow automation.

- Build and maintain a 3x-4x qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound execution while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.

- Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe’s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.

- Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet’s AI agent capabilities.

- Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.

- Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.

- Document repeatable customer use cases and market feedback to shape Pallet’s product roadmap and international GTM strategy.

- Help establish Pallet as the leading AI platform for enterprise logistics across Europe.

What we’re looking for 

- 8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS or enterprise logistics sales experience.

- Business-fluent Spanish you can run discovery, negotiate and present to executives in Spanish. 

- Proven track record of consistently closing six- and seven-figure enterprise software agreements.

- Strong consultative selling and value-based sales methodology.

- Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.

- Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.

- Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.

- Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.

- Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.

- Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.

Experience selling into logistics, supply chain, transportation, or warehouse operations is strongly preferred but not required. Candidates without logistics experience should demonstrate an ability to quickly learn operational workflows and become trusted advisors to customers.

Working model 

Working hours are generally 9:00am-6:00pm London time , providing full coverage of the European business day while maintaining regular collaboration with our San Francisco headquarters.

You’ll typically spend:

- Mornings and early afternoons working directly with European customers and prospects.

- Late afternoons collaborating with our US-based Sales, Product, and Engineering teams during our daily overlap window.

- Approximately 75% of your time traveling across Europe for customer meetings, executive workshops, pilots, and industry events.

Initially this role will be remote. Once Pallet opens its local office, you’ll work from the office five days per week whenever you’re not traveling to customers.

Reporting structure 

You’ll report directly to the General Manager, London for territory strategy, customer relationships, and international expansion.

You’ll also work closely with our Head of Sales , participating in weekly pipeline reviews, forecasting, and sales process alignment with the US team.

Interview Process 

- Chat with Christy - Business Recruiter - 30 mins

- Deal Review - 30 mins

- Discovery Mock Interview - 45-60 mins

- Final Interview - ~3 hours

- Brief Background Check and Reference Check

We move fast, and we’ll keep you informed at every stage of the process.

Compensation 

The estimated compensation range for this role is £100,000-£240,000 OTE , depending on experience and skill set.

Our compensation follows a standard 50/50 enterprise sales structure consisting of base salary and target commission. High performers are eligible for uncapped commission accelerators above quota.

In addition to cash compensation, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and significant growth opportunities as one of our earliest international commercial hires.

Final compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated enterprise sales performance.

Our Benefits 

We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.

- 🩺 Health, Vision, and Dental benefits 

- 🏝️ Take-what-you-need Paid Vacation

- ➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance 

- ❤️‍🩹 Short-Term Disability Coverage

- 💸 Generous salary and equity for all staff

- 🪜 401k option; helping you save for the future

- 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Paid parental leave to support growing families

- 📚 Yearly learning and development stipend

- 🚌 Commuter benefits for Bay Area employees

- 🚘 Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office 

- 🏡 Remote office home stipend to get you comfy in your space

- 🍔 Daily catered lunches provided 

- ✈️ Onboarding trip to San Francisco HQ if you work remotely

- 🥤 Monthly happy hours

- 🎉 Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA 🌴

Workplace Policy 

We are an in-person company. Our offices in San Francisco, New York City and London are where ideas get built, decisions get made, and the team gets stronger. We have invested in making them genuinely great places to spend your day, with catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and people who care about the work and each other.

Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip. 

Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us.

We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, disability status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We prohibit any form of discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring.

Candidate Privacy Notice

Accommodations 

Pallet complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable state or local laws. We will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with a disability during the application process and throughout employment as required by law.
