This is an early-career engineering role for someone who wants to build depth in finance systems, application configuration, data integration, and operational support. You will work with Finance, Finance Technology, Data, and wider Corporate Technology teams to keep planning processes reliable, well-controlled, and easy to operate.

You will have support from more senior engineers for complex design decisions, but you will be expected to work independently for longer periods on well-defined configuration, integration, support, and continuous-improvement tasks. This reflects Checkout’s Engineer 1 expectations: delivering small-to-medium-sized work, supporting common operational flows, communicating clearly, and taking ownership of the quality of what you deliver.

How you’ll make an impact

- Configure, maintain, and enhance Adaptive Planning models, dimensions, versions, levels, accounts, sheets, reports, dashboards, and planning workflows under appropriate guidance.

- Support the delivery of budgeting, forecasting, headcount planning, scenario modelling, and management reporting capabilities for Finance and business stakeholders.

- Build and support data loads and integrations between Adaptive Planning, Workday Financials, Workday HCM, and other approved internal or third-party systems.

- Maintain data mappings, transformation rules, validation checks, and reconciliation processes so that planning data is complete, accurate, and traceable.

- Monitor scheduled loads and integration tasks, investigate failures, and resolve common data or configuration issues within agreed service levels.

- Triage incidents and service requests, identifying root causes and escalating complex or high-risk issues with clear evidence and recommended next steps.

- Partner with Finance stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into maintainable system configuration, reporting, or integration changes.

- Contribute to the assessment and delivery of future analytics data flows, including the potential use of Adaptive Planning data in BigQuery and management analytics.

- Participate in testing, regression testing, release preparation, and controlled deployment of Adaptive Planning changes.

- Follow change-control, access-management, data-quality, and audit requirements relevant to financial systems and planning data.

- Create clear documentation, support guides, data dictionaries, integration runbooks, and knowledge-base articles so that operational knowledge is shared rather than held by one person.

- Identify recurring manual work or failure patterns and propose practical automation and process improvements.

What we’re looking for

Essential experience and skills

- Experience in a finance systems, enterprise applications, data, reporting, or integration environment.

- Practical experience with Workday Adaptive Planning, or strong experience with a comparable planning, performance-management, ERP, or finance application and a clear ability to learn Adaptive quickly.

- Understanding of core finance planning concepts such as budgets, forecasts, actuals, variance analysis, allocations, dimensions, hierarchies, and scenarios.

- Experience configuring or supporting structured data models, application workflows, reports, dashboards, or business rules.

- Ability to work with data imports, exports, mappings, transformations, validations, and reconciliations.

- Strong troubleshooting skills, with the ability to break down an issue, gather evidence, identify likely causes, and communicate findings clearly.

- Good attention to detail and an understanding of why accuracy, access control, auditability, and repeatability matter in finance systems.

- Ability to manage small-to-medium-sized tasks independently while knowing when to ask for help or escalate.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with Finance and Technology stakeholders.

Desirable experience

- Workday Adaptive Planning certification or implementation experience.

- Experience with Adaptive Planning Integration, Planning Data Loader, APIs, or equivalent enterprise planning integration tooling.

- Experience integrating planning systems with Workday Financials, Workday HCM, an ERP, a data warehouse, or a reporting platform.

- Familiarity with SOX controls, financial audit requirements, data privacy, and segregation of duties.

- Experience supporting month-end, budget, forecast, or management-reporting cycles.

- Exposure to Agile delivery, ticket-driven change management, incident management, or service-management practices.

What success looks like

After the first 6–12 months, you will be able to:

- Support common Adaptive Planning configuration, data-load, and reporting requests with limited supervision.

- Diagnose and resolve routine integration or data-quality issues using a structured troubleshooting approach.

- Deliver small-to-medium-sized enhancements from requirement clarification through testing, documentation, and controlled release.

- Explain key planning data flows, mappings, dependencies, and operational controls to Finance and Technology colleagues.

- Improve the reliability or efficiency of at least one recurring planning or finance-technology process.

- Maintain accurate, useful documentation and contribute positively to team ceremonies, reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Working style and behaviours

We are looking for someone who:

- Takes ownership of tasks and follows through on commitments.

- Acts with urgency and accountability when issues affect Finance or business reporting.

- Is curious about how finance processes, data, and technology fit together.

- Communicates clearly, especially when explaining risk, blockers, trade-offs, or support impact.

- Welcomes feedback and actively develops their technical and domain knowledge.

- Collaborates generously and shares knowledge so the team does not depend on a single subject-matter expert.

- Looks for durable automation and simpler operating processes rather than repeatedly working around the same manual problem.

Why join Finance Technology?

You will work on systems that sit at the centre of how Checkout.com plans, forecasts, reports, and makes financial decisions. The role offers the opportunity to develop a broad foundation across enterprise applications, finance processes, integrations, data quality, controls, and automation while working closely with experienced Finance and Technology professionals.

title: Team Lead, Account Development Representatives
description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence? 

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

ABOUT THE ROLE 

Kong is hiring an ADR Team Lead to support our NEMEA region: the UK, Benelux, and Nordics. This is a player-coach role. You'll carry your own pipeline targets while taking an active hand in developing the team around you, especially the newer ADRs still finding their footing.

You'll work closely with, and report into, the Senior Manager for NEMEA. You're shaping how the team operates, not running it solo. Think of this as a high-impact individual contributor role with a leadership layer built in: the natural next step for an ADR who's ready to start making other people better, not just themselves.

Our NEMEA team is already strong. Driven, independent, hitting their numbers. What they need isn't more oversight. They need someone who sharpens how the team works, especially around process and tooling, while making sure newer reps get the support to ramp fast.

You'll report to Oscar Winberg. He moves fast, sets a high bar, and expects people to bring solutions, not just flag problems. He's direct, so you'll always know exactly where you stand, and he expects that same directness back: if you disagree, he wants the pushback, backed by data, not silence. Earn his trust and he'll hand you real ownership. What he won't do is hand-hold, so this role suits someone who'd rather be given room to run than told exactly what to do.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

Carry your own number. You'll hit your own pipeline targets as an active ADR. Your activity and results set the standard for everyone watching. You'll contribute to weekly forecasting alongside the Senior Manager.

Support newer ADRs. You'll be the first point of contact for less tenured reps, helping them ramp faster and build good habits early. You'll help with onboarding alongside the Senior Manager and Enablement, and run regular 1:1s with newer ADRs. Different reps need different things from you, so you'll read where each person is and adjust your coaching accordingly rather than running the same playbook on everyone. You'll help build individual development plans grounded in a real read of each rep's attitude, process, and results, and you'll flag underperformance early, with context, instead of letting it fester.

Coach and upskill the team. You'll support team coaching sessions: live dialling, pitch practice, feedback loops. You'll run or contribute to upskilling initiatives, on your own or with Enablement. You'll share what's working, best practices, sequences, outbound approaches, with the wider team, and give direct, specific feedback often, recognizing strong work and not letting bad habits slide.

Sharpen process and tooling. You'll help spot where the team's workflows and tooling could run more efficiently, and support the Senior Manager in rolling out improvements without stripping reps of their autonomy. You'll be the go-to person for best practice on Salesforce, Outreach, and the team's automation tools.

Contribute to the wider GTM motion. You'll keep strong alignment with your AE partners and take part in pipe review cadences. You'll support the Senior Manager in preparing performance updates and regional insights, and join bi-weekly RD cadences where it makes sense.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING 

- Hands-on ADR or SDR experience. You know what this job feels like from the inside, not just what it looks like from a deck.

- A real coach's instinct. You get energy from making other people better, not just from hitting your own number.

- The ability to juggle competing priorities without dropping the ball. Your own quota, coaching newer reps, and process work will all pull on your time in the same week, and you know how to decide what actually matters right now.

- Strong time management. This is one we screen for directly, not something we assume comes with experience.

- A bias for building. You spot what needs fixing and go build it, rather than working only through a list of tasks someone else handed you.

- Analytical rigor. You make calls based on data, not gut feel, and you're comfortable being specific about why a number moved, including when that number is going the wrong way.

- A track record of top-tier performance that holds up on both counts: the day-to-day discipline that drives it (activity, sequence execution, pipeline hygiene), and the results that discipline produces, quarter over quarter, not just once.

- Real trust with your AE and RD partners, earned through consistency, not just alignment on paper.

- Transparency, especially with leadership, especially when something isn't on track. We'd rather hear it early than find out later.

- The kind of presence the team actually looks up to, not just reports to.

- Comfort in an allbound model with a heavy outbound emphasis.

- Self-awareness and a genuine investment in growing as a leader.

- Language skills relevant to the UK, Benelux, or Nordics are a bonus, not a requirement.

CULTURE AND VALUES 

The EMEA SDR team are weather makers. We don't wait for opportunity, we create it. We're accountable, relentless, and we invest in each other like no other team does.

- Relentless. Energy and intention every day. Every challenge is a chance to get stronger.

- Character. Good humans first. Integrity, humility, and keeping our word.

- Together. No one gets left behind. Differences make us better, not harder to manage.

- Truth. Radical honesty. We say the hard things with care. That's how we move fast.

- Accountable. We own our results, bias toward action, and don't wait to be told.

- Pioneering. We take up space, experiment, and bring creative thinking to every challenge.

In NEMEA specifically, we operate in mature markets. We don't manufacture urgency, we earn entry by knowing the landscape better than the prospect does. We're pipeline gardeners: patient, precise, persistent.

"We don't book meetings. We build pipeline." 

This role is a genuine development opportunity. For the right person, it's the foundation of a leadership career at Kong.

title: Senior / Staff Intelligence Analyst, Environmental Crimes
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

About the role

TRM is building a highly impactful, collaborative Environmental Crimes intelligence function, with one goal: disrupt the illicit actors behind wildlife trafficking and other environmental crimes, and add real friction to their ability to operate.

As our Senior or Staff Intelligence Analyst, Environmental Crimes , you will own TRM's intelligence on this category end-to-end. You will research, analyze, and publish intelligence on environmental crime networks and the crypto and financial flows behind them, combining on-chain tracing, OSINT, and off-chain data from partners into a picture that law enforcement, NGOs, and private-sector partners can act on.

You will also be the clear TRM owner for our partnership with United for Wildlife and Project Pangolin, serving a global network of partner organizations as a trusted advisor, convener, and the expert user who shapes how TRM's products serve this mission. What makes this role unique: you get to build a new intelligence category from the ground up, on the leading blockchain intelligence platform, with executive sponsorship and direct real-world impact.

The impact you will have

- Build the environmental crimes threat picture. Research, author, and publish intelligence products (threat assessments, typology reports, trend analysis, actor profiles, network maps) on environmental crime and the illicit finance behind it, and maintain a reusable threat picture inside TRM's intelligence infrastructure.

- Drive investigations to action. Develop and use a wide variety of intelligence sources, tools, and capabilities — on-chain, OSINT, and partner-provided off-chain data — to identify the wallets, entities, and off-ramps behind environmental crime networks. Produce structured, source-cited targeting packages that support law enforcement and partner investigations and surface disruption opportunities.

- Own the United for Wildlife partner program. Replace fractional coverage with a managed, repeatable program across a network of 200+ partner organizations: case assistance, analysis, guidance, training, and onboarding.

- Bring the community together. Organize virtual and in-person cross-sector, cross-border sprints and working groups aimed at real-time disruption, and collaborate with partners such as USFWS, HSI, DOJ, Interpol, UNODC, national agencies, and NGOs.

- Be TRM's public voice on environmental crimes. Brief internal stakeholders, partners, and leadership, and represent TRM with media, at external events, and with other stakeholders to amplify our intelligence.

- Shape the product. Act as the representative power user of TRM's mission tooling for the environmental crimes community, turning field needs into structured feedback and partnering with product teams to prototype new analysis and collaboration capabilities.

- Scale your coverage with AI. Build reusable AI workflows for signal processing, target selection, and drafting, with human validation where it matters, so more of your time goes to high-judgment analysis and partner delivery.

What we're looking for

- 5+ years in intelligence analysis, financial crime, illicit finance, blockchain intelligence, or transnational threat investigations.

- Domain knowledge of wildlife trafficking, environmental crime, and/or transnational smuggling — or a closely adjacent illicit-trade domain, with a demonstrated ability to ramp fast.

- Proven ability to independently run complex, multi-source investigations and produce clear, decision-ready, source-cited written intelligence for both expert and non-expert audiences.

- Strong proficiency in OSINT methodology and tradecraft, with hands-on experience using commercial databases and investigative tools.

- Production AI fluency: you already use AI and LLMs to accelerate research and analysis, build reusable workflows, and critically evaluate AI output — neither accept-all nor reject-all.

- A partner- and community-facing operator: you build trust and energize a multi-organization network, and you are comfortable owning an external partner program, not only heads-down analysis.

- Strong stakeholder communication, briefing, and facilitation skills.

- Self-directed: you thrive in ambiguity and generate visible wins quickly in an early-stage initiative.

- Commitment to becoming fluent in blockchain tracing and TRM's tooling. Prior crypto experience is not required; we will train you.

Nice to have

- Hands-on blockchain or crypto tracing experience across multiple chains and obfuscation techniques (strongly preferred).

- Experience working alongside law enforcement or NGOs in a conservation or enforcement context.

- Experience delivering training or enablement to external partners.

- Experience organizing events or operational working groups that bring diverse stakeholders together to drive action.

- Regional language skills relevant to key trafficking corridors (e.g., Mandarin, Vietnamese, Thai, Spanish, Portuguese).

About the team

- You will join TRM's Primary Intelligence organization and work day-to-day with the Environmental Crimes team, a distributed group producing finished intelligence across threat categories.

- Environmental crime is a category TRM is investing in at the executive level, including our collaboration with United for Wildlife.

- Mission-first, high-autonomy, execution-oriented culture with rigorous analytical standards.

- AI-native: analysts use AI daily and build reusable methods that the whole team adopts.

Team operating rhythms

- Distributed, not distant: a global team that collaborates across time zones with regular overlap for syncs.

- Slack-first, async communication; @mention for timely responses.

- Weekly 1:1s and team syncs, plus case and partner-delivery rhythms.

- Regular engagement with external partners and cross-functional teams.

- Required online and collaboration hours: Overlap with US, EMEA, and APAC time zones for internal syncs and partner engagement.

- On-call responsibilities: N/A

- Travel requirements: Up to 20%. Expect about 6 or more major trips per year for key industry and partner events (e.g., Climate Weeks) plus 2 TRM offsites.

- Onsite requirements: None; remote, distributed role.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position

- Within 30 days: Take ownership of an active environmental crimes case and deliver a finished, source-cited intelligence product a partner can act on.

- Within 60 days: Deliver intelligence or training to at least one United for Wildlife partner, and ship a reusable AI workflow another analyst adopts.

- Within 90 days: Stand up a repeatable partner-delivery play for the United for Wildlife network, publish or brief your first environmental crimes intelligence product, and hand off leads that support disruption.

Application Instructions 

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered.

What to Expect From Our Interview Process 

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview.

- Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.

- Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

- First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

- Final Round: Meet some of the people you'd be working with. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

- References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact.

- Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions.

- Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding.

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

Learn more about interviewing at TRM 

Life at TRM 

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

- Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate

- Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity

- A high level of personal ownership and accountability

- Close collaboration across teams and functions

- Frequent, high-touch communication

- Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking

- A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more about Interviewing at TRM 

AI Fluency at TRM 

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

- Accelerate repeatable workflows

- Structure and solve problems

- Improve output quality

- Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Leadership Principles 

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

- Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

- Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.

Kubernetes

This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.

- Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.

- Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.

We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

BAU & Platform Stability

- Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments

- Understanding of networking fundamentals

- Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python

- Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux

- Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)

- Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state

- A methodical, security-conscious approach

- Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management

- Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)

- Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)

- Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

The Kind of Person We're After

- You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't

- 
How can we incentivise good rider behaviour?

- 
What is the business impact of exclusive deals we have with restaurants?

Can the Delivery food market sustain multiple players?

-

- 
Ability to think creatively and insightfully about business-relevant economic problems

Proficiency with analytical tools like R/Python and familiarity with SQL

title: Head of Sales @Pelagon (backed by Hexa)
description:
Who are we?

The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable.

Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction : detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them.

We sell to navies and coast guards , and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy.

Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa , the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk.

⚡ What is at stake in the coming months

- Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators.

- Deploy and sign our first paid pilots.

- Sign our first contracts.

By joining us, you'll play a key role in turning that early traction into multi-year protection contracts, and in building the sales team that follows.

🎯 Your mission

- Own every deal from first meeting to signed contract, with navies, port authorities and operators of cables and offshore energy.

- Sell interdiction, not detection alone: make the threat and the gap between alarm and response concrete for each buyer, then turn pilots into multi-year protection contracts.

- Shape requirements before the tender: work with navies and operators months ahead of an RFP so that it asks for detection and action together.

- Open our priority export markets: the Baltic and the Nordics, the Black Sea, the Gulf and Southeast Asia.

- Work as a pair with Gauthier, our Co-CEO, on key accounts, and bring Aymeric and the engineers in when the technical conversation starts.

- Build the partner channel: primes and integrators, offshore and cable operators, and local partners in each country.

- Turn every deployment into a reference the next customer can check.

- Set up the sales machine, then hire and lead the first sellers.

📈 How you will be measured

- First 3 months: you own the pipeline, have a qualified deal plan for each priority region, and a first paid pilot or LOI is signed.

- 6 months: paid pilots are running and the first contracts are signed.

- 12 months: recurring contracts in at least two countries, and your first sales hires are made and ramped.

🤩 This job is your dream job if:

- You have closed defense or government deals and want to do it again, from zero, where every contract changes the trajectory

- You like being the second half of a founder pair: the CEO brings operational credibility, you bring the deal

- You'd rather be on a plane to Tallinn, Constanța or Abu Dhabi than in a forecast meeting

- You speak engineer well enough to sell sensors, AI and C2

- You want to write the sales playbook yourself, then hire the team that runs it

🙅 This job is not for you if:

- You need a brand, a marketing team and SDRs to sell

- You have only sold short-cycle SaaS or SMB deals, never through formal procurement

- You want to manage a large team from day one rather than close deals yourself

- Sales cycles of 12 to 24 months and 40% travel put you off

- You are looking for the comfort of a large defense group

What we offer

- A founding role in a seed-stage defense tech company backed by Hexa

- Fixed salary, variable on signed revenue, BSPCE

- Offices in Paris, real deployments at sea

🧭 Our recruitment process

- A first call to get to know each other.

- A deep dive into two deals you closed.

- A case study on a real Pelagon challenge, presented to the founders.

- A conversation with the founders.

- Reference checks, with your consent.

- Offer.

We answer after each step.

Pelagon is committed to creating a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment irrespective of gender, origin, identity, background and sexual orientation.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. - Proactive. You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.

- Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly. You can explain something complex in a few sentences.
- AI-driven. AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink at least one thing you're proud of.
- Hungry and motivated. You're ambitious, high-energy, and grounded. You see this internship as a chance to learn faster than anywhere else, and you're ready to work for it.
- Bonus: you've built something. A game, an app, a student initiative, a side business. We'd love to hear about it.
For this role, you'll also bring: 

- You've created content in some form: a blog, a TikTok page, a newsletter, a portfolio, a standout university project. Show us. We care about what you've made, not where you made it.
- Sharp writing. You write and speak with clarity and punch, adapt to any audience, and work confidently with anyone.
- Design instinct. You're fluent in content tools (slides, Canva, Figma, or similar) and build clean, high-quality visuals.
Practical details

- A 6-month internship, with a flexible start date. We adapt to any month.
- A convention de stage (internship agreement) is required.
- Apprenticeships ( alternance ) are also welcome.
- Paris based. You'll need to be able to work onsite at our Paris office.
- Fluent English is required. French is a plus, not a requirement.
- Top performers may be offered a full-time role at the end of the internship

Our Culture 

At Homa , we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

- Humility: We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.
- Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.
- Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.
- Ambition: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” - we use common sense to reach higher.
Benefits 

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

- 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
- 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.

title: Senior Demand Generation Specialist, Hotels (12M FTC)
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 

The Community You Will Join: 

The Airbnb Hotels organization is a fun, entrepreneurial, start-up team where you can have outsized impact. Simplicity is at the core of our products. We pride ourselves on delivering the smoothest and most intuitive hotel booking experience. For hotels, we make it easy to drive incremental bookings so they can focus on the craft of hosting. We aspire to facilitate hotel discovery and serendipity at scale, benefitting guests and hotel partners. 

The Difference You will Make: 

Airbnb is building the world's largest supply of boutique and independent hotels on its platform. To accelerate that growth, we're hiring a Senior Demand Generation Specialist to own the inbound engine for our Hotels Acquisition team.

This is a high-impact, strategic and hands-on role sitting at the intersection of marketing and sales. This is Airbnb's first-ever B2B demand generation role. You'll build the Hotels inbound motion from the ground up across EMEA, as a 12-month pilot that will shape how we scale it globally.

A Typical Day: 

- Define and own the EMEA inbound strategy and roadmap, prioritising the channels and initiatives that will drive the most hotel go-lives

- Build and scale multi-channel inbound programs (email, paid, SEO, content, events, partnerships) targeting independent hotels, boutique chains, and hotel groups globally

- Own the full funnel from lead capture to MQL handoff, including lead scoring, routing, and CRM hygiene in Salesforce, in collaboration with RevOps Teams

- Design Linkedin campaigns in coordination with regional AE teams to target high-priority segments and geographies

- Develop outbound-assist sequences (via tools like Mixmax or Outreach) to complement AE prospecting

- Partner with Global Marketing to build collateral, landing pages, and nurture flows that speak to hotel operator pain points

- Track, report, and optimize against pipeline contribution metrics: MQLs, MQL-to-SQL conversion, cost per lead, and influenced revenue

- Run co-marketing and referral programs with industry partners (channel managers, PMSes, hospitality associations)

- Build business cases for each campaign, secure budget from stakeholders, and show clear ROI

title: Senior Product Manager, Mobile
description:
Why Mozilla? 

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser, and Pocket, a service for keeping up with the best content online. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders - only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role: 

We’re looking for a hands-on Mobile Product Manager with a primary focus on Firefox for iOS, while also contributing across mobile (including Android). 

This role is about building a better browser, turning downloads into loyal users, and creating experiences that truly stand out. If you’ve shipped mobile apps, obsess over details that improve everyday use, and love turning user insights into real improvements, this is a great opportunity to drive impact at Firefox. 

What you’ll do: 

- Build a fundamentally better browser experience: fix bugs, refine UI and navigation, improve downloads, menus, performance, and all the small details that make Firefox noticeably better for users who care about privacy, quality and reliability. 

- Drive strong activation and retention: focus on the new-user journey, quickly hooking people after they install the app, understanding where they drop off, and relentlessly optimizing the funnel through data, testing and iteration. 

- Deliver differentiating features and experiences that make Firefox stickier for key user groups, the kinds of things others can’t or won’t build. 

- Work closely with engineers, designers, data science and TPMs to ship high-impact improvements while balancing user needs, technical constraints, privacy and performance goals. 

- Stay deeply connected to real users: track App Store trends and discussions, test apps hands-on, analyze reviews and analytics, and turn those insights into concrete enhancements for Firefox on iOS and Android. 

- Monitor app health in App Store Connect and Google Play Console (crashes, ANRs, ratings) and support acquisition/retention efforts through ASO, store listings and growth experiments. 

- Adapt and optimize Firefox for global markets (Europe, Japan, Asia etc.), keeping cultural differences and local realities like data constraints in mind. 

What you'll bring: 

- Proven Shipping Experience: Hands-on experience launching or managing apps on the iOS App Store and/or Google Play Store, with clear impact on user experience and metrics. 

- Execution Focus: A strong track record of delivering features and improvements under deadlines through effective collaboration with engineering, design and cross-functional partners. 

- Mobile & Browser Fluency: Deep understanding of iOS (and ideally Android) ecosystems, app store policies and web browser technologies, with genuine passion for what makes a great browsing experience. 

- Data-Driven Iteration: Comfort using analytics, funnels, A/B testing and user feedback to improve activation, retention and overall product quality. 

- User Obsession: Natural habit of studying apps, following trends on platforms like X/Twitter and Reddit, and testing experiences yourself to uncover opportunities. 

- Global & Growth Mindset: Interest or experience growing products in international markets with sensitivity to local user needs. 

- Bonus: 

- Experience with mobile browsers or privacy-focused products. 

- History of meaningfully scaling an app’s user base. 

- Currently maintaining your own side project or app on the App Store or Google Play. 

What you’ll get: 

- Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team 

- Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage 

- Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) 

- Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together 

- Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday 

- One-time home office stipend 

- Annual professional development budget 

- Quarterly well-being stipend 

- Considerable paid parental leave 

- Employee referral bonus program 

- Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) 

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. title: Process Engineer - Semiconductor Processes
description:
Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. 

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

Role Overview 

We are looking for a Process Engineer to support the development, stabilization and industrialization of our semiconductor fabrication processes. 

At our current stage of maturity, this position combines advanced process development, hands-on R&D and manufacturing engineering. The Process Engineer will play a key role in bridging the gap between Advanced R&D and Production, transforming newly developed process building blocks into robust, repeatable and scalable manufacturing processes. 

The role will have a strong focus on dry etching processes, particularly ICP and RIE, as well as PECVD and metal evaporation. The successful candidate will work closely with R&D teams, fabrication engineers, equipment owners and cleanroom operators to improve process capability, reproducibility, yield and production throughput. 

This is a highly hands-on position requiring a strong understanding of semiconductor fabrication, rigorous experimental methodology and the ability to investigate complex interactions between process parameters and device performance. 

Key Responsibilities 

Process Development & Industrialization 

- Develop, optimize and stabilize semiconductor fabrication processes, with a primary focus on ICP / RIE dry etching, PECVD deposition and metal evaporation. 
- Validate and qualify new fabrication equipment and associated processes. 
- Define process windows, recipes, operating conditions and acceptance criteria. 
- Use structured experimentation, including Design of Experiments (DoE) where appropriate, to understand process sensitivities and optimize performance. 
- Improve process repeatability, reproducibility, robustness and within-wafer / wafer-to-wafer homogeneity. 
- Prepare processes and equipment for increasing wafer sizes, batch sizes and production volumes. 
R&D to Production Transfer 

- Act as a key technical interface between Advanced R&D and Production. 
- Convert R&D process building blocks into stable, documented and manufacturable processes. 
- Assess manufacturability, scalability and process risks before transfer to production. 
- Define qualification plans and acceptance criteria before releasing new or modified processes to production. 
- Lead or contribute to Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) for critical fabrication steps, identifying potential failure modes, their effects on device performance and appropriate prevention and control measures. 
- Translate PFMEA outcomes into process controls, monitoring plans, acceptance criteria, Control Plans and documentation. 
- Support technology transfer through clear documentation, operator training and technical communication. 
Process Control & Yield Improvement 

- Monitor and improve production process performance, yield and throughput. 
- Establish regular process checks, controls and monitoring methodologies, including Statistical Process Control (SPC) where relevant. 
- Detect process drifts, investigate deviations and define corrective and preventive actions. 
- Lead root-cause analysis and troubleshooting activities for yield losses, process excursions and equipment-related issues. 
- Define and maintain relevant process KPIs and contribute to continuous-improvement initiatives. 
- Promote best practices that increase process stability, repeatability and equipment utilization. 
Equipment & Production Support 

- Provide hands-on technical support to cleanroom operators and production teams. 
- Support equipment qualification, troubleshooting and process recovery following equipment interventions. 
- Work closely with equipment suppliers and internal teams to resolve technical issues. 
- Contribute to a safe, disciplined and efficient cleanroom environment. 
Process Characterization & Data Analysis 

- Characterize the impact of fabrication parameters on material and device performance. 
- Correlate process data with structural, optical and electrical characterization results. 
- Use experimental data to identify process sensitivities, failure mechanisms and optimization opportunities. 
- Develop appropriate data-analysis tools to support process monitoring and engineering decisions. 
- Search and analyze scientific and technical literature to support process development and troubleshooting. 
Documentation & Communication 

- Create and maintain high-quality process documentation, including process specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), equipment recipes, qualification reports, Control Plans, process-development reports and troubleshooting guides. 
- Ensure frequent and clear reporting of process status, experimental results, risks and improvement actions. 
- Communicate effectively with colleagues from different technical backgrounds and levels of experience. 
- Train and support operators and other team members on new or updated processes. 
Requirements 

Required Qualifications & Experience 

- Master's degree or PhD in Semiconductor Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Micro/Nanotechnology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
- Hands-on experience with semiconductor or photonic-device fabrication in a cleanroom environment. 
- Strong knowledge of dry etching, ideally including hands-on experience with ICP-RIE. 
- Experience with one or more complementary processes such as RIE, PECVD, physical vapor deposition / metal evaporation and lithography. 
- Strong understanding of how fabrication parameters can influence material properties and device performance. 
- Excellent attention to detail and a rigorous approach to experimental work. 
- Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and problem-solving skills. 
- Ability to independently investigate technical problems using experimental data and scientific literature. 
- Strong communication and documentation skills. 
- Fluent English, both written and spoken. 
Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience in a semiconductor manufacturing, pilot-line or production environment. 
- Experience with process industrialization and transfer from R&D to production. 
- Experience with PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, DoE or other structured process-risk and continuous-improvement methodologies. 
- Experience with optical and electrical characterization of semiconductor or optoelectronic devices. 
- Experience with III-V semiconductor devices, particularly AlGaAs-based photonic structures, resonators or VCSEL-type technologies. 
- Knowledge of Python or other programming languages for process-data analysis, automated reporting, instrument control or experimental automation. 
Profile 

We are looking for someone who combines the mindset of an R&D engineer with the rigor of a manufacturing/process engineer. 

The ideal candidate is comfortable developing new processes where all parameters are not yet fully understood, while also being able to transform experimental processes into stable, controlled and documented production workflows. 

You should enjoy working directly in the cleanroom, analyzing data, solving complex fabrication problems and collaborating across R&D and production teams.

title: Senior/ Lead AI Consultant
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team 

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role 

As a Senior/ Lead AI Consultant (known internally - Senior/ Lead Deployment Engineer), you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.

This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact. 

The Work You’ll Do 

Initiate and Connect 

- Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases

- Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria

- Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required

Build & Value 

- Direct AI deployment agents (Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements

- Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights

- Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer

- Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot

- Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies

- Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact

- Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance

Rollout, Adoption, and Handover 

- Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption

- Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations

- Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value

- Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff

Domain & Industry Depth 

- Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals

- Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage

- Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era 

- You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually

- You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly

- You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers

- You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer

- You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable

The Qualifications You Need 

- Experience: 4-7+ years in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators. 

- Platform skills: Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. Proficiency in PQL, SQL, and Python.

- AI fluency: Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.

- Business and process domain expertise : Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus.

- Consulting skills: Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences. 

- Analytical mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with a value-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact.

- Learning agility: Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools.

- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field.

- Languages: Fluency in English required. Additional languages are a plus.

- Travel : Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases.

What Celonis can offer you:

- Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

- Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

- Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. title: Senior AI/ML Software Engineer
description:
About Nabla 

We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine.

Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day.

We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows.

Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere.

This is a great time to join us!

The best of AI at the service of healthcare 

Led by former Meta AI Research engineers, our team has consistently anticipated how AI can revolutionize healthcare delivery. Our Machine Learning team continually leverages the latest advancements to unlock AI’s full potential in healthcare.

Yann LeCun, Meta’s ex-Chief AI Scientist and Turing award winner, is an advisor to Nabla. He’s now focused on AMI Labs, with whom we have a close partnership.

Engineering at Nabla 

Engineering at Nabla is lean, fast-moving, and deeply technical. Our teams span machine learning, native desktop applications, and platform infrastructure to deliver AI into clinical settings reliably and at scale.

Your Team 

At Nabla, product development is led jointly by Engineering and Product, and organized into cross-functional squads, each focused on a specific product area. Squads bring together product managers, designers, engineers of different profiles, and domain experts, and operate with a high level of ownership.

As an AI Engineer, you’ll join one of these squads and contribute end to end to a specific part of the product.

What you'll do 

As an AI/ML Software Engineer, you’ll play a key role in redefining clinicians’ workflows, unlocking better care for patients, and ensuring Nabla remains at the forefront of AI innovation. You will take ownership of high-impact projects and contribute to the growth and maturity of our engineering team and product.

Within a team of experts who have built large-scale production systems at Meta, Google, and Microsoft, you will:

- Build agentic pipelines: chains of LLM-based agents that work together on complex clinical documentation tasks.

- Go beyond ambient scribing to fully redefine clinicians’ workflows with AI, unlocking transformative efficiencies and improved patient care.

- Integrate LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others) into production features.

- Design prompts and build evaluation frameworks to measure and improve output quality, then iterate quickly based on results.

- Write clean, production-grade code and own your features end to end, from design to deployment and monitoring in a live healthcare setting.

- Work closely with product managers to turn model capabilities into reliable, scalable product features.

To get a sense of the impact you’ll have: 

- Nabla processes 300 billion tokens/month with LLMs.

- By the time you’ve read this posting, Nabla will have transcribed 100 new hours of live audio and generated 500 new clinical notes , saving 125 hours of doctor time .

Your DNA: 

The ideal candidate will bring strong software engineering skills and a practical, hands-on approach to building with LLMs.

- You have 3+ years writing production code, with solid skills in software design, testing, and system architecture.

- You’re proficient in one or more widely used back-end languages (Java, Kotlin, C++, Go, etc.).

- You’ve built features or products using LLM provider APIs, including prompting and evaluation. You don’t need to have trained or fine-tuned models yourself.

- You can turn a fuzzy product requirement into a working, testable pipeline.

- You have a passion for going beyond the status quo to redefine workflows and unlock better care for patients.

- You communicate clearly and effectively.

- Bonus: Experience building multi-agent systems or agent orchestration frameworks is a strong plus.

Our Stack 

- Kotlin for backend services

- LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, and others) for the models themselves

- Agent orchestration frameworks for building chains of agents

- Prompt evaluation and testing tools to track output quality over time

- Google Cloud & Kubernetes for deployment

Where you'll be based 

Our offices are based in Paris 3e (Arts & Métiers) .
Remote policy: 1-2 days a week (with some flexibility). Possibility of working remotely 1-2 weeks once a year.

Benefits 

Just like we’re dedicated to supporting doctors’ well-being, ensuring yours is a top priority. We firmly believe that by prioritizing your well-being, we support you to excel in your work.

Here are the benefits you get when joining Nabla:

- Stock ownership

- 100% healthcare coverage

- Meal vouchers

- Public transportation costs covered at 50%

- Exercise class during the workday: Yoga, running, pilates, HIIT

- Unlimited budget for book purchases, so you can continue to learn about ML / Healthcare

- Culture of trust & accountability — your output matters more than your clock-in time

Life at Nabla 

When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed.

We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes.

We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts!

If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application!

Our Values at Nabla 

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel 

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble 

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift 

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity 

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion 

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment scam which is now using Nabla to collect personal information or financial scams. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure whomever is contacting you truly represents Nabla and is utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity from people who could be pretending to be recruiters or senior professionals at Nabla. You can find more information following this link .

Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

Singulier is a strategy, transaction advisory and AI transformation consulting firm supporting private equity funds, portfolio companies and established businesses on their most critical strategic and operational challenges. We combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution to help our clients make better decisions, accelerate value creation and deliver tangible business impact.

Singulier x OMMAX are joining forces to build a leading European AI management consulting platform, combining deep strategic expertise with technology, data and AI capabilities. Working at the intersection of business, product, technology, data and AI, you will help clients transform functions, teams, operating models and ways of working while ensuring that solutions create measurable and sustainable value.

You will lead taskforces composed of strategy consultants and senior digital experts located across France and the UK, with the support of a Principal or Partner.

What you will do ?

Lead transformation engagements

- Structure the problem, define the overall approach and organise the engagement into clear workstreams.
- Translate business challenges into actionable transformation roadmaps, prioritised initiatives and concrete delivery plans.

- Lead projects from execution to closing, ensuring that timelines, milestones and team responsibilities remain on track.
- Manage resources, team capacity and end-products while contributing to project profitability.
- Participate in setting up the appropriate team of strategy consultants and digital experts.
- Ensure the quality, consistency and executive-readiness of all key deliverables.
- Anticipate risks, resolve delivery issues and maintain alignment with the client and the Singulier leadership team.
- Ensure the appropriate capitalisation of project knowledge, methodologies and reusable assets.
Contribute to business development

- Contribute to building proposals and responding to client opportunities with the support of Partners, Principals, Directors and practice leaders.
- Help shape the problem statement, transformation approach, workplan, team structure and commercial scope.
- Identify opportunities to extend client relationships and support the growth of Singulier’s transformation offering.
- Bring innovative ideas to proposals, client presentations and problem-solving discussions.
- Contribute to the development of Singulier’s market positioning and thought leadership on business, product, technology, data and AI transformation.
Develop people and build the firm

- Lead and develop teams of consultants and digital experts across engagements.
- Coach Consultants, Analysts and junior team members, helping them build both consulting and transformation capabilities.
- Provide clear direction, feedback and support throughout projects.
- Contribute to internal initiatives, methodology development, knowledge sharing and recruitment.
- Help strengthen the culture, capabilities and long-term growth of Singulier.
Requirements 

What we’re looking for

- 4–5+ years of experience in a strategy, digital, product, technology or business transformation consulting firm.
- Proven experience leading complex transformation programmes in environments involving multiple stakeholders.
- The ability to combine strategic vision, structured problem-solving and operational execution.
- Experience working across business, product, technology, data or AI topics.

- Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, timelines, resources and deliverables.

- Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly.
- Demonstrated commercial abilities and an interest in contributing to proposals and business development.
- An entrepreneurial mindset, with the autonomy, pragmatism and proactivity required to thrive in a fast-growing environment.

Why join Singulier?

title: Head of Hospitals & Home Care
description:
Qui sommes-nous ? 

Doctolib est une entreprise B Corp engagée à construire ensemble la santé dont nous rêvons tous. Avec 2 900 collaborateurs en France, en Allemagne, en Italie et aux Pays-Bas, nous accompagnons plus de 420 000 professionnels de santé et 90 millions de patients, transformant l'accès aux soins et la prise en charge à travers l'Europe. Nous accélérons désormais notre ambition : devenir le partenaire clinique de référence en Europe, de confiance pour les patients et les professionnels, grâce à la puissance de technologies avancées et de l'IA.

Notre ambition est de construire le système d'exploitation clinique de demain pour l'Europe - offrant des résultats de santé mesurables pour des millions de personnes.

- Pour les professionnels de santé : Nous réduisons la charge administrative, augmentons la prise de décision clinique grâce à l'IA et permettons de nouveaux modèles de soins.

- Pour les patients : Nous passons de soins réactifs en cas de maladie à une gestion proactive de leur santé, en donnant aux personnes les moyens de prendre en charge leur santé avec des compagnons numériques de confiance, recommandés par les médecins.

Vos missions 

L'hôpital est l'un des segments les plus stratégiques et exigeants de Doctolib. En une décennie, nous avons construit une présence solide auprès des établissements de santé, publics et privés à but non lucratif, avec une suite complète de solutions couvrant l'ensemble du parcours ambulatoire : visibilité de l'offre de soins, planification, prise de rendez-vous, préparation administrative, assistant de consultation IA, téléconsultation, téléexpertise et bien plus encore.

En tant que Head of Hospitals & Home Care, vous prenez la tête d'une équipe d'une quinzaine de personnes, structurée en acquisition et account management, et appuyée par de nombreuses équipes expertes partenaires, notamment Déploiement, Interopérabilité, Product Marketing et Affaires Publiques. Vous êtes le ou la garant(e) de la performance commerciale, de la satisfaction client et de la vision stratégique du segment hospitalier en France, tout en ouvrant la voie à de nouveaux territoires : le médico-social et les soins à domicile.

Votre responsabilité sera de combiner performance à court terme, développement de la base installée et construction d'une vision stratégique à deux ou trois ans pour le segment.

Vous rejoindrez l'équipe Salaried & Retail France de Doctolib, en reportant à Maric Philibert, notre VP Sales, Salaried & Retail.

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à : 

- Piloter et atteindre les objectifs de net MRR du segment, sur l'acquisition, l'expansion et la rétention, avec une implication personnelle dans le développement des comptes les plus stratégiques et l'accélération du cross-sell sur les nouvelles solutions, notamment l'Assistant de Consultation et la Téléexpertise.

- Assurer la satisfaction et l'usage effectif des solutions Doctolib dans les établissements clients, en coordination étroite avec les équipes Déploiement, Interopérabilité et Customer Care.

- Manager, développer et engager une équipe d'environ 15 personnes, accompagner sa montée en séniorité et renforcer son efficacité grâce à la donnée et aux agents IA.

- Construire et incarner la vision stratégique à deux ou trois ans du segment, en lien avec la Product Vision de Doctolib et les tendances de marché, en coordination avec les équipes Product Marketing, Affaires Publiques, Communication et Produit.

- Développer et entretenir les relations institutionnelles clés, notamment avec la FHF, la FEHAP, UNICANCER, la DGOS et les ARS, et piloter les partenariats stratégiques du segment.

- Explorer et initier les premiers revenus dans les segments médico-social et soins à domicile, en définissant les besoins, la stratégie et les approches tactiques adaptées.

- Développer une approche structurée de segmentation, d'account planning et de couverture des comptes stratégiques, afin d'augmenter l'adoption, l'expansion, le cross-sell et la rétention.

- Coordonner les équipes Tech, Déploiement, Legal, Finance, Product Marketing, Affaires Publiques et Partenariats, tout en gardant les priorités clients et terrain au centre des décisions.

- Représenter Doctolib auprès d'interlocuteurs exécutifs, institutionnels, politiques, techniques et des principaux réseaux professionnels du secteur.

Votre impact
