Collaborate with frontend, product, and design teams to deliver high-quality customer experiences backed by robust backend systems.

Requirements: 

- 
4-6 years of backend engineering experience with a track record of shipping reliable, well-tested systems.

- 
Strong fundamentals in backend development, including API design, data modeling, concurrent systems, and performance optimization.

- 
Experience working with relational databases and distributed systems concepts.

- 
Curious and eager to learn - you're excited to dig into unfamiliar systems, understand complex integrations, and grow your technical skills.

- 
Bias toward action and ownership - you see a problem, propose solutions, and drive it to completion without needing constant direction.

- 
Strong communication skills and comfort working cross-functionally with product, design, and other engineers.

- 
Thrive in fast-paced environments with evolving priorities and high autonomy.

- 
Interest and experience with AI tools and prompting - you leverage AI in your workflow and can help level up the team's capabilities.

You'll stand out if you have: 

- 
Experience building integrations, ETL pipelines, or working with third-party APIs at scale.

- 
Exposure to financial services, fintech, or B2B SaaS products.

- 
Experience at seed/early-stage startups where you wore multiple hats and moved quickly.

- 
Familiarity with event-driven architectures, message queues, or data synchronization patterns.

- 
Previously built side projects or contributed to open source software.

Our tech stack: Golang, Redis, PostgreSQL, AWS SQS, Amazon S3

Why Dispatch ? 

Why work at Dispatch? 

- 
We’re a highly experienced team with a track record of successfully building together. We’re well-versed in building for the best tech companies and asset managers.

- 
We’re a well-funded company backed by top-tier investors.

- 
We're laser-focused on customers and believe that a world-class user experience is critical for product and business success.

- 
We move fast, iterate quickly, and have a high bar for what “excellent” looks like.

What we offer: 

- 
Competitive salary and equity options

- 
High-quality benefits package including 100% company-paid insurance premiums for family coverage (medical, vision, dental).

- 
401K, HSA & FSA plans

- 
OneMedical, HealthAdvocate, TalkSpace, and Teladoc memberships

- 
Technology stipend

- 
Unlimited PTO

- 
Paid parental leave

- 
Office space in San Francisco and New York for in-person working

Dispatch provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

title: Senior Applied Research Engineer - Video
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

As an Applied Research Engineer in our Video team, you will help build the next generation of production-grade foundation models for human-centric video generation.

You will join a highly focused team working at the intersection of large-scale generative modeling, distributed systems, and production engineering. Our mission is to develop and optimize video base models that power realistic, controllable, and emotionally expressive synthetic humans at scale.

This is not pure research. This is applied research with direct product impact.

You will work on advancing training recipes, scaling distributed systems, improving evaluation frameworks, and optimizing inference to ensure our models are high quality, stable, and efficient enough for real-world deployment. Your work will directly influence models used by tens of thousands of businesses worldwide.
What you’ll do 

You will own and execute end-to-end research and engineering projects, from hypothesis to production impact. This includes:

- Developing and scaling latent video diffusion models tailored for human-centric video generation

- Designing conditioning mechanisms to improve control (pose, emotion, script, camera) without sacrificing fidelity

- Advancing distributed training strategies (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed, sequence parallelism) under real compute constraints

- Improving training stability at multi-node scale

- Designing rigorous evaluation frameworks combining automated metrics and structured human evaluation

- Optimizing inference for low latency, high resolution, and cost efficiency 

- Running controlled ablations and experiments to drive high-signal modeling decisions

- Contributing to high engineering standards: reproducibility, experiment tracking, CI/CD, monitoring

You will be expected to move fast, run multiple hypotheses in parallel, identify signal early, and focus on outcomes rather than exploration for its own sake.
What we’re looking for 

Must-have

- Strong experience training deep learning models at scale

- Strong Python and PyTorch skills

- Hands-on experience with diffusion models (image domain required; video preferred)

- Experience with large scale multi-GPU / multi-node training

- Good understanding of distributed training (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed or similar)

- Ability to design controlled experiments and interpret noisy results

Nice-to-have

- Experience with video diffusion models

- Experience in avatar or human-centric generation

- Familiarity with world / interactive models

- Experience with GANs or VAEs

Experience optimizing inference systems for production

Our stack

- Python, PyTorch, CUDA

- DeepSpeed, distributed training & inference

- Sequence parallelism

- AWS, SLURM, Docker

- GitHub, CI/CD pipelines

Who you are

- You are research-driven but outcome-focused

- You care about shipping, not just publishing

- You can explore multiple ideas quickly and drop low-signal directions early

- You communicate clearly and present results scientifically

- You operate independently but collaborate actively across teams

Why join us?

- Build production-scale video foundation models in a fast-growing Generative AI company

- Work on human-centric video generation with real-world impact

- Tackle hard problems in scaling, stability, and controllability

- Influence the direction of next-generation synthetic human technology

- Join a highly technical, high-ownership environment where your work ships

If you want to work on cutting-edge generative video models and see your research power real-world products, we’d love to talk.
Our culture 

At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here. 

Serving 50,000+ customers (and 50% of the Fortune 500) 

We’re trusted by leading brands such as Heineken, Zoom, Xerox, McDonald’s and more. Read stories from happy customers and what 1,200+ people say on G2 .

Proprietary AI technology 

Since 2017, we’ve been pioneering advancements in Generative AI. Our AI technology is built in-house, by a team of world-class AI researchers and engineers. Learn more about our AI Research Lab and the team behind. 

AI Safety, Ethics and Security 

AI safety, ethics, and security are fundamental to our mission. While the full scope of Artificial Intelligence's impact on our society is still unfolding, our position is clear: People first. Always. Learn more about our commitments to AI Ethics, Safety & Security .

title: Software Architect
description:
Job Requisition ID # 

26WD94957

Position Overview 

At Autodesk , we are pioneers in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, building tools that empower some of the most creative minds on the planet to solve real-world problems. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor, and others as a top place to work, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where innovation and creativity thrive. 

Autodesk's Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Data organization is seeking an experienced Software Architect to join the AEC Data team and define the cloud-native services and distributed-systems architecture that power the AEC Data Model (AECDM) and the many services around it. 

Data is the domain, but the role is fundamentally one of cloud and services architecture — APIs, service contracts, integrations, distributed-systems design, and the connected data model that ties them together — spanning multiple teams. It is not a data-warehouse or analytics-specialist role. 

The AEC Data organization is building the foundational data infrastructure behind Autodesk's vision for connected construction: the platforms, services, and unified data models that span the entire built-asset lifecycle, from design and construction through operation and maintenance. This work enables the continuous flow of AEC data (3D models, 2D drawings, issue tracking, cost, sensor streams, and more) across Autodesk products and third-party integrations. The architect will help shape the next generation of capabilities for the Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud, collaborating with software architects, domain experts, and product teams across Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Autodesk Forma. 

This is a senior individual-contributor role on an established architecture track, reporting to the Distinguished Architect of the AEC Data team, who also serves as the Lead Software Architect. The primary responsibility is to shape how multiple teams design and build — through standards, reference architectures, ADRs, and design-review governance — rather than to own a single service. The exact focus flexes to your strengths and organizational need. 

Responsibilities 

- API Design & Evolution : Design and evolve API surfaces across the AEC Data services — resource modeling, addressing, versioning and backward-compatible evolution, query APIs, and unifying overlapping surfaces into a single coherent contract. 

- System Architecture : Define and evolve cross-team, cloud-native architecture across the AEC Data services; design distributed systems including service contracts and event-driven flows. 

- Schema Design & Evolution : Design, document, and evolve data schemas for AEC domain entities (buildings, infrastructure, spaces, systems, components, relationships) — including semantic models, property sets, classification systems, and relationship hierarchies. Own versioning, backward/forward compatibility, deprecation, and migration; maintain the schema registry, validation rules, and quality checks. 

- Standards & Governance : Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components; author architecture proposals and decision records (ADRs) for review by a cross-org architecture council, and run cross-team design reviews. 

- Prototyping & Feasibility : Evaluate alternative architectural directions through modeling and prototyping, de-risking key decisions before broad adoption. 

- Mentorship & Technical Leadership : Mentor engineers and fellow architects on emerging and established technologies and on architectural practice; grow technical depth across teams. 

- Reliability & Performance : Ensure reliability, security, and performance of systems; define SLOs and drive observability (metrics, tracing, logging). 

- Communication : Communicate architecture with clear views and diagrams (e.g., C4) and executive-ready narratives; produce comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials. 

Minimum Qualifications 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 

- 10+ years designing cloud-native, distributed systems, including 5+ years at cross-team architect altitude (Software Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff+, or equivalent). Title is flexible; scope of impact is the primary consideration. 

- Deep expertise in cloud services (ideally AWS), API/service design, and distributed-systems patterns (microservices, event-driven, resilience). 

- Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design — including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies — as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required. 

- Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns. 

- Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management. 

- Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams. 

- Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders. 

- Ability to collaborate with a global team. 

Preferred Qualifications 

Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites. 

Core: 

- Cloud Services : AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS). 

- Distributed Systems : Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design. 

- API & Service Design : REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation). 

- Database Architecture : Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL). 

- Observability/SRE : OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services. 

Bonus: 

- Semantic Technologies : Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs — particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM. 

- BIM Expertise : Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems. 

- AI Systems : RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering). 

- Domain-Specific AI for AEC : BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing. 

- Event-Driven Architectures : Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing. 

- AEC Domain Knowledge : Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Domain onboarding is provided. 

About the Team 

The AEC Data team is building the AEC Data Model (AECDM) to enable better AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, Operations) outcomes through more useful, connected, and accessible data. Its scope spans data services and APIs, product and design-tool integrations, and lifecycle/asset data across multiple teams — enabling the seamless flow of information across Autodesk products and third-party integrations so that AEC professionals can make better decisions with better data. 

Why Join Us 

- Shape the future of AEC data platforms and standards at an industry-leading company. 

- Design systems and schemas used by millions of architects, engineers, and construction professionals worldwide. 

- Collaborate with world-class software architects and engineers across Autodesk's AEC portfolio. 

- Contribute to open standards and interoperability initiatives that benefit the entire industry. 

- Join a team that values technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning. 

Learn More 

About Autodesk 

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency 

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Belonging 
We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging 

Are you an existing contractor or consultant with Autodesk? 

Please search for open jobs and apply internally (not on this external site).

title: Staff Backend Engineer
description:
About Us 

At TeamSnap , we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better. TeamSnap is a sports and communication platform dedicated to taking the work out of play in youth sports. We also believe our jobs should excite us, our teammates should support us and our bosses should inspire us. We empower our people to bring big ideas and tiny egos, landing us on Outside Magazine’s list of “ Best Places to Work" and Built In’s “ 100 Best Remote-First Places to Work." 

TeamSnap is seeking a Staff Software Engineer, Backend, to join our fully distributed engineering team and help us continue scaling systems that serve millions of daily users and tens of thousands of amateur sports organizations. Our stack includes Node, TypeScript, Elixir, Ruby/Rails, SQL, React, cloud-based services, event-driven systems, queues, background jobs, caching layers, and observability tooling.

We are looking for a hands-on Staff Backend Engineer who can build and improve APIs and services, reason through production issues across the system, lead technical design in ambiguous areas, mentor engineers, and raise the quality bar across the team. This person should be comfortable working closely with infrastructure, platform, and data teams without being expected to own those functions directly.

As an engineering team, we architect and build scalable systems using service-oriented and event-driven architecture. This role will help shape the technical foundation behind TeamSnap’s product experience, with a focus on backend systems, APIs, services, data performance, reliability, observability, and production quality.

What You'll Do:

- 
Architect, build, and evolve backend APIs, services, event-driven workflows, queues, background jobs, data models, caching strategies, and integrations that support millions of users and thousands of sports organizations.

- 
Own complex backend product and technical work from discovery through design, implementation, rollout, production support, and long term maintainability.

- 
Lead ambiguous technical initiatives by breaking down problems, identifying risks, making practical tradeoffs, and helping teams move from uncertainty to clear execution.

- 
Improve the reliability, scalability, performance, and operability of production systems through thoughtful architecture, strong testing practices, database optimization, caching, monitoring, alerting, and incident follow-up.

- 
Debug complex production issues by reasoning across application code, databases, caches, queues, jobs, observability data, and the broader request lifecycle.

- 
Partner with Product, Design, Engineering, Infrastructure, Platform, Data, Support, and other teams to turn roadmap needs into durable backend systems and practical delivery plans.

- 
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to give and receive constructive feedback, mentor engineers, influence cross-team alignment and articulate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders

What Will Set You Up for Success:

- Strong Node expertise with experience building and maintaining production backend systems.

- 
Staff level backend engineering depth, with a strong track record building and operating high-scale APIs, services, distributed systems, or shared product capabilities in production.

- 
Strong command of backend technologies such as Node, TypeScript, Elixir, Ruby/Rails, Java, Go, Python, or similar, including runtime behavior, failure modes, and production tradeoffs.

- 
Strong SQL and relational database judgment, including indexing, query optimization, migrations, profiling, data modeling, transactions, read and write patterns, and performance tuning.

- 
Practical understanding of service-oriented architecture, event-driven architecture, queues, background jobs, webhooks, Redis or similar caching tools, and systems that need to scale under real production load.

- 
Working knowledge of production infrastructure and platform concerns, enough to reason through deployments, containers, CI/CD pipelines, cloud services, networking basics, observability, and operational debugging.

- 
Strong production ownership mindset, with the ability to use logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts, incident reviews, and system behavior to improve reliability over time.

- 
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, mentor engineers, facilitate technical decisions, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and connect backend technical choices to customer impact, business needs, and long term maintainability.

Bonus:

- 
Previous work in or close partnership with infrastructure, platform, SRE, DevOps, or data teams.

- 
Familiarity with Elasticsearch, BigQuery, analytics pipelines, search infrastructure, reporting workflows, or high-volume data processing.

- 
Responsible use of AI-assisted engineering workflows to improve debugging, testing, documentation, refactoring, prototyping, or developer experience without compromising quality or understanding.

Compensation

Additional Information

Got cold feet? If you’re thinking you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying . We’re all humans with special talents that go beyond what’s listed here.

Compensation 

We’re committed to equitable compensation for all TeamSnappers. The minimum starting point for this role is $200,000 inclusive of base and bonus, with comp updated based on multiple factors. Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. 

Location

title: Senior Reviewer - Code & Web Templates
description:
About Us 

At Envato , we empower creative pros to thrive.

We're here to help creatives bring their ideas to life, supercharge their workflows, and equip them with an unparalleled toolkit they can use anywhere. With unlimited access to world-class assets, innovative AI tools, and hands-on tutorials, we deliver what creatives need today - and are continually evolving our offering. As AI transforms the creative landscape, we’re committed to building what’s next for the future.

We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values: Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow.

You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024.

About the role 

The Senior Reviewer, Code & Web Templates is responsible for reviewing, assessing, and maintaining quality standards across Envato’s broad code and web template categories, including Web Themes & UI Templates, Template Kits, WordPress, WordPress Plugins, Scripts, Plugins, and Code assets.

As Envato continues to evolve its Content Operations model, this role will help consolidate review expertise into a smaller, stronger, and more scalable team in Mexico. The Senior Reviewer will be expected to apply expert judgment across the full Code Review landscape, ensuring that submissions meet Envato’s technical, usability, security, originality, documentation, and commercial-quality expectations.

This role plays a critical part in protecting customer trust, supporting contributor quality, improving review consistency, and helping Envato maintain a high-quality marketplace experience across its web, theme, template, and code categories.

What you'll be doing

Scope of Review Coverage 

- This role may review and support quality decisions across the following asset groups:
- Web Themes & UI Templates.
- Site Templates.
- UI Templates.
- Template Kits.
- ThemeForest categories, excluding areas that require separate specialists. handling where applicable.
- WordPress themes.
- WordPress plugins.
- Scripts.
- Plugins.
- Code assets.
- Front-end templates and components.
- Admin dashboards, landing pages, HTML templates, and related web products.
- PHP, JavaScript, CSS, HTML, and CMS-based assets.

- Deep specialization in every domain is not required from the outset. However, this role requires a strong full-stack technical foundation, practical hands-on experience, and the learning agility necessary to effectively review, assess, and contribute across all relevant areas at a high professional standard.

Content Review & Quality Assessment 

- Review and assess submissions across all code and web template categories against Envato’s technical, quality, usability, documentation, security, and commercial standards.

- Apply review criteria consistently across all asset types, including design quality, code quality, functionality, responsiveness, browser compatibility, accessibility, performance, security, dependency management, documentation, installation and setup experience, originality, and commercial value, while adapting standards to the specific expectations of each category.

- Identify and reject submissions that do not meet marketplace standards, including those with poor code quality, broken functionality, inadequate documentation, security concerns, excessive dependencies, low originality, poor usability, intellectual property risks, or limited commercial value.

- Provide clear, objective, and constructive review outcomes aligned with established review guidelines.

Risk Management & Escalation 

- Identify complex, ambiguous, or high-risk submissions and escalate them to the appropriate stakeholders for further review.

- Recognize emerging category risks, contributor patterns, and quality concerns that may impact marketplace standards or customer trust.

Standards, Documentation & Continuous Improvement 

- Support calibration activities to ensure consistency and alignment of review standards across the Code Review team.

- Contribute to the development and maintenance of review documentation, category standards, technical benchmarks, and reviewer enablement materials.

- Identify recurring contributor issues, operational bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve review quality, efficiency, and consistency.

- Stay current with modern web development practices, WordPress, JavaScript frameworks, UI/UX trends, plugin ecosystems, marketplace expectations, and AI-assisted development trends.

Team Collaboration & Operational Support 

- Partner with Content Operations leaders to support the evolution of the review function, including the transition from a larger contractor model to a smaller, highly skilled, cross-functional Mexico-based review team.

- Maintain productivity and turnaround expectations while ensuring quality, consistency, and customer trust are not compromised.

- Act as a subject matter expert in code and web template review, supporting team knowledge sharing, reviewer development, and continuous improvement initiatives.

About you

Key Capabilities 

- Strong full-stack development background with practical experience across front-end and back-end web development, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, WordPress themes and plugins, scripts, and web templates - covering responsive design, browser compatibility, performance optimization, and accessibility basics.

- Strong understanding of WordPress ecosystems including template hierarchy, installation workflows, customization, dependencies, and common marketplace quality issues.

- Strong understanding of clean code practices, file organization, naming conventions, documentation standards, version compatibility, and user setup experience.

- Ability to identify common technical risks including broken functionality, poor code structure, weak security practices, performance issues, unsupported dependencies, and poor customer usability.

- Strong eye for commercial quality, customer value, modern design execution, and marketplace relevance.

- Ability to use AI-assisted tools to support review throughput, code analysis, and other workflow and productivity efficiencies.

- Ability to make consistent, objective, and well-reasoned review decisions across multiple asset categories.

- Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly and professionally.

- High attention to detail with the ability to identify technical and quality issues quickly.

- Comfortable maintaining strong quality standards while meeting productivity and turnaround expectations.

- Ability to collaborate with global teams in a remote or hybrid environment.

- Fluent or strong professional proficiency in English.

Required Technical Coverage

This role requires solid working knowledge across several relevant technical domains, with the adaptability and learning agility needed to develop proficiency across the broader review scope over time.

- HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive web development

- PHP and WordPress development.

- WordPress themes and plugin ecosystems.

- Site Templates and UI Templates.

- Template Kits and page-builder-based assets.

- Scripts, plugins, and reusable code products.

- Installation, configuration, dependency management and documentation review.

- Code quality, security basics, compatibility, performance, and maintainability.

- Marketplace asset quality standards and customer usability expectations.

Additional Experience 

- Previous experience reviewing or creating assets for a digital marketplace.

- Familiarity with Envato’s marketplaces, including ThemeForest and CodeCanyon.

- Deeper specialisation in one or more areas beyond the required technical coverage.

- Experience in QA, technical validation, software testing, content review, or marketplace operations.

- Familiarity with intellectual property, licensing, open-source dependencies, and AI-assisted code generation risks as they apply to marketplace submissions.

- Experience supporting process improvement, reviewer calibration, documentation, or category quality standards.

Compensation

Additional Information

Life at Envato 

• Flexible Working: remote-first with flexibility for you to manage work and life as you need. 

• Work from Anywhere: apply to work in another location for up to 3 months per calendar year.

• Conoce Mexico: a unique travel benefit for you to explore and visit new places across Mexico.

• Connection Budget: an annual budget to connect with the team IRL where and when possible.

• Learning Budget - Study leave and an annual budget for you to put towards your learning and development.

• Home Office Allowance: contribution towards your set-up and a monthly allowance to support work from home costs.

• Wellbeing: access to a holistic assistance program that provides support in many areas of life and health.

• Volunteer Leave: 2 days per calendar year to volunteer and give back to the community.

• Parental Leave: 20 weeks paid primary carer leave, and 6 weeks paid secondary carers leave. 

• Christmas Bonus, Paid Holidays and Holiday Bonus: we offer 30 days paid in December, you will have 12 days vacation in the first year, and you will earn 100% of holiday bonus.

• Grocery tickets: we offer you a monthly amount of 5% (subject to the legal cap) in food vouchers, which can be used in markets, pharmacies and more.

• 5% Saving Funds (fondo de ahorro).

• Private Health Insurance (SGMM).

• Unlimited Ebooks.

By submitting your application you are agreeing to our Privacy Policy. If you would like to understand how we handle personal information before submitting your application, please read through our Privacy Policy.

Research shows candidates from neurodiverse and underrepresented backgrounds often only apply for roles if they meet all the criteria. We like to make our hiring decisions based on lived experience, so if you’re keen to apply and need reasonable adjustments please let us know.

We appreciate the time you’ve taken to apply to Envato and we're committed to responding to every applicant.

Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. 

Hartford Investment Management Company (HIMCO)

Internship, Business Operations 

Hartford Investment Management Company (HIMCO), a subsidiary of The Hartford Insurance Group, is committed to being a leading provider of investment management solutions. 

About HIMCO

Hartford Investment Management Company (HIMCO) has been providing investment advice for over 35 years. With more than 130 investment professionals and approximately $120 billion in assets under management (AUM) across the fixed income, equity, and alternatives markets, we deliver tailored strategies to insurance companies as well as retail and institutional clients. Our mission is the pursuit of investment excellence centered on each client's success, and we have developed a culture that fosters debate and collaboration in an effort to drive value and results.

Why intern in Business Operations?

This is a great hands-on opportunity at a growing investment management company with affiliate and third-party assets under management. Interns will work across Business Operations, data, and technology initiatives, helping analyze processes, support reporting and data needs, and identify practical opportunities to improve efficiency, controls, and decision-making. This internship offers students a firsthand look at how business processes, data, and technology support investment management, with opportunities to collaborate across Business Operations, Portfolio Management, Trading, and IT through meaningful project work, networking, and a capstone presentation. Interns will also gain knowledge of fixed income, equity, derivative, and alternative assets with varying degrees of complexity.

About the internship

This is a 10-week experience designed to immerse interns in the buy-side investment management industry by working alongside one of HIMCO’s Business Operations teams. Assignments may include performance measurement and attribution, investment reporting, trade operations, data integrity, reconciliation and controls, valuations, or business process improvement. Interns may help document current-state processes, analyze data quality or reporting needs, support workflow improvement efforts, and contribute to initiatives that connect business requirements with technology-enabled solutions. Interns are offered development opportunities through mentoring, networking, business unit reviews, executive speakers, volunteering, and social events. Each intern’s contributions will culminate in a capstone project presentation to HIMCO senior leaders. Successful summer interns may be invited back for a full-time Business Operations position.

What are we looking for?

Our summer internship program is open to candidates pursuing a bachelor’s degree, with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028. While no specific major is required, we are looking for highly motivated students with strong academic achievements, an interest in financial markets, and curiosity about how business, data, and technology intersect. We value candidates who bring fresh perspectives, ask thoughtful questions about how and why work is performed, and are comfortable proposing new ideas. Successful candidates will be interested in understanding existing processes, identifying potential improvements, and working collaboratively with business and technology partners to develop practical solutions. Candidate qualities we look for include:

- Curiosity, analytical thinking, and motivation to understand how business processes work and where they can be improved

- Strong academic achievement, related coursework, experience and/or interest in areas such as finance, economics, business, mathematics, computer science, engineering, data analytics, or business analysis

- Willingness to challenge assumptions, ask thoughtful questions, and identify more effective ways of working

- Interest in using data, reporting, automation, and technology concepts to solve business problems, improve processes, and support better decision-making

- Ability to collaborate with Business Operations teams, IT partners, Front Office and other technical stakeholders to translate business needs into practical solutions

- Strong attention to detail, initiative, time management, follow-through, clear communication, and comfort working in a collaborative environment with a proactive mindset.

- Interest in applying data and technology to improve business processes, reporting, controls, operational efficiency, and decision-making

- Familiarity with concepts such as data analysis, visualization, reporting, database design, business analysis, workflow automation, or generative AI

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office; exposure to tools such as Excel, Power BI, Power Automate, SQL, Python, or Excel VBA is a plus

title: Director of Growth Marketing
description:
Fireclay Tile is here to revolutionize the tile and design industry. By implementing an innovative digital platform paired with unmatched artisan-crafted products and client service, we've made it easier than ever to specify and purchase beautiful, sustainable tile sourced and handcrafted in the US. Our tireless commitment to innovation, transparency, and sustainability has not gone unrecognized. We aim to grow 25-35% annually and are the first tile company recognized as a B Corp for how we use Business as a Force for Good. With an innovative product, an ambitious team, and an inspiring mission, we're changing the way you think about tile. Come join the makers who support the dreamers! 

Location: San Francisco Bay Area preferred. Remote U.S.- based candidates considered, with occasional San Francisco Bay Area travel.

The Team You’ll Work With … 

As Director of Growth, you will lead Fireclay’s growth engine across homeowner, Trade, and commercial customer journeys. You will own the growth roadmap for fireclaytile.com and lead the connected work across performance marketing, lifecycle, E-Commerce conversion, SEM, SEO, GEO, affiliate and partner growth, site experience, measurement, and AI-enabled workflows.

This role reports to Eric Edelson , Fox Marble and Fireclay’s CEO, and will partner closely with the VP of Technology, VP of Sales, VP of Brand & Product, and VP of Client Success. Technology owns engineering and delivery. Brand & Product retain final creative and product direction. You own the growth strategy, media budget, website growth roadmap, performance priorities, and operating cadence that connect those efforts to commercial outcomes. You will inherit an agency and part of a team, then build the capability around you. This is a salary role, target total annual compensation of $150,000–$250,000, inclusive of base salary, bonus, and equity, depending on experience and scope.

The Challenge

Fireclay is working to double revenue over the next 24 months. As Director of Growth, you will help build the demand engine to make that possible. Your mandate is to scale media investment from low six figures today toward mid- and high-six figures over time, but only where the data proves we can do so profitably. You will build the measurement, customer journeys, website experience, creative-learning system, and operating rhythm that turn more demand into qualified samples, new customers, Trade relationships, and revenue.

This role is for a builder who wants to join a team and help shape a brand. You care about the product, the customer, and the people making it. You know that durable growth comes from understanding a brand deeply and working exceptionally well with the people responsible for product, technology, sales, service, and creative, not optimizing channels in isolation. You will not inherit a finished machine. You will help build one.

The Opportunities You’ll Have …

- Build the growth engine required to help double Fireclay revenue in 24 months.

- Own the growth funnel from investment and qualified traffic through sample order, purchase, Trade engagement, revenue, and contribution.

- Lead paid-media strategy, agency management, budget allocation, creative learning, and performance accountability. Define when Fireclay should spend more, hold, or pull back using customer quality, conversion, revenue, and contribution guardrails—not platform ROAS alone.

- Own the growth roadmap for fireclaytile.com, including customer journeys, landing pages, merchandising, UI/UX improvements, site performance, and conversion opportunities.

- Build an integrated sample-to-purchase system across paid acquisition, lifecycle, on-site experience, sales and client-success handoffs, and post-sample communications.

- Activate profitable growth opportunities beyond conventional paid media, including Trade affiliate and partner programs, post-sample print and direct-mail programs, referral opportunities, and other testable acquisition channels.

- Build a lean, high-performing growth operating model. Use the right mix of in-house leadership, agency partners, specialist vendors, and global/offshore talent to expand SEM, SEO, GEO, analytics, creative production, and lifecycle capacity cost-effectively—without compromising quality, security, brand, or accountability.

- Turn Fireclay’s Trade member audience into a stronger growth engine. Build and scale affiliate, referral, partner, education, lifecycle, and engagement programs that create incremental qualified demand and durable member value.

- Build lifecycle programs that make the next best action clear for homeowners, designers, Trade customers, and commercial accounts—from discovery and sampling through purchase, engagement, and reactivation.

- Establish a reliable measurement foundation across analytics, advertising platforms, CRM, sales, and financial outcomes. Improve the data before drawing conclusions from it.

- Create a disciplined experimentation cadence: clear hypotheses, high-value tests, success metrics, guardrails, decision thresholds, and recommendations on what to scale, stop, or learn next.

- Use AI tools—including Claude, ChatGPT, and emerging systems—to accelerate analysis, creative development, workflow design, testing, and team productivity without compromising judgment, privacy, or customer experience.

- Build, coach, and lead the team required to scale the function.

What Success Looks Like Early

- First 15 days: Diagnose the funnel, media mix, agency performance, customer journeys, and measurement gaps; establish the commercial baseline.

- First 30 days: Present the growth roadmap and investment thesis; reallocate budget where warranted; launch the first high-priority conversion, lifecycle, and acquisition tests.

- First 60 days: Put a trusted growth scorecard and operating cadence in place; show early performance movement; establish the hiring, agency, and technology plan required to scale.

About You …

- You have helped scale a consumer, home, design, or adjacent business from approximately $50M to $250M in revenue. You know how to grow with constraints—not merely with large teams and large budgets.

- You have deep experience across DTC E-Commerce and B2B, Trade, or commercial customer journeys. You understand their different needs, buying cycles, and definitions of success.

- You are AI-native. You live in Claude, ChatGPT, or comparable tools and have used them to make your own work and your teams meaningfully faster and better. You know the difference between real leverage and AI theater. You will be asked to demonstrate your AI workflow.

- You have personally led work across SEM, SEO, GEO, paid acquisition, lifecycle marketing, affiliate and partner growth, conversion-rate optimization, E-Commerce merchandising, and website performance.

- You are analytically rigorous and commercially minded. You can work from imperfect data, reconcile sources, identify the real constraint, and turn insight into action.

- You know the difference between an ad-platform metric and a business outcome. You care about qualified demand, revenue, contribution, and customer quality—not vanity metrics.

- You have operated across an omni-channel business, connecting digital demand with sales, service, showrooms, or other human-assisted customer experiences.

- You are a missionary, not a mercenary. You want to become part of a brand and a team—not simply optimize another media account.

- You are a collaborative, resourceful leader who earns trust across technology, sales, brand, product, and client-success teams. You bring strong points of view while respecting functional expertise.

- You bring established, high-quality relationships with agency, technology, affiliate, publisher, and specialist partners. You know when to build in-house, when to use flexible expertise, and how to hold every partner accountable to commercial outcomes.

- You have direct experience using specialized global and offshore talent effectively. You can create clear standards, workflows, QA, and accountability that make distributed capacity an advantage rather than a source of rework.

- You have built or scaled affiliate and partner-growth programs, ideally involving a Trade, professional, design, or member audience. You know how to drive engagement and profitable growth without treating a valued community as a cheap acquisition channel.

- You have a high bar for customer experience. You know how to improve conversion without compromising trust, clarity, design quality, or the Fireclay brand.

Why Fireclay? 

Beyond the role itself, here’s what makes Fireclay Tile a special place to work:

- 
Our Mission: We are on a mission to do good by crafting products intentionally, collaboratively, and transparently. We are the makers, who support the dreamers. 

- 
Our Values: We live by Kindness, Honesty, Tread Lightly on the Earth, Measure Twice, Cut Once, and Ganas (Desire).

- 
Our Commitment: We are accountable to the B Corp standards, prioritizing People and Planet alongside Profit. 

- 
Growth and Innovation: We are committed to "25-35% annual growth" and are revolutionizing the tile and design industry. 

- 
Our Culture: We foster a culture of professional development, ongoing training, and opportunities for growth.

- 
Our Benefits: We offer a comprehensive compensation package, including medical, dental, vision, a 4% 401(k) match, PTO (non-exempt) or FTO (exempt), sick time, and other perks. Visit Fireclaybenefits.com to view details of our benefits and perks offered. 

Serving as a Fireclay Tile Brand Ambassador, representing our core values including: 

Kindness ○ Honesty ○ Tread Lightly on the Earth ○ Measure Twice, Cut Once ○ Ganas (Desire)

Accountable to the B Corp standards, we take care of our People and our Planet while turning a Profit.

title: Client Onboarding Analyst – New Plans
description:
POSITION PURPOSE

The Client Onboarding Analyst – New Plans supports the end-to-end onboarding of newly sold 401(k) plans onto Ubiquity’s recordkeeping platform. Working within the New Plan team and reporting to the New Plan Team Lead, this role is responsible for executing plan setup tasks, preparing plan documents, coordinating payroll integration, and managing an active pipeline of new plan cases from contract through go-live. The Analyst serves as the primary point of contact for plan sponsors, financial advisors, and Third Party Administrators throughout the setup process, providing proactive communication, ongoing platform education, and compliance-aware guidance at every milestone. All complex issues, escalations, and cross-functional blockers are routed through the New Plan Team Lead.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

New Plan Setup & Document Preparation

- Manage an assigned pipeline of new 401(k) plan cases from initial contract through go-live on Ubiquity’s platform, tracking each case against established milestones and SLAs using Salesforce and internal case management tools; proactively flag cases at risk of delay to the New Plan Team Lead.

- Draft plan documents for new clients based on their selected plan design elections, ensuring all provisions are accurately reflected and in compliance with ERISA, IRS, and DOL requirements.

- Review and verify plan design elections submitted by plan sponsors and advisors, identifying and clarifying any inconsistencies or missing information before plan document preparation begins.

- Establish trust accounts and confirm investment elections are properly configured in accordance with the plan document and client instructions.

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date case records, notes, and milestone documentation in Salesforce and Ubiquity’s recordkeeping system throughout the plan setup lifecycle.

Payroll Integration & Contribution Setup

- Coordinate payroll setup requirements directly with plan sponsors to ensure contribution data, employee census information, and payroll schedules are accurately configured prior to the first payroll submission.

- Guide plan sponsors through the process of connecting their payroll system to Ubiquity’s platform, explaining integration steps, expected timelines, and required actions clearly and proactively.

- Monitor initial payroll submissions after go-live to confirm contributions are processing correctly; identify and troubleshoot discrepancies in contribution amounts, employee eligibility data, or payroll file formats, escalating to the New Plan Team Lead when issues cannot be resolved at the analyst level.

- Document payroll setup configurations and any integration issues encountered for each case, maintaining a clear record in Salesforce for the plan’s ongoing service history.

Client & Advisor Communication

- Serve as the primary point of contact for plan sponsors, financial advisors, and Third Party Administrators throughout the new plan setup process, providing proactive, milestone-based updates on outstanding items and next steps.

- Conduct plan setup kickoff calls to establish expectations, review the onboarding timeline, confirm required actions from each party, and introduce plan sponsors to the Ubiquity platform.

- Deliver ongoing platform education throughout the onboarding lifecycle, including portal navigation, contribution submission, employee enrollment, and plan reporting, ensuring sponsors are fully equipped to manage their plan independently at go-live.

- Follow up in a timely and organized manner to obtain required documentation, signatures, and plan elections, creating appropriate urgency to minimize time to first contribution.

- Escalate complex plan design questions, unresolved setup issues, or cross-functional blockers to the New Plan Team Lead rather than attempting to resolve them independently or routing directly to other departments.

Compliance & Quality Assurance

- Ensure all plan setup tasks are completed in accordance with ERISA, IRS, and DOL requirements, including plan document provisions, required notices, contribution limits, and eligibility rules.

- Review completed plan setup work for accuracy before submission, identifying errors or omissions and correcting them prior to plan go-live.

- Stay current on changes to IRS and DOL regulations, plan contribution limits, and SECURE Act provisions that affect new plan setup and plan document preparation.

- Maintain, follow, and enforce all Ubiquity security policies and procedures at all times.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Escalation

- Coordinate directly with internal teams on routine plan setup tasks and approvals within established processes and authority levels, routing escalated issues or items requiring leadership judgment to the New Plan Team Lead.

- Partner with Sales and Client Experience to ensure a smooth handoff from the point of sale through plan setup, with client expectations clearly established from day one.

- Contribute to team process improvement efforts by identifying recurring setup issues, documentation gaps, payroll configuration challenges, or workflow inefficiencies and surfacing them to the New Plan Team Lead.

- Support the team during high-volume periods by assisting colleagues with case overflow and contributing to shared team priorities as directed by the New Plan Team Lead.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

- Experience in the 401(k) or retirement plan industry preferred, including exposure to new plan setup, plan implementation, plan documents, or plan design.

- Working knowledge of 401(k) plan design and administration, including Safe Harbor, traditional 401(k), Profit Sharing, ERISA requirements, and IRS contribution limits preferred.

- Familiarity with payroll integrations, contribution files, census data, and digital plan onboarding workflows a plus.

- Experience in a fintech, SaaS, or technology-driven environment, including API-based integrations or cloud-based recordkeeping platforms, preferred.

- Experience conducting client-facing onboarding or plan setup consultations with plan sponsors and financial advisors preferred.

- Proficiency with CRM and workflow management tools such as Salesforce and Asana; experience with recordkeeping, plan document, compliance testing, or Form 5500 platforms (e.g., FT Williams, ASC) a plus.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Excel, and Word.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to manage a high-volume case pipeline while maintaining accuracy and meeting SLAs.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a professional, client-focused approach.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively, exercise sound judgment, and escalate issues appropriately within established protocols.

- QKA designation or active pursuit of ASPPA or NIPA credentials a plus.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Benefits & Perks 

- Health, dental, and vision coverage — 90% of your premium covered, 60% for dependents

- 401(k) with company match up to 4% of your gross annual pay

- $100/month wellness reimbursement + $300 home office stipend

- Fully remote, flexible work culture

Compensation & Schedule 

The annual base salary range for this role is $73,000–$83,000, with the opportunity to earn an additional 5% in variable compensation based on performance.

This role is expected to work 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m or 9:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. Pacific Time to ensure alignment and availability with the team.

title: Growth Lead
description:
WHO WE ARE

Jampp is a programmatic advertising platform used by the most ambitious companies to accelerate their mobile businesses. Founded in 2013, Jampp leverages machine learning, creative optimization, and proprietary advertising solutions to drive incremental growth for leading mobile advertisers such as Uber, Just Eat, FREENOW, Rappi, and BIGO Live.

We’ve experienced tremendous growth over the past years: from expanding our global footprint to 10+ countries and building a team of 100+ mobile experts, to becoming part of the Affle Group, a fast-growing AdTech company that successfully launched its IPO in 2019 and owns multiple industry-leading platforms, including Appnext, mDSP, mediasmart, Newton, RevX, Ultra, and YouAppi, in addition to Jampp .

Today, Jampp is consistently ranked as a top mobile performance partner by the industry’s leading MMPs, featured across 10 categories of Singular’s ROI Index and listed as a top-10 performer in AppsFlyer’s Performance Index.

THE GROWTH TEAM

We are looking for an outstanding Growth Lead to lead our Growth team.

The Growth team is responsible for defining and executing advanced performance strategies to help mobile companies achieve their growth goals by continuously iterating and running A/B experiments on key campaign components such as audiences, creatives, bidding strategies, and more. The team works closely with Product, Customer Success, Sales, and Tech to improve campaign performance and advertiser outcomes.

As Growth Lead, you will own the region’s performance strategy, prioritize accounts and opportunities, and connect business needs with Product priorities. You will combine hands-on campaign management with strategic leadership, guiding the team toward scalable and sustainable growth.

You will lead and mentor a team of Growth Analysts while staying close to execution, ensuring best practices, strong analytical rigor, and high performance standards across campaigns. You will help the team troubleshoot complex performance and technical challenges, turning insights from daily operations into experiments, Product feedback, and scalable best practices.

As part of the Product organization , you will bring a critical perspective on advertisers, campaign challenges, and growth opportunities. You will work closely with Sales and Customer Success to understand business needs, and partner with Product and Tech to translate those needs into clear priorities and actionable solutions.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own Growth’s performance strategy for the region, setting regional priorities and action plans to improve campaign quality, advertiser results, and sustainable growth.

- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Growth Analysts, helping them prioritize their work, strengthen their technical and analytical skills, and take ownership of results.

- Stay close to campaign execution, managing strategic accounts when needed and guiding the team through optimization, experimentation, and complex troubleshooting.

- Monitor regional and account performance, using SQL, BI tools, and campaign data to identify risks, investigate root causes, and make informed decisions.

- Connect business needs with Product priorities. Bring insights from advertisers and campaigns to Product, help prioritize opportunities, and follow through on solutions with the team.

- Act as the link between the region business needs and Product priorities. Stay close to new Product developments, identify opportunities to test them across regional campaigns, and provide structured feedback based on performance results and the team’s experience.

- Partner with Sales and Customer Success to understand advertiser objectives, align on account priorities, and build plans for retention and growth.

- Define and prioritize A/B experiments across audiences, creatives, bidding strategies, and other campaign components. Turn validated results and recurring insights into best practices and Product feedback.

- Identify opportunities to improve Growth’s processes, reporting, and workflows, including the use of automation and AI tools.

🤚 This isn’t an exhaustive list. At Jampp , we believe in autonomy and look for people who spot opportunities for improvement and take the initiative to make them happen.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Business, Statistics, or a related field.

- At least 5 years of experience in performance advertising, AdTech, or growth, with hands-on ownership of campaign strategy, optimization, and results. Experience in mobile advertising, programmatic media, or a DSP is preferred.

- At least 2 years of experience leading or mentoring analysts , setting priorities, and developing team members through coaching and feedback.

- Proficiency in SQL and experience using BI tools to investigate performance issues, identify root causes, and guide others through troubleshooting.

- Solid understanding of mobile measurement and attribution, with hands-on experience using MMP data to analyze and optimize campaign performance.

- Familiarity with campaign performance metrics such as CPA and ROAS, tracking, and the factors that affect delivery and optimization.

- Experience designing and evaluating experiments, and translating results into actionable recommendations that can scale across campaigns.

- Ability to connect business needs with Product priorities, bringing regional and advertiser insights to Product, framing problems with supporting evidence, and following through on tests and solutions.

- Clear communication and the ability to align stakeholders across Product, Customer Success, Sales, and Tech.

- Advanced English, both written and spoken, and Spanish or Portuguese for collaboration across teams.

- A hands-on leadership style, sound judgment, and the ability to balance regional strategy, team development, and day-to-day execution.

- 🤓 An ambitious self-starter who enjoys a challenge and continuous learning.

- 💙 Someone others enjoy working with because of their competence, clarity, and positive attitude.

WHAT WE OFFER

- 📱 Learn a ton about the hottest area of growth in Internet advertising - Mobile!

- 💰 Competitive salary

- 🤰🏻 Extended Maternity/Paternity leaves

- 🌴 Extended holidays every year

- 📈 A great level of responsibility from day one and the chance to develop your potential without limitations.

- 💪 An entrepreneurial environment.

- 💻 Office and remote work balance.

- 🤓 A structured remote onboarding process and continuous training with a supportive team. We win together!

title: Director, People Operations & Systems
description:
We are building a lean, AI-enabled People function, and the Director of People Operations & Systems will own the infrastructure that allows it to operate accurately, efficiently, and at scale. This leader is accountable for our People systems ecosystem, people data integrity, payroll governance and controls, employee lifecycle operations, and the continuous redesign of People workflows through AI, automation, and self-service.

This is a builder role. You will inherit systems and processes that need to evolve, lead our transition to a modern HR technology environment, and create an operating model that reduces manual work while strengthening accuracy, controls, and the employee and manager experience. You will be close enough to the work to understand it deeply and step in when necessary, but your primary job is to build systems, controls, talent, and workflows that do not depend on you personally executing every transaction.

You will lead core People Operations capabilities, including payroll and benefits/compliance team members, and serve as the senior operational partner to Finance, IT, Legal, Security, Talent, and People leadership. The right person combines strong HR systems and payroll judgment with a first-principles mindset: you see a clunky process and ask not only how to automate it, but whether it should exist in its current form at all.

What You Will Own

People Systems & Technology

- Own the People technology ecosystem and roadmap, including HRIS architecture, system governance, integrations, access, vendor performance, and continuous improvement.

- Serve as the internal business owner for our planned HRIS modernization, leading requirements, data migration, configuration decisions, testing, training, rollout, and adoption in partnership with implementation experts and cross-functional stakeholders.

- Ensure People systems are designed around scalable workflows, clear controls, manager and employee self-service, and reliable downstream data.

- Partner with IT and Security on integrations, access controls, system changes, and audit requirements across the People technology stack.

People Data, Analytics & Controls

- Own the integrity and governance of People data, including organizational structure, job architecture fields, compensation-related data, employee records, and reporting structures.

- Build proactive data-quality controls that identify discrepancies before they create payroll, reporting, compliance, or employee-experience issues.

- Develop scalable dashboards and self-service reporting that give leaders timely insight into headcount, hiring, turnover, compensation, and talent trends.

- Reduce reliance on recurring manual reports by redesigning reporting workflows and automating repeatable data delivery wherever practical.

Payroll Governance & Operational Risk

- Lead the payroll capability and provide senior oversight of payroll operations, with accountability for accuracy, timeliness, controls, documentation, audit readiness, and effective issue resolution.

- Manage and develop the payroll team member responsible for day-to-day payroll execution; remain sufficiently close to the work to review controls, interrogate payroll outputs, understand multi-state requirements, and step in during high-risk or exceptional situations.

- Establish clear review and escalation mechanisms across People and Finance, including independent controls for high-risk payroll changes and exceptions.

- Redesign payroll and payroll-adjacent workflows as systems and automation mature, shifting the function toward governance, exception management, auditing, and continuous improvement rather than manual processing.

Employee Lifecycle & People Operations

- Own the effectiveness of the operational infrastructure supporting onboarding, offboarding, employment changes, contractor lifecycle processes, I-9/E-Verify, and Employer of Record operations for international team members.

- Ensure workflows are accurate, compliant, well controlled, and increasingly self-service; the role owns the effectiveness of the operating system even when another team member or system executes individual steps.

- Partner with Finance, IT, Legal, Security, Talent, and People Business Partners to create clean handoffs and clear decision rights across employee lifecycle processes.

- Maintain a resilient operating model with clear documentation, backup coverage, escalation paths, and ownership for recurring People operations.

Benefits, Compliance & Team Leadership

- Lead and support the Benefits & Compliance capability, ensuring the team has clear priorities, escalation support, strong vendor partnerships, and an effective compliance operating rhythm.

- Own operational compliance infrastructure and audit readiness while partnering with subject-matter experts, Legal, Finance, brokers, and external advisors where specialized judgment is required.

- Clarify roles, decision rights, controls, and service expectations across People Operations; coach team members to operate at the appropriate level and build durable functional capability.

- Build capacity through systems, partners, automation, and role clarity rather than defaulting to additional headcount.

AI-Enabled Operational Transformation

- Continuously identify manual handoffs, administrative bottlenecks, recurring reporting cycles, and control points that can be eliminated, simplified, automated, or redesigned.

- Use AI and automation as core tools for operating-model redesign—not simply individual productivity—including exception detection, data-quality auditing, workflow orchestration, employee/manager self-service, and recurring operational processes.

- Evaluate workflows from first principles before automating them: remove unnecessary steps, clarify ownership, reduce middle-person handoffs, and preserve human judgment where risk or complexity requires it.

- Measure whether redesigned workflows improve capacity, speed, accuracy, control, or employee/manager experience, and iterate based on results.

Cross-Functional Partnership

- Serve as the senior People Operations partner to Finance and Accounting on payroll controls, People data, workforce reporting, systems changes, and operating risk.

- Partner with IT and Security on systems architecture, integrations, access, and controls; with Legal on employment and compliance matters; and with Talent and People leadership on processes that depend on high-quality People data and infrastructure.

- Translate complex operational issues into clear recommendations, tradeoffs, and decisions for People leadership and executive stakeholders.

Requirements

- 8–12+ years of progressive People Operations, HRIS, HR technology, payroll operations, or related experience, including senior ownership of complex operational environments.

- Demonstrated experience leading a major HRIS implementation or transformation. Direct Rippling experience is strongly preferred; ADP Workforce Now experience is a plus.

- Strong payroll fluency, including controls, multi-state considerations, audits, exceptions, and the relationship between upstream HRIS data and payroll accuracy.

- Experience leading and developing operational team members and creating clear accountability across functions.

- Strong systems and data orientation: you can move between process architecture, data quality, reporting, integrations, controls, and practical execution.

- Evidence of redesigning workflows through automation, AI, self-service, or technology—not simply digitizing an existing manual process.

- Comfort using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude as part of day-to-day problem solving, analysis, and workflow design.

- Strong analytical and spreadsheet skills, sound judgment, high attention to detail, and a bias toward durable solutions rather than workarounds.

- Ability to partner credibly across Finance, IT, Security, Legal, Talent, and senior People leadership, including navigating ambiguity and making clear recommendations.

- Working fluency in compensation and benefits operations is valuable; deep compensation strategy expertise is not required.

How Success Will Be Measured

- People data is trusted, governed, and increasingly self-correcting through strong controls.

- The HRIS modernization is delivered with clear ownership, sound configuration decisions, successful adoption, and stable integrations.

- Payroll operates with strong controls, clear accountability, effective backup coverage, and fewer manual failure points.

- Managers and employees can complete more routine People processes through intuitive systems and self-service without unnecessary People Team intervention.

- Recurring People Operations work becomes materially less manual as AI, automation, and workflow redesign create measurable capacity and quality improvements.

- Benefits, payroll, and operational team members have clear ownership, escalation paths, and room to operate at the appropriate level.

- Cross-functional partners experience People Operations as reliable, responsive, data-driven, and clear about decision rights.

Benefits

Base Salary: The base salary range for this position is $148,750 - $218,750. Our salary is just one component of Panorama’s competitive total rewards strategy that also includes annual bonuses or commission awards, equity awards, as well as other region-specific health and welfare benefits

Some of the additional benefits offered are:

- 401K with an employer match

- Health, dental, vision, life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability coverage. 

- Flexible spending account for health care and dependent care

- Wellness Reimbursement

- Company Issued Laptop

Job Description Summary: 

The Associate Director, Pharmacovigilance (PV) performs the function of Safety Scientist within the PV department for both clinical trials and post-marketing surveillance support for PTC products. 

He/she leads and project manages deliverables including, but not limited to, aggregate reports and risk management plans. He/she actively contributes as needed to signal detection activities and the safety review board.

The Associate Director, Pharmacovigilance (PV) works cross-functionally with internal departments/key stakeholders and external resources on PV-related matters to adhere to global PV regulations and requirements. Job Description:

- Provides and ensures oversight for the technical and scientific support for safety surveillance and signal detection activities for PTC products.

- Alongside the safety physician, provides planning for, and ensures the conduct of, routine and ad-hoc cross-functional Safety Review Board (SRB) meetings.

- Contributes to the update of Risk Management Plans (RMPs) and ensures that regulatory and RMP commitments are efficiently tracked and presented as part of the SRB process. - Provides support to Drug Safety Monitoring Board and clinical trial support. · Contributes to investigator meetings, as needed.

- Interfaces with medical monitors for medical assessment and regulatory classification of SAEs; facilitates SAE reconciliation across projects.

- Assists as needed with serious adverse event follow-up and case closure.

- Performs other tasks and assignments as needed and specified by management.

- Works closely and collaborates with EU and local Qualified Person (QP) to develop new or maintain PV processes supporting both development and marketed/commercial products.

- BSN or Bachelor’s in Pharmacy or related life science discipline and a minimum of 8 years of progressively responsible pharmacovigilance experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology or related environment.

- Demonstrated, expert knowledge of relevant Food and Drug Administration (FDA), European Union (EU) and International Conference on Harmonisation (ICH) guidelines, initiatives, and regulations governing pharmacovigilance.

- Experience in scientific writing; project management; leading and contributing to required safety reports, etc.

- Extensive working knowledge of medical terminology and Medical Dictionary of Regulatory Activities (MedDRA).

- Demonstrated hands-on experience identifying, developing and implementing improvements to departmental processes that increase efficiency and maintain or improve quality.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office and excellent verbal and written communication and skills.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively, as required, in a fast-paced matrixed team environment consisting of internal and external team members.

- Analytical thinker with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines.

- Excellent planning, organization and time management skills including the ability to support and prioritize multiple projects.

- Ability to influence without direct authority.

*Special knowledge or skills and/or licenses or certificates preferred.

Plattform-Architektur. Du gestaltest die Architektur end-to-end über unsere gesamte Plattform mit — Frontend wie Backend, ein Team, ein gemeinsamer Task-Pool, keine Produkt-Silos.

- AI: Claude

Mission, die wirkt. Wir managen einen realen Teil des Wohnungsbestandes Deutschlands. Dein Code entscheidet mit, wie effektiv und nachhaltig Immobilienportfolien saniert und gemanagt werden können.
